title: Commercial Account Executive, Growth | Remote | Germany
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity 

Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals

  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales

  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & German 

 Bonus Points For: 

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards 

In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

What you bring

    Wir stellen dir professionelle Kameras, Mikrofone und Licht. Für die Postproduktion bekommst du die Maschine, auf der du am besten arbeitest, egal ob MacBook Pro oder Dell XPS mit Linux, dazu 4K-Monitore und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform schon sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Durch diesen Traffic siehst du schnell, was funktioniert, und bekommst direktes Feedback auf deine Arbeit.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Dein Content hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Content Creator (w/m/d) bist du nicht nur für den Schnitt verantwortlich. Du kannst Strateg:in, Regisseur:in oder Performance-Analyst:in sein.

  • Strategisches Video-Scripting
    Du entwickelst kreative Video-Konzepte und Skripte für alle relevanten Social-Media-Kanäle (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) und bringst sie bis zur finalen Fassung.
  • Produktionsmanagement
    Du planst, koordinierst und setzt Videodrehs um, von der Idee bis zum Upload.
  • Storytelling mit Impact
    Gemeinsam mit unserem Anwaltsteam verwandelst du komplexe juristische Themen in leicht verständliche, authentische und emotionale Geschichten.
  • Redaktionsplanung
    Du baust eine Content-Pipeline auf und sorgst mit deiner Redaktionsplanung für konstanten Output.
  • Content-Multiplikation
    Du planst Cross-Promotion und verwertest Content clever über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg.
  • Trend-Scouting
    Du erkennst aktuelle Social-Media-Trends und Formate früh und adaptierst sie schnell für Migrando.
  • Performance-Analyse
    Du analysierst laufend, wie dein Content performt (Views, Watch Time, Engagement), und optimierst ihn stetig.
  • A/B-Testing
    Du testest systematisch Thumbnails, Teaser, Titel und Call-to-Actions, um Klickrate und Performance zu maximieren.
  • Community- & Engagement-Management
    Du baust eine engagierte Community auf und pflegst sie, indem du aktiv auf Kommentare und DMs antwortest.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer in der Praxis gearbeitet und echte Hands-on-Erfahrung gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählen deine Erfahrung, dein Können und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Content-Produktion
    Du hast bereits Social-Media-Content produziert, der wirklich online gegangen ist und funktioniert hat, und kannst uns Beispiele dafür zeigen. Du weißt, was es heißt, regelmäßig zu liefern, und hast aus Erfolgen wie Flops gelernt.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Bereitschaft, vor der Kamera zu stehen
    Du hast keine Scheu, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen, und motivierst auch Kolleg:innen, ihre Geschichte zu teilen.
  • Video-Schnitt
    Idealerweise beherrschst du professionelle Schnittprogramme (z. B. Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve). In unserem Social-Media-Team gibt es aber auch Bedarf an Scripting, Ideenentwicklung und Content-Planung, ganz ohne Schnittsoftware.
  • Scripting-Können
    Du hast Erfahrung im Storytelling und Scripting von Kurzvideos mit fesselnden Hooks und CTAs, die wirken.
  • Social-Media-Algorithmen
    Du verstehst die Mechanismen, Algorithmen und Best Practices von TikTok, Instagram und YouTube.
  • Engagement-Fokus
    Du denkst nicht nur in Reichweite, sondern in Interaktion. Deine Metrik ist die Engagement Rate.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
    Du packst lieber an, als lange zu planen, baust schnell Prototypen und stellst Output über Perfektion.
  • Trendgespür
    Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, erkennst virale Trends und Formate und weißt, wie wir sie für unseren Content nutzen können.
  • Was dir helfen wird
    Du kannst dich in die Fragen und Herausforderungen von Menschen hineinversetzen, die nach Deutschland gekommen sind, und weißt, wie du dazu recherchierst, um daraus Content zu entwickeln.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.

title: Content & Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
About Tradeaze

Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live.

The role

You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it.

What you will do

  • Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office
  • Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch
  • Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design
  • Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches
  • Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good
  • Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand

Who you are

  • Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it
  • You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours.
  • You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional
  • You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follower will stop for
  • You already use AI in your work. You can show us something you shipped with it and talk us through how you use it
  • You've taken a campaign from the idea to launch: the message, the words and the design
  • You come to a conversation with ideas and you enjoy bouncing them off someone
  • You're personable: comfortable with sales reps, a room full of branch managers, and sitting with a merchant head office's marketing team to run a joint campaign
  • You'd rather get it live this week and improve it than plan it for a month
  • Nice to have: paid ads (you've run paid social or search with a budget), events (you've helped run a trade show stand) and email copy (you've written emails that get people to take one clear action)

Not for you if:

  • You want a brief handed to you
  • You need an agency to make things
  • You'd rather plan than ship

How we work

You will report to our GTM Engineer, and you both report to Jack, our CEO. You will work with the GTM Engineer day to day. They own the systems: the CRM, the email platform, the data and the sends. You own the message and the content. You will plan together, brainstorm together, and look at the numbers together every Monday. Jack opens the door with merchant head offices; you and the GTM Engineer run what happens next.

You will see your work on a live dashboard: what shipped, what it reached, and which branches ordered because of it.

What you get

  • £40k to £48k
  • Stock options
  • 25 days holiday
  • A laptop

How to apply

With your application, send us:

  1. 3 to 5 pieces of content you made yourself, ideally including one video you filmed and cut yourself (a phone is fine). Other examples: a social post or carousel, a campaign from idea to launch, a printed piece, a case study. For each one, a line on what you did and what it led to
  2. A few lines on how you use AI: which tools, for what, and one thing it let you ship

How we will hire

  1. Send us 3 to 5 pieces you made and a few lines on how you work with AI
  2. A call with Jack, our CEO
  3. A short campaign task, then a call with our GTM Engineer to talk it through
  4. Present your idea to the team in person: the same idea, updated with what you'd change. 15 minutes, no new deck needed

title: Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

  

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

title: Customer Operations Specialist (Part Time) (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission:

As a Customer Operations Specialist, you will be a fundamental part in the Operations team. As the first point of contact for customer requests you will be managing all customer related processes from onboarding management to off-boarding. You will ensure that customer data is up-to-date, as well as resolve any issues with customer accounts. You will also manage securities transfers in coordination with Investing Operations and take on non-routine tasks as they arise, such as supporting audit findings. Additionally, you will take ownership for all Customer Service processes and manage the relationship with the Customer Service teams of our partners, enabling them to provide outstanding Customer Service.

At lemon.markets, we value ownership a lot, that means, you will have autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. You’ll be collaborating closely with the Customer Lifecycle Domain, AFC Operations and the wider Operations team, you will leverage your expertise to optimize effective procedures and processes. Your collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Customer Service teams of our partners will be crucial in ensuring our customers will have a great customer experience.

In this role you will:

  • Be operationally responsible for all processes and tasks along customer onboarding, management and off-boarding.

  • Be operationally responsible for handling 2nd level Customer Service requests and complaints.

  • Take ownership for all customer service processes, expand the knowledge base and manage the relationship with the 1st level customer service of our partners.

  • Resolve account opening issues and update customer data.

  • Set up, operate and optimize robust processes and documentation.

  • Manage securities transfers, coordinating with Investing Operations to ensure accurate, timely completion and clear communication with customers throughout the process.

  • Take on non-routine tasks as they arise, such as supporting audit findings, investigating unusual cases, and contributing to projects beyond the regular scope of the role.


You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have relevant experience in Customer Operations or KYC Operations in the financial industry, ideally in a Fintech and a Bank/Financial services.

  • You have business/professional proficiency in German, written and spoken, as you will mainly advise German-speaking clients. English isalso required as it is the official language within our international team setup.

  • You are great at communicating in a written format and you thrive with cross-functional collaboration, working with Markets Ops, Securities Ops, Product.

  • You have experience with process optimisation and building out steps using a business workflow tool (i.e. Jira Service Management, Jira and Confluence is a plus).

  • You can prioritize effectively and are able to sift through the noise and assess what's critical for the current priority.

  • You are able to cope with uncertainty and navigate in an unstructured environment, creating processes and structure from scratch.


How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

title: Customer Service Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Zable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional support for a designated Zable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.

  • Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Feedback

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.

  • Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.

Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.

Our Interview Process
We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

What you'll be doing

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

title: Customer Support Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle bist du oft der erste und wichtigste Kontaktpunkt für unsere Kund:innen. Du verantwortest die Bearbeitung von Support-Tickets und Live-Chat-Anfragen, hilfst Unternehmen dabei, Probleme schnell und lösungsorientiert zu lösen und sorgst für eine starke Customer Experience. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Teams wie Product, Engineering und Customer Success zusammen und bringst wertvolles Feedback direkt aus dem Kundenkontakt zurück ins Unternehmen. Wenn du Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkten Impact auf unsere Kund:innen hast, könnte das perfekt zu dir passen.

Who We Want

Customer-first operator. Du denkst aus Sicht der Kund:innen, übernimmst Verantwortung für Probleme und möchtest echte Lösungen schaffen - nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten.

Calm under pressure. Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig passiert, behältst du den Überblick, priorisierst sinnvoll und kommunizierst klar und professionell.

Customer-obsessed and empathetic. Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich erklären, gehst geduldig auf unterschiedliche Kund:innen ein und sorgst für eine starke Customer Experience.

Collaborative and cross-functional. Du arbeitest eng mit Support, Product, Sales und Customer Success zusammen und verstehst, dass guter Support immer Teamarbeit ist.

Product-minded and analytical. Du möchtest verstehen, warum Probleme entstehen, erkennst Muster im Kundenfeedback und bringst aktiv Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.

Tech-curious and hands-on. Du hast Lust, dich technisch einzuarbeiten, Dinge selbst auszuprobieren und Probleme pragmatisch zu lösen, statt sie direkt weiterzugeben.

Who We Don’t Want

Escalates instead of thinking it through.
Du eskalierst jedes Problem sofort, statt selbst mitzudenken, zu analysieren und Lösungen zu finden.

Struggles in fast-paced environments.
Du tust dich in schnelllebigen Startup- oder SMB-Umfeldern schwer und verwaltest Probleme lieber, statt sie pragmatisch zu lösen.

Low ownership on difficult cases.
Du gibst Verantwortung bei schwierigen Fällen oder Eskalationen lieber ab, statt sie zu übernehmen.

Focused on tickets, not outcomes.
Du fokussierst dich stärker auf Ticket-Status und Prozesse als auf echte Kundenergebnisse und eine starke Customer Experience.

Copy-pastes standard answers.
Du greifst auf Standardantworten zurück, statt Kund:innen individuell und lösungsorientiert zu helfen.

Your Day To Day

Operational & Customer Contact (ca. 80%)

  • Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen im Live-Chat und hilfst ihnen dabei, Herausforderungen schnell und pragmatisch zu lösen. Deinen Tag startest du gemeinsam mit dem Team um 9:00 Uhr beim Daily Check-in, bevor du ab 10:00 Uhr die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen im Live-Chat übernimmst.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, um komplexe Supportfälle effizient zu eskalieren und eine starke Customer Experience sicherzustellen.
  • Du unterstützt Kund:innen aus verschiedensten Branchen und Märkten dabei, Superchat erfolgreich und reibungslos zu nutzen.

Process Optimisation & Feedback (ca. 20%)

  • Du kollaborierst mit verschiedenen Abteilungen wie Sales, Product und Success, um Support-Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern und weiter aufzubauen
  • Du identifizierst aus Kundenfeedback Produktverbesserungen und priorisierst diese mit dem Produktteam
  • Du arbeitest aktiv am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres AI-gestützten Support-Bots mit, um unsere Customer Experience effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten

Stakeholders

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch
Customer Support Team: für Eskalationen, Troubleshooting und gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch
Product & Engineering: bei Bugs, technischen Sonderfällen und Produktfeedback aus dem direkten Kundenkontakt
Customer Success: für onboardingbezogene Support-Themen und die Koordination gemeinsamer Kund:innen
Sales: für relevanten Kundenkontext und Übergaben bei Bedarf

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - wenig Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität Unternehmen besser macht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerber:innen. Unabhängig von Gender, Herkunft, Nationalität oder Glaube. Fühl dich frei und schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung!

Mit deiner Bewerbung stimmst du unseren Datenschutzrichtlinien zu.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Data & AI Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du sprichst mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management unserer Kunden, strukturierst Anforderungen und leitest daraus ein Zielbild für ihre Daten- und KI-Landschaft ab.

  • Du entwirfst hybride Architekturen, in denen SAP-Daten (SAP BW, SAP Business Data Cloud) und Nicht-SAP-Plattformen wie Microsoft Fabric oder Databricks zusammenspielen. Ziel ist eine gemeinsame Datenbasis ohne doppelte Datenhaltung.

  • Du bewertest Plattformen und Architekturvarianten herstellerunabhängig und bereitest die Entscheidung für den Kunden vor.

  • Du planst Migrationspfade, etwa von SAP BW in die SAP Business Data Cloud, und erarbeitest Architekturleitlinien einschließlich der Kostensicht (FinOps).

  • Du konzipierst Integrationsmuster und die ersten Datenprodukte und validierst sie mit dem Kunden in einem PoC oder MVP.

  • Du modellierst fachliche Semantik: Kennzahlen, Begriffe und ihre Beziehungen. Du legst sie als Semantic Layer oder Ontologie technologieunabhängig ab, sodass SAP- und Nicht-SAP-Plattformen sie gleichermaßen nutzen.

  • Du entwirfst den Context Layer, über den KI-Anwendungen und Agenten verlässlich an Daten und fachlichen Kontext kommen, und legst die Schnittstellen für die Agenten fest.

  • Du prüfst, ob die Datenlandschaft eines Kunden für die geplanten KI-Vorhaben trägt, und zeigst die Lücken auf.

  • Du baust mit uns ein neues Angebot rund um Semantik, Kontext und Agentenarchitektur auf, von der Methodik bis zum ersten Kundenprojekt.

  • Du übergibst Zielbild und Leitlinien an unsere Engineering-CCs und begleitest die Umsetzung als Architekt:in.

  • Du profitierst von Lernformaten, Mentoring und internen Sessions und bringst mit der Zeit eigene Inhalte ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrung (ca. 2–3 Jahre) in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-&-Analytics-Lösungen.

  • Du kennst dich in SAP-Datenlandschaften aus (SAP BW, SAP Datasphere oder SAP Business Data Cloud) und hast erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric oder Databricks. Wenn du von der Nicht-SAP-Seite kommst, bringst du die Bereitschaft mit, dich in SAP einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung (3NF, Data Vault, Star Schema) und Integrationsmustern.

  • Du interessierst dich für KI-Architektur, Semantik und Agenten und verfolgst, was sich dort tut.

  • Von Vorteil: Du hast Erfahrung mit Semantic Layern, Ontologien oder Knowledge Graphs (z. B. RDF/OWL, Neo4j) oder hast KI-Anwendungen an Unternehmensdaten angebunden, etwa über RAG, MCP oder Agenten-Frameworks.

  • Du denkst lieber in Zielbildern und Alternativen als in einem einzigen Werkzeug.

  • Du denkst analytisch, handelst eigenverantwortlich und kommunizierst souverän gegenüber Kolleg:innen und Kunden.

  • Verhandlungssichere (C-Niveau) Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Deine Perspektive

title: Data Science
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We're hiring full stack data scientists who love to get into the nitty gritty of the domain, have an instinct for commercial value, and own the entire process from data exploration to production.

  • Developing a deep understanding of energy markets, grid dynamics, and trading strategies

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

title: Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek
descriptionHtml:
Je bent recent afgestudeerd van een bèta / kwantitatieve opleiding, bent statistisch goed onderlegd en je hebt ook al enige ervaring opgedaan met R, SPSS en/of Python en op zoek naar een mogelijkheid om je eerste stappen in de wereld van Data te zetten. Wij hebben dan een erg gave uitdaging in de aanbieding waarin je je kunt ontwikkelen binnen een publieke omgeving waarin je met onderzoek data het verschil kunt maken binnen maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Als Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek werk je binnen een team wat zich richt op beleidsonderzoek en informatie binnen de verschillende domeinen van een lokale overheidsinstelling. Dit team verzamelt statistische informatie over het stedelijk gebied en voert uiteenlopende onderzoeken uit: van snelle opiniepeilingen tot diepgaande data-analyses en dashboards. Jij speelt hierbij een centrale rol: je beheert databanken, ontwikkelt dashboards, ondersteunt grootschalige enquêtes, en zorgt dat data toegankelijk én begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt voor collega’s en beleidsmakers. Je werkt met tools als R, SPSS, Python en Tableau, en krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise in data, visualisatie en statistiek volop te ontwikkelen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Met deze opdracht binnen het Data & Analytics traineeship geef jij jouw carrière een vliegende start! In twee jaar tijd behaal je waardevolle certificaten, volg je boeiende trainingen op ons gezellige kantoor in Bunnik, én werk je aan uitdagende projecten bij één van onze opdrachtgevers.

Tijdens het eerste jaar ligt de focus op jouw ontwikkeling als professional én als persoon. In de eerste twee weken duik je met andere trainees ons kantoor in, waar je trainingen volgt in zowel soft als hard skills. Daarna ga je aan de slag bij je opdrachtgever. In het tweede jaar werk je samen met ons aan een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan dat helemaal is afgestemd op jouw ambities.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een vliegende start als Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek via een tweejarig traineeship boordevol trainingen, masterclasses, certificaten en praktijkervaring

Dit vragen wij van jou:

title: DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit) - London
descriptionHtml:
DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit)

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (HFT), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge



The role
About Credit Desk

In our Credit & On-Chain Liquidity team, we design strategies and deploy capital across decentralized lending protocols, managed vaults, and credit facilities. Operating at the intersection of quantitative finance and smart contract technolgy, the Credit Desk is responsible for optimizing yield, evaluating counterparty and protocol risk, and deploying programmatic credit solutions across digital asset markets. As a Credit Desk DeFi Quant Trader Intern, you will work directly with quant traders and credit strategists to build quantitative risk models, automate yield harvesting, analyze on-chain liquidity pools, and evaluate DeFi protocol mechanics.

Key Responsibilities of a DeFi Quant Trader intern in this unit

  • On-Chain Risk & Credit Modeling: Develop and refine quantitative risk models to assess protocol health, collateralization ratios, liquidation risks, and smart contract vulnerability exposure across DeFi credit platforms.

  • Yield Optimization & Execution: Build Python-based tools and algorithmic models to analyze real-time yield curves, liquidity pool depth, and funding rate arbitrage across lending and borrowing protocols.

  • Data Analytics & Monitoring: Query on-chain data, EVM event logs, and lending protocol data using SQL, Subgraphs, and Python to generate actionable insights for credit positioning and risk allocation.

  • Protocol Due Diligence & Forensics: Perform quantitative forensics and stress testing on emerging lending primitives, liquid staking protocols, and structured credit products prior to capital deployment.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Skills: Strong code-first foundation in Python, familiarity with Rust with Solidity as a plus. Understanding of smart contract mechanics and DeFi primitive mathemtaics (including propAMMs, lending pool utilization curves, liquidation thresholds).

  • Quantitative & Trading Mindset: Rigorous background in a quantitative field (Math, Physics, CS, Finance, or Engineering) with a systematic/trading mindset. Ability to model yield dynamics, credit risk, backtesting strategies, and protocol insolvency scenarios.

  • DeFi “Skin in the Game”: Hands-on experience interacting with decentralized lending protocols (e.g., Aave, Morpho, Compound, Maker/Endgame), yield aggregators, or credit markets.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Familiarity with Rust, Solidity, Foundry, or specialized credit risk models and backtesting frameworks.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

https://keyrock.com/careers/
