title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
descriptionHtml:
Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière. Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision, une stratégie claire, et une gouvernance solide. Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte.
Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer
pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents,
composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent
d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable.
Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence.
Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit
vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow
sans friction.
How we work together 🤝
  • Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes.
  • Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production.
  • Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits.
  • Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs.
  • Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme

    • How we get work done 🚀
  • Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme.
  • Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation.
  • Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code.
  • Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement.
  • Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes.
  • Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités

    • How our work creates impact 🎯
  • Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction
  • Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables
  • Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite
  • Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant
  • Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence

    • Compétences 💼
  • Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes.
  • Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions.
  • Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS.
  • IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS.
  • Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue.
  • Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders.
  • Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage.
  • Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral

    • Qualités 🌟
  • Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA
  • Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent.
  • Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes.
  • Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants.
  • Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client.
  • Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design

    • Expérience 📇
  • Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un
    rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior
  • Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle, pas
    seulement contribué à l'un
  • Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des
    intégrations design to code
  • Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative, dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma
    Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent)
  • Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne
    lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design.
  • Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de
    delivery.

    • Ce que nous offrons 🎊
  • Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues
  • De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences
  • Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé
  • Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.
  • Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).
  • Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

    • Les étapes du process 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement
  • L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers
  • Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions
  • Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc.
  • Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝
    • Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

title: DevOps, Core Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

We are building software infrastructure to power AI development and delivery for operational use cases in defense. Our software needs to run in customers' data centers, on their hardware, often with no internet connection. You will own the continuous deployment of our software in these environments. That covers installations, upgrades with no downtime, and keeping track of dependencies between the services that make up the software.

This role involves hands-on coding. You will join the core platform team, with broad ownership and a direct effect on real defense deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Delivery: Take a change from a commit in CI to a running system on a customer site, and keep every step repeatable.

  • Safe upgrades: Roll out upgrades step by step with no downtime, watch the system as it changes, and stop and alert the team automatically when something goes wrong.

  • Disconnected sites: Make installs and upgrades work with no internet, using signed, self-contained packages.

  • Release checks: Work on the release system that checks that all our services work together, in CI and at release time.

descriptionHtml:
Dein Team

Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen. Du bekommst dabei nicht nur ein Team, sondern Rückenwind für deine Ideen, Raum zum Ausprobieren und Menschen, die mit dir aus einer guten Idee etwas Besonderes machen. Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leuten zu arbeiten, die genauso viel vorhaben wie du: Willkommen bei der fino data services.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns verantwortest

Security Monitoring im Tagesgeschäft

  • Du überwachst täglich und hands-on unsere Security-Dashboards und hast den Sicherheitsstatus unserer Systeme jederzeit im Blick.

  • Du erkennst Auffälligkeiten frühzeitig, bewertest sie und leitest selbst die nötigen Schritte ein, statt sie nur weiterzugeben.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards, Alerts und Kennzahlen weiter, damit relevante Signale nicht im Rauschen untergehen.

  • Im Ernstfall behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest Sicherheitsvorfälle strukturiert ab.

Sicherheit in der Pipeline

  • Du verankerst Sicherheitsprüfungen fest in unseren CI/CD-Pipelines, von statischer Code-Analyse (SAST) über dynamische Tests (DAST) bis zur Prüfung von Abhängigkeiten (SCA).

  • Du wählst die passenden Werkzeuge aus und legst fest, welche Befunde einen Build stoppen. So schützt Sicherheit unsere Teams, statt sie auszubremsen.

  • Du bewertest Schwachstellen nach ihrem tatsächlichen Risiko und sorgst dafür, dass das Wichtige zuerst erledigt wird.

Software-Lieferkette & Infrastruktur

  • Du sicherst unsere Software-Lieferkette ab: Abhängigkeiten, Build-Artefakte und Container-Images werden nachvollziehbar dokumentiert (SBOM) und signiert.

  • Du bringst unser Secrets Management auf ein sauberes Niveau: Passwörter, Zertifikate und API-Schlüssel gehören in einen Tresor, nicht in den Code.

  • Du härtest Container- und Cloud-Umgebungen, vergibst Rechte nach dem Least-Privilege-Prinzip und erkennst Fehlkonfigurationen, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Du schreibst Sicherheitsregeln als Code fest und setzt sie automatisiert durch (Policy as Code).

Security-Kultur & Compliance

  • Du führst gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungsteams Threat Modelings durch, schulst und baust Security Champions auf.

  • Du unterstützt die technische Umsetzung und den Nachweis der Anforderungen unserer ISO-Zertifizierung.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass auch KI-generierter Code und KI-Agenten sicher in unsere Prozesse eingebunden sind, und behältst regulatorische Anforderungen wie den Cyber Resilience Act im Blick.

Qualifikation

  • Ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä., eine IT-Ausbildung (z. B. in der Fachinformatik) oder einen vergleichbaren Weg. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst.

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in Softwareentwicklung, DevOps oder Plattformbetrieb: Du hast selbst Code geschrieben und Systeme betrieben.

  • Fundiertes Security-Know-how: OWASP Top 10 in der Praxis, Threat Modeling, Cloud- und Container-Security.

  • Erfahrung im aktiven Security Monitoring: Du arbeitest gern täglich mit Dashboards, Logs und Alerts und gehst Auffälligkeiten selbst auf den Grund.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD (z. B. GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions), Docker und Kubernetes sowie Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform).

  • Sicher in mindestens einer Programmier- oder Skriptsprache wie Python, Go oder Bash; Erfahrung mit Elixir/Phoenix ist ein Plus.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Tools wie Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, HashiCorp Vault, Sigstore oder OPA sowie Zertifizierungen wie CKS.

  • Überzeugen statt anordnen: Du erklärst unseren Entwicklungsteams, warum der Build rot ist, und dem Management, welches Risiko im nächsten Release steckt.

  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten, auch wenn hunderte Befunde offen sind.

  • Sprachen: sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig an unseren Teamtagen teilzunehmen.

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

Klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Unterstützung:
Bei uns weißt du genau, was von dir erwartet wird, und du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Fehler als wertvolle Lernchancen betrachtet werden.

Gemeinschaftliches Engagement für außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse:
Unser Team strebt leidenschaftlich nach Spitzenleistungen und sieht deinen Beitrag als unverzichtbar an. Gemeinsam erreichen wir Großartiges.

Individuelle Entwicklung und Selbstverantwortung:
Wir fördern Selbstmotivation und deine persönliche Verantwortung, um herausragende Leistungen zu erzielen.

Dynamisches Feedback für kontinuierliches Lernen:
Bei uns erhältst du direktes und zeitnahes Feedback, damit du schnell auf Veränderungen reagieren und dich kontinuierlich verbessern kannst.

Offene Kommunikation und persönliche Entwicklung:
Wir leben offene Kommunikation und unterstützen dich aktiv bei der Gestaltung deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Lösungsorientierung und Unternehmenserfolg im Fokus:
Unser Ziel ist es, Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die das Unternehmen voranbringen. Dein Engagement für diesen Erfolg wird bei uns hoch geschätzt.

Teamtage, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern: Gemeinsame Events für Teamspirit und Freude am Arbeitsplatz

Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area.  This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases.

The successful candidate’s primary role will be one of the clinical study leads working on the plasminogen program transitioning from Phase 2 to Phase 3. The Director will report directly into the program clinical development strategy lead who provides the clinical research oversight of the program. The Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence of his/her clinical trial(s). This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. The Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & Quality Assurance teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. The Director will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.

  • Be a subject matter expert for the relevant disease area(s)
  • Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical program
  • Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts towards global regulatory approvals
  • Oversight of trial conduct and safety
  • Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans.
  • Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables.
  • Supervise closely all major written deliverables (regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials.
  • Be responsible for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, investigator brochures, and informed consent forms.
  • Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion

Qualifications

A highly driven, dynamic, engaged and accomplished physician-scientist with experience and insight will thrive in this role. Specific qualifications include:

  • MD with strong research background or MD PhD with best of class clinical and/or research training as shown through research support and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training in hematology is desirable
  • 3+ years industry experience or equivalent clinical academic research experience

title: Director of Client Growth - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Lead Conveo's Client Growth function: build and coach the team that makes our biggest clients wildly successful with AI-moderated research, and own growth across the whole client portfolio.

The context: AI moderation is changing what research can do - qual depth at quant scale, in days rather than months. The question our biggest clients now ask is no longer "does AI moderation work?" but "what can we do now that was never possible before?" Conveo works with brands like Unilever, Google and P&G to not only conduct research, but make decisions across their marketing, product and customer strategy. Our client base is growing fast and you'll lead the Client Growth team across enterprise accounts: setting how we onboard, drive adoption, renew and expand, and stepping in personally on our largest and most strategic clients. You'll partner with Sales on expansion and big deals, Product on what clients need next, Marketing on advocacy, and the Research Impact team on the hardest client problems. This is a player-coach role: you lead and grow the team while staying close to our most important clients.

Your mission

  1. Build and lead a high-performing Client Growth team - hire, coach and develop Client Growth Managers across Europe and the US; set clear goals and a strong operating rhythm; raise the bar on how we deliver value to our clients.

  2. Become the trusted insight partner our biggest clients call first - be the expert in AI-moderated research; own executive relationships up to C-suite; lead strategic reviews and QBRs; show them what AI moderation makes possible; partner with Sales to turn a first study into a multi-year, multi-team partnership.

  3. Build the Client Growth playbook - own own retention, adoption and expansion across all accounts; set targets, build account plans with the team, and spot risk and expansion early.onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion motions, health metrics and reporting that scale as we grow, with AI making the team faster.

  4. Be the voice of the client inside Conveo - bring client needs into Product's roadmap, and work with Marketing on advocacy, references and case studies.

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in client success, account management, consulting or a similar client-facing role, including 3+ years leading teams

  • A track record of growing enterprise accounts: retention, adoption and expansion against clear targets

  • Experience hiring, coaching and developing client-facing teams, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS company

  • Comfort with research and insights work and conviction about AI moderation; deep research expertise is a plus, not a requirement

  • Extensive C-suite stakeholder experience

  • A charismatic presenter and leader

  • Strong commercial instinct: comfortable owning renewals, expansion and forecasts alongside Sales

Mindset: player-coach who leads from the front; high agency, low ego; startup energy; creative and inventive; rigorous without being rigid; AI-native.

Nice to have: experience building a client success or account management function at an early-stage company; network among insight leaders at major brands; a research or insights background.

Success at 6-12 months: the team hired, onboarded and running with clear goals; retention and expansion targets met across the portfolio; every major client knows you by name; direct role in several of our largest expansions; a Client Growth playbook the team uses day to day; client needs visibly shaping the Product roadmap.

Why join us

At Conveo, you’ll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That’s why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

Plus

  • Play a defining role at a fast-growing, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Sell to and grow some of the world’s most iconic brands.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

  • Opportunities to travel globally and build real relationships with customers shaping the future.

  • We actively build a team where different backgrounds and viewpoints make us better.

Compensation: £88K – £168K • Offers Equity

title: Director, Technical Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
• Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads.

  • Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software for customers with demanding AI requirements.

  • As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions to provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant.

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing with deep, hands-on knowledge of AI infrastructure, GPU compute and datacenters to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

The role in brief

  • An embedded role, close to the product, close to engineering, and close to what we are building: end-to-end datacenters purpose-built for large-scale GPU compute and AI model training and inference.

  • You will spend time with infrastructure, datacenter design and operations, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships and the leadership team.

  • You will extract the technical truth from the building (power and cooling design, GPU cluster architecture, networking fabric, how customers train and serve models) and identify what is differentiated.

  • You will turn that into blogs, web pages, whitepapers, case studies, executive thought leadership, speaking narratives and product storytelling.

What this role is not

  • Not a conventional PMM role centred only on launch checklists, personas and sales decks. Our audience is hyperfocused and well understood.

  • Not a technical writing role.

The right person

  • Technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer.

  • Deeply technical in data centers / AI factories and AI infrastructure.

  • Understands GPU and accelerator architectures, how frontier models are trained and served, and what those workloads demand of power, cooling, networking and physical design.

  • Knows how to sit with engineers, ask good questions, pressure-test claims, and translate complex infrastructure into language that is accurate, compelling and useful.

What You'll Do

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our GPU platform, infrastructure, datacenter footprint and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to understand what we build, how it works, what problems it solves and why it is different, from site, power and thermal design through to GPU cluster performance and model workload efficiency.

  • Translate that into positioning, messaging, product explanations and technical narratives for customers, partners, analysts, executives and the broader market.

  • The questions you'll be asking:

    • Why did we build this this way?

    • What breaks at scale: power density, liquid cooling, GPU interconnect, cluster utilisation?

    • What tradeoff did we avoid?

    • What is genuinely differentiated, and what is defensible?

    • What should a technical buyer, such as a model builder or hyperscaler infrastructure lead, care about?

Technical Content & Thought Leadership

  • Create the core technical content that gives hyperscaler and AI lab customers confidence that Radiant is who they should trust to run their most demanding GPU workloads.

  • Formats include:

    • Technical blog posts, product pages and solution pages

    • Whitepapers and reference architecture content (GPU cluster design, high-density rack deployments, liquid cooling, power architecture)

    • Case studies and customer stories

    • Launch narratives and technical explainers

    • Executive essays and long-form thought leadership

  • Make complex topics understandable without making them simplistic.

  • Write for technical buyers, ML and infrastructure engineers, datacenter engineers, business decision-makers, partners, investors and industry observers, adjusting the level of detail without losing credibility.

Web & Product Copy

  • Help shape the language on Radiant's website and product pages.

  • Turn internal product reality into strong external copy that covers:

    • What the product does and who it is for

    • Why it matters and how it is different

    • The proof points that support the claim (GPU performance, power efficiency, capacity, deployment speed)

  • Work with design, web, product and marketing teams to create pages that are clear, technically grounded and commercially useful.

Speaking & Executive Substance

  • Create the technical spine behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, executive posts and strategic narratives across the AI and datacenter industry calendar.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. You provide the substance: the thesis, the architecture, the proof points, the technical argument, the story arc and the language.

  • Ghostwrite for corporate and executive voices where content needs technical depth, product understanding or strategic market framing, on topics such as GPU generations, AI compute supply, power availability and model scaling.

  • Be public-facing yourself: an excellent communicator with a credible presence in the datacenter and AI infrastructure community, able to hold your own on stage and in a room of engineers and AI researchers.

Case Studies, Customer Stories & Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner and product proof.

  • Work with sales, solutions, customer teams, GPU and hardware partners, and leadership to identify strong stories.

  • Turn them into case studies, web copy, blogs, presentations and sales-supporting narratives.

  • Find the real story behind each account:

    • What problem existed

    • What was deployed (compute, cooling, power, network)

    • What changed for the customer's models and workloads

    • What was hard, what mattered, and what the market should learn from it

Internal Translation

  • Act as a bridge between engineering, datacenter operations, product, sales, marketing and leadership.

  • Engineers should trust you because you ask good questions and represent the technology accurately, down to the GPU, the rack and the megawatt.

  • Marketing should trust you because you can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling language.

  • Sales should trust you because your work helps customers understand why Radiant matters.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Strong working relationships built with product and engineering.

  • A clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture, GPU platform, datacenter design and product priorities.

  • A meaningful set of market-facing assets shipped.

  • A repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organisation and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs and longer-form assets.

Over time

  • Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice and is recognised as a leading voice in AI infrastructure and datacenters.

  • The website explains the product more clearly.

  • Our blogs are technical, differentiated, and read by the people who build and run AI at scale.

Who You Are

Experience and technical depth

  • 8–12+ years in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing or a closely related role, with a substantial part of that in AI infrastructure, GPU compute or datacenters.

  • A background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters or high-performance computing.

  • Deep technical AI experience (essential): you understand how GPUs and accelerators work, how models are trained and served, and how those workloads drive compute, networking, power and cooling design. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You know datacenters from the inside: power density, liquid and air cooling, electrical and mechanical design, capacity planning and build-out, with a visible presence or network in the datacenter community.

  • Technically fluent enough to work directly with product managers, engineers, architects, ML practitioners, datacenter engineers and technical executives. You don't need to be an engineer, but you understand complex systems, from GPU interconnects and cluster topology to the power and thermal envelope of a hall.

  • You keep up with the market: GPU roadmaps, model releases and datacenter developments, and you can explain what each new generation means for infrastructure.

Writing and judgment

  • An excellent writer who can produce product pages, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, executive essays, launch narratives and technical explainers on GPU infrastructure, AI models and datacenter design with minimal handholding.

  • Strong product judgment: you can distinguish a feature from a benefit, a claim from a proof point, a capability from a differentiated position, and a generic AI market trend from a useful point of view.

  • Strong editorial taste: you know when copy is too generic, too inflated, too shallow or too complicated, and can make technical content sharper without making it flashy or imprecise.

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working in the building: regular face time with product, engineering and leadership is part of the job, as is time on site in our datacenters.

  • Highly autonomous: you don't wait for perfect briefs. You find the right people, ask the right questions, create the draft, pressure-test the claims and move the work forward.

  • Commercially aware: you understand that technical marketing exists to help the market understand the company, help customers evaluate the product, help sales tell the story, help executives communicate clearly, and help the company build credibility in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

Ideal Background

  • Where you've worked: high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, GPU cloud / neocloud providers, hyperscale and colocation datacenter operators, AI model companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems (particularly GPU and accelerator vendors), or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

  • Strongly preferred: experience working with engineers, architects, ML researchers, datacenter design teams, product leaders, founders or technical executives.

  • Required: experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences, specifically on GPU compute, AI models and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Strong advantage: a track record of speaking, publishing or being visibly active in the AI infrastructure or datacenter community.

To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

title: Duitssprekende recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Vacature: Recruiter bij PhysioMatch
Locatie: Regio Groningen |
Fulltime/Parttime

Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging?
Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste recruiter die ons team
komt versterken!

Wil jij zorgprofessionals begeleiden naar hun droombaan in Zwitserland? Ben
jij communicatief sterk en spreek je vloeiend Duits? Dan gaan we graag met jou
in gesprek.

Lees verder en ontdek of deze kans jouw volgende stap kan zijn. Misschien
word jij binnenkort onze nieuwe collega.

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

  • Tijdens het intakegesprek informeer je de kandidaat over de mogelijkheden die
    Zwitserland biedt en bespreek je uitgebreid hun wensen en verwachtingen.

  • Samen met het team selecteer je de best passende opdrachtgevers bij je
    kandidaten en je stelt deze voor.

  • Regelmatig heb je contact met je opdrachtgevers om op de hoogte te blijven
    van hun wensen en behoeften.

  • Je bouwt een band op met de kandidaten door ze zorgvuldig te begeleiden in
    het emigratieproces.

  • Je denkt mee over de marketing en werving van zorgprofessionals zoals
    fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen.

  • Je schrijft vacatureteksten

  • Je bezoekt circa een keer per jaar zorginstellingen in Zwitserland om bestaande relaties te
    onderhouden.

Vereisten

Jij brengt mee:

  • Geen ervaring nodig, je wordt goed ingewerkt. Fouten maken mag!

  • Actieve werkhouding, je pakt makkelijk de telefoon.

  • Gezelligheid: interesse in collega's, klanten en kandidaten.

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau. Pré: ervaring met fysiotherapie.

  • Woonachtig in Groningen of omgeving.

  • Vloeiende beheersing van de Duitse taal (B2/C1 niveau).

  • Goede kennis van Engels en redelijke kennis van Nederlands, extra talen zijn
    mooi meegenomen.

  • Pré: werkervaring in de zorg.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

  • Actief en gezellig team met een moderne werkomgeving.

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk.

  • Gezellige teamuitjes en trips naar Zwitserland.

  • Werklaptop, telefoon en een goed gevulde koelkast.

  • Goed salaris.

  • Een baan voor langere tijd.

Interesse?

Extra info over PhysioMatch:

PhysioMatch is gespecialiseerd in het bemiddelen van zorgprofessionals, zoals
fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen, voor diverse instellingen
in Zwitserland. We zorgen voor de ideale match tussen professionals en
zorginstellingen, waarbij we de nadruk leggen op persoonlijke
begeleiding.

Een voorbeeld van een dag bij PhysioMatch:

Elke dag is anders bij PhysioMatch, maar er is altijd een goede mix van
focus, teamwork, en zelfstandigheid.

08:30 - Begin van de werkdag
Je pakt een bak heet water met een smaakje en checkt je e-mails en agenda ter voorbereiding op de dagstart.

09:00 - Dagstart
Het team komt samen voor de dagelijkse meeting. Eerst kletsen we uitgebreid bij en dan worden de prioriteiten van de dag besproken en de sollicitanten verdeeld.

09:30 - Vacatureteksten en werving
Na de meeting ga je
aan de slag met het schrijven en plaatsen van vacatures in het Duits, Engels en
Nederlands.

11:00 - Sollicitatiegesprek
Je voert een online
sollicitatiegesprek met een therapeut die geïnteresseerd is in een functie in
Zwitserland. Je bespreekt de wensen en geeft info over het proces.

12:00 - Lunchpauze
Tijd om te ontspannen en samen met
collega's te lunchen. Na de lunch maken we een wandeling, wat zorgt voor een
frisse start van de middag.

13:00 - Administratie en opvolging
Je werkt de
administratie bij, volgt sollicitaties op en neemt contact op met kandidaten en
zorginstellingen. Je plant sollicitatiegesprekken in voor de komende dagen.

14:30 - Bezoek voorbereiding
Samen met het team bespreek
je de aankomende trip naar Zwitserland om zorginstellingen te bezoeken. We
bespreken de planning en welke locaties we bezoeken.

16:00 - Evaluatie en afronding
Aan het einde van de dag
werk je nog een paar actiepunten af, stuur je e-mails en noteer je taken voor de
volgende dag. Je sluit de dag af met een korte informele uitwisseling met
collega's.

E-commerce Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the E-commerce Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

title: Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. With FALU PMAS, our cloud based production monitoring and assistance system, every machine reports its state every five seconds. Customers get live dashboards, shift KPIs, downtime analytics and automatic alerts in the browser. The first customer went live in September 2026 with eight machines, and more plants are lined up.

The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.

This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.

Tasks

You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:

PLC and machine side

  • Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.
  • Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
  • Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
  • Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Edge devices and site gateway

  • Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
  • Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.
  • Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to "visible in the dashboard" in under an hour.
  • Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.

Broker and data contract

  • Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
  • Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.

Commissioning and support

  • Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
  • Act as second line when "the dashboard shows nothing" or "the numbers look wrong" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
  • Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.

Requirements

Must have

  • Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
  • Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
  • Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
  • Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
  • MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools is a hard requirement. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or comparable tools every day, you write and maintain project instructions for them, you review their output critically, and you are measurably faster with them than without. Our code and documentation are written with and for these tools. If you see AI tools as optional, this role is not for you.
  • Working proficiency in English (all code, commits and documentation are in English). German is a plus for the machine side.
  • Willingness to travel to customer plants, typically a few days per quarter.
  • Availability of at least two days per week on a permanent basis, with the option to scale up during rollouts.
  • You work as a freelancer (own company or registered self employed) and can invoice FALU AG.

Nice to have

  • OPC UA, Snap7 or the Siemens open communication libraries.
  • Node-RED, Docker on ARM, Ansible or similar fleet tooling.
  • Machine building or commissioning experience: reading electrical schematics, 24 V control cabinet basics, HMI (WinCC).
  • Administration of HiveMQ, Mosquitto or EMQX.
  • A basic understanding of what happens after the broker (Node.js services, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), so that you can talk to the cloud side at eye level.

Benefits

  • A clearly bounded, business critical scope with a colleague who knows the system and hands over properly. No cold start.
  • A running production system with a real customer, not a greenfield slide deck.
  • AI assisted development is how we work, not an experiment. You get the tools and the budget for them.
  • Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
  • Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
  • A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.
  • Fast, uncomplicated invoicing and decisions from a small team.

If you have ever made a stubborn PLC talk to the cloud and have capacity to do it again with us, we would like to hear from you.

Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, your daily rate and availability, one paragraph about a PLC to cloud integration you built or fixed and what went wrong on the way, and one concrete example of how you use AI tools in your daily engineering work.

What to expect: a short call with Marc Wyss (CEO) within a week of your application, then a small practical task with a simulated PLC data source, a Raspberry Pi image and a broker endpoint. We look at how you work, not just at the result. After that, one conversation with our integration engineer and the team, then a decision and a contract.

title: Emerging Account Executive - London

We are looking for a passionate sales professional for our EMEA region with 1-3 years of experience in a customer facing role selling SaaS or consulting, not necessarily in the security and compliance space. Exceptional candidates are hungry to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and have a proven track record of success in their past roles and experiences.

title: Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

  • The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently

  • If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice

descriptionHtml:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Payments engineering team within the E-commerce department. Payments takes, refunds and reconciles customer money across our white-label booking sites, subscriptions and in-person sales points, integrating with providers such as Adyen, PayPal and Checkout.com. Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable.


You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it.

What you will do:

  • Lead several engineering teams, working through tech leads to set direction, priorities and delivery across them.

  • Hire, coach and grow senior engineers and future leaders. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales.

  • Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response.

  • Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees.

  • Partner with White Label, Orders, Finance and Data teams on checkout, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation and the payment ledger.

  • Stay close to system design and architecture of our event-driven services (Ruby, Kafka), and set the technical bar across your teams.

  • Raise the bar on ownership: documentation, runbooks, observability and on-call.

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering across your teams: coding agents, AI code review, test generation and documentation. Measure which practices improve delivery and quality.

  • Define safe guardrails for AI use where money moves: human review, test coverage and auditability stay non-negotiable.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.



Who you are:

  • An experienced Engineering Manager who has led multiple teams or a team of senior engineers.

  • Required: hands-on background in payments. You've built or run payment systems in production, including PSP integrations, refunds and chargebacks, reconciliation and recurring billing.

  • An engineer at heart, with experience in event-driven distributed systems (Kafka or similar) and strong skills in a modern backend language. Ruby is a plus.

  • You're comfortable working across teams and departments, and you communicate clearly in writing in English.

  • You use AI tools in your own day-to-day work, not just in theory. You've helped a team adopt them, and you can tell real productivity gains from hype.

    Nice to have: card-present/terminal payments, SEPA direct debit, multi-currency, travel or marketplace experience.


What you can expect:

descriptionHtml:
Curious Minds. Bold Ideas. Extraordinary Impact.

We're transforming financial services through bold innovation and relentless execution. You bring the ideas and drive. We'll build what's next — together.

As nCino's Enterprise Account Executive for Corporate Solutions, you'll be responsible for net-new sales to prospects and for driving expansion within our existing customer base.

You'll be selling beyond traditional banking and lending, into gaming, fintech and payments, and into the wider B2B market across a defined set of industries. You'll have a clear target account list, a structured sales process, and strong pre-sales and customer success support behind you. 

This role matters because it takes nCino's mission to new markets, and you'll have real room to grow as we build our presence in them.

You'll sell into two connected markets:

  • Regulated businesses that have to verify individuals. Gaming and gambling, fintech, payments and similar businesses are required by regulation to know who their customers are. The challenge is doing those KYC and anti money laundering checks quickly and reliably, without losing customers at sign up and without exposing the business to fraud or regulatory risk. You'll help these businesses get that right.
  • B2B businesses that need to find, check and onboard other businesses. Outside financial services, many companies still win and onboard business customers with too little information. They struggle to find the right companies to target, to know who really owns and controls them, and to check them before a contract is signed. You'll help sales and compliance teams find better prospects and onboard business customers with confidence, with fewer manual checks and less risk of fraud or bad debt.

Our priority industries on the B2B side are accountancy, tax and corporate services, telecoms and connectivity, legal services, and construction, infrastructure and supply chains. Wider opportunities sit in energy and utilities, commercial property, wholesale and distribution, and staffing and recruitment.

You don't need to know these sectors before you start. You do need to learn them quickly and talk about their problems credibly.

title: Finance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
MyEdSpace is an education technology platform that connects the best teachers on the planet with the students who need them the most - wherever they are, whatever their means.

Backed by $15m in Series A funding from some of the leading investors in the space, we're ready to scale - and we want you to help us build and scale MyEdSpace as part of a collaborative and ambitious team.

We're on a mission to make a world-class education accessible to all.

We believe that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of geography or socioeconomic background, to achieve their dreams and build a brighter future.

If you’re motivated by solving meaningful problems and creating real impact through your work on a societal level and make a real impact on the world - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Title: Finance Analyst

Location: London Office in Chancery Lane

What You’ll be Doing

  • You'll be a core part of a small finance function, reporting directly to the Finance Manager, with exposure to the leadership team, the board and our investors from early on

  • Success in this role looks like management reporting the business trusts, a close that runs to a predictable rhythm, and analysis that changes what leadership decides

  • Running our month end close to deliver management accounts that senior stakeholders can act on with confidence

  • Building and maintaining our budgeting, forecasting and cash flow processes to inform and underpin company strategy

  • Analysis and interpretation of business costs and performance against plan, providing insight throughout the business

  • Owning the finance operations that keep the company moving day to day, from payroll through to payments

  • Taking end to end responsibility for our year end audit, statutory reporting and compliance calendar

  • Preparing analysis and materials for the board and our investors, with the opportunity to take ownership of the financial model over time

  • Scanning the horizon for bottlenecks in the finance function before they arrive, and targeting them with better process and automation

  • Designing and embedding the controls and routines a scaling business needs, so the function can grow without growing headcount

  • Managing the relationships with the external partners who support our finance function

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong command of the fundamentals: financial statements, reporting, and the accounting that sits behind the numbers

  • One to three years at a Big 4 or another leading mid-tier firm, or in a finance team in industry, part qualified ACA or ACCA

  • Ambitious, and looking to develop and progress quickly in a fast growing company

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, with strong financial modelling ability and the capacity to turn financial data into clear, actionable insight

  • Commercially minded, and able to communicate complex financial movements clearly and concisely to people outside finance

  • An inquisitive approach to the day to day, with a desire to question and challenge the numbers and to understand the business behind them

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving ability, highly numerate, with a real drive for accuracy

  • A natural instinct to automate and improve rather than repeat

  • Comfortable operating in an ambiguous environment, managing changing and conflicting priorities

  • Strong organisational skills, with a proven record of meeting and beating deadlines

  • Experience of Xero or similar accounting software preferred; familiarity with data and reporting tools an advantage

  • Self motivated, able to work autonomously, and conscientious with it

✨ Our values

PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.

KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.

RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.

LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.

WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.

🙋 Why you’ll love working here

We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.

  • A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.

  • A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.

We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Finance & Strategy Senior Associate to join our London team. In this role, you’ll work with partners across Deliveroo to ensure we are making efficient, data-driven decisions that evaluate the effectiveness of our products and unlock new avenues for growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We accelerate the growth of our business by implementing new opportunities and solutions, partnering across the company to improve the profitability and scalability of our business model.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Consumer Product Impact: Evaluate the effectiveness of high-impact consumer products at scale and develop creative growth strategies.

  • Strategic Modelling: Build custom financial models tailored to specific business needs to improve high-stakes strategic decision-making.

  • Framework Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and processes in a fast-paced environment.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key business and financial KPIs, uncovering trends to assess risks and future opportunities.

  • Operational Scaling: Lead special projects to automate and scale reporting tools, investment frameworks, and cost-tracking methodologies.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic Finance Background: Significant experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within the high-growth technology sector.

  • Advanced Modelling Skills: High proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to build robust financial models and perform complex analyses.

  • Data Fluency: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large data sets and uncover hidden insights.

  • Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of budget management and the ability to partner with cross-functional teams to drive operational value.

  • Adaptability: Proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, evolving environment that values autonomy and ownership.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
