title: Finance Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance Data Scientist to join our central Data team as the first dedicated analytics partner to Finance. You'll turn billing, revenue and forecasting data into audit-ready numbers, and the analysis that shapes pricing and planning decisions as we scale towards IPO.

  • Own finance-facing analysis: revenue and ARR reconciliation, cohort and retention economics, pricing and packaging experiments.

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified finance KPI layer (ARR, billing, revenue), and be the first to catch when a number is quietly wrong.

  • Build forecasting and scenario models that FP&A uses directly in planning and board reporting.

  • Translate ambiguous finance questions from FP&A, RevOps and leadership into clear, reusable analysis.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist or analyst embedded with a Finance / FP&A function, ideally at a growth-stage or pre-IPO company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with comfort reconciling data across Stripe, Salesforce and a dbt-modelled warehouse.

  • Finance fluency: ARR, billing, revenue recognition, cohort economics — you can speak FP&A's language.

  • Rigour around data quality: you reconcile by default and can explain a variance, not just report it.

  • Strong stakeholder management with Finance leadership, and the ability to push back on ambiguous asks.

Bonus

  • Experience preparing finance data for audit, SOX or IPO readiness.

  • Experience with pricing / packaging experimentation or revenue forecasting at a subscription or usage-based business.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse (BigQuery), partnering directly with analytics engineers.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Lead Finance Data Scientist role as the central Data team scales.

  • Expand scope into broader strategic finance or RevOps analytics.

  • Path into a Head of FP&A Analytics or data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Financial Consultant (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Odoo DE GmbH

Odoo entwickelt eine Suite von Open-Source-Betriebsanwendungen, die Unternehmensprozesse von CRM und E-Commerce bis hin zu Buchhaltung und Lagerhaltung abdecken. Das Ziel ist es, einer der weltweit führenden Open-Source-Anbieter zu sein und Software bereitzustellen, die gleichzeitig einfach zu bedienen und voll integriert ist.

Deine Aufgaben als Financial Consultant

Als Financial Consultant liegt dein Fokus auf der digitalen Transformation im Rechnungswesen und der gezielten Beratung von Unternehmen im Finance-Bereich. Dabei analysierst du die Geschäftsprozesse der Kund:innen, bringst dein Fachwissen in die Prozessgestaltung ein und unterstützt gleichzeitig dabei, unser Produkt kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du begleitest Unternehmen bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Finanzprozesse und bist die treibende Kraft hinter der Optimierung unserer Accounting-Lösung. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du deine Kolleg:innen bei ihren Projekten und bist das Odoo-Gesicht auf Finance-Events, auf welchen du unseren Spirit nach außen trägst. 🚀

Wofür bist du verantwortlich?

  • Bedarfsanalyse & Konzeption: Du durchleuchtest bestehende Finanz- und Geschäftsabläufe unserer Kund:innen und entwirfst passgenaue Lösungskonzepte.

  • Beratung & Implementierung im Finanzbereich: Du betreust die Kund:innen, konfigurierst maßgeschneiderte Odoo-Lösungen und sorgst für reibungslose, automatisierte Abläufe im Rechnungswesen.

  • (Für einen optimalen Start in unsere Odoo-Welt steuerst du im Rahmen deines Onboardings zunächst einige ganzheitliche ERP-Projekte von A bis Z.)

  • Projektsteuerung: Du behältst Zeitplan und Budget fest im Blick, kommunizierst transparent den Projektstatus und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Go Live.

  • Repräsentation & Networking: Du vertrittst Odoo auf Messen, Finance Academies und Branchenevents und begeisterst das Fachpublikum für unsere Lösungen.

  • Business Development: Du bist für das Odoo Buchhaltungsfirmen-Programm zuständig: Du demonstrierst interessierten Buchhaltungsfirmen unsere Software und unterstützt sie direkt in Odoo bei der Live-Buchhaltung ihrer Mandanten.

  • Wissensaustausch & Coaching: Als interne Anlaufstelle für Accounting-Themen unterstützt du andere Business Analyst:innen in Finance-Themen. Zudem schulst du Kund:innen und Partner:innen.

  • Schnittstelle zum Produkt: Du bündelst das Feedback aus der Praxis und gibst wertvolle Impulse direkt an unsere Product Owner weiter.

Das bringst du mit

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen (z. B. Buchhaltung, Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung) und ein tiefes Verständnis für buchhalterische Zusammenhänge.

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, mit dem du nicht nur Zahlen verstehst, sondern auch übergreifende Geschäftsprozesse systematisch durchleuchtest und optimierst.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch und Englisch (mind. C1): Du schaffst es, komplexe finanzielle und technische Anforderungen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich zu übersetzen.

  • Hohe IT-Affinität und Spaß am Umgang mit moderner Software. (Erfahrung mit ERP- oder Accounting-Systemen ist ein großes Plus.)

  • Eine Hands-on-Mentalität, Lust auf Verantwortung und die Bereitschaft, ca. ein- bis zweimal im Monat zu Veranstaltungen zu reisenBenefits

Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

Deine Benefits

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.

  • Sachbezug oder Urban Sports: Mit deinen monatlichen 50 € hast du die Wahl: Lass dir das Guthaben flexibel auf eine Mastercard buchen oder entscheide dich alternativ für eine Urban Sports M-Mitgliedschaft.

  • Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.

  • Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.

  • Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.

  • Go Global - Austauschprogramm : Lust auf Auslandserfahrung? Nach 2 Jahren Odoo hast du die Möglichkeit dich an einen unserer weltweiten Standorte versetzen zu lassen.

  • Faires Gehalt: Wir spielen mit offenen Karten. Abhängig von deiner relevanten Berufserfahrung liegt das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Rolle zwischen 48.000-60.000€.

Das ist uns wichtig

Bei Odoo setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, inklusives und authentisches Arbeitsumfeld ein.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller oder Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen.

Du hast Lust auf die Stelle, aber dein Profil passt nicht zu 100%.
Bewirb dich trotzdem!Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diesen Job!

title: Fleet Administrator
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

As the Fleet Associate - Admin, you are the backbone of our vehicle operations. Your primary mission is to ensure that our fleet is fully compliant, legally documented, and that all vehicle related costs are accurately tracked. You are a highly organised administrator who thrives on keeping records up to date and resolving issues from insurance claims to parking fines with speed and precision.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Penalty Charge Notice (PCN) Management:

    Act as the primary lead for all incoming traffic fines and PCNs.

    • Identify the responsible driver for each contravention and raise the appropriate recoup charges in our internal systems.

    • Ensure all appeals or payments are actioned within the required legal timeframes to avoid late fees.

  • Insurance Claims Administration:

    • Coordinate the end-to-end administration for vehicle accidents and insurance claims.

    • Gather evidence, photos, and statements to submit to our insurers and follow up until each case is closed.

  • Vehicle Compliance & Documentation:

    • Maintain a "zero-error" digital archive for all vehicle documents, including V5Cs, MOTs, service records, insurance certificates and invoices.

    • Monitor expiration dates to ensure no vehicle is dispatched without valid tax, insurance, or safety certification.

  • Fleet Onboarding & Offboarding:

    • Manage the administrative workflow for bringing new vehicles into the fleet and removing decommissioned units.

    • Ensure all tracking hardware and vehicle specific documents are assigned or recovered correctly.

  • Communication & Inbox Management:

    • Oversee the fleet department’s central inbox, providing professional and timely responses to drivers, partners, and local authorities.

    • Act as the point of contact for external vendors regarding vehicle status and maintenance updates.

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • The Ultimate Organiser: You take pride in a clean inbox and a perfectly updated spreadsheet. You are someone who notices the smallest details that others might miss.

  • Effective Communicator: You can write clear, professional emails to local councils and handle firm but fair communication with drivers regarding fines or damages.

  • Resilient Administrator: You are comfortable managing a high volume of repetitive tasks and can stay focused on accuracy even during busy periods.

  • Tech-Literate: You are proficient with Google Sheets/Excel and are quick to learn new internal databases and fleet management software.

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

    • if you're on a 4 days on - 4 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 18 days paid holiday plus public holidays

    • similarly on 4 days on - 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Annual compensation review

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Dog friendly office and depots

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)


🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

  • HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

  • Read how HIVED raised $42M to transform parcel delivery with AI and all-electric logistics network

  • Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

  • Keep up with HIVED ✨here✨

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer intern in the PRO business unit, you will build the RevOps system (apps, API and MCP connectors, AI-ready data), embedded with the Sales and Marketing teams. You will:

  • Design and build systems that remove friction from the way we sell.
  • Make our data AI-ready and put it into the hands of tools, agents and sales reps.
  • Consolidate our tools into one AI Sales Studio.

You will work directly with our RevOps PRO, who guarantees the vision, the strategy and the RevOps system as a whole. He will coach you day to day: architecture choices, review of what you ship, and priorities. The goal is for you to own your scope quickly.

This is a 6-month internship (an internship agreement with your school is required)!


Your Impact at Brevo:
  1. AI-ready data:
  2. Standardise data ingestion with a guaranteed format designed for AI.
  3. Make that data available in our apps and tools, so AEs can use it easily.
  4. AI Sales Studio:
  5. Merge our existing custom apps into one tool and extend it with new features. One tool to rule them all.
  6. Connectors:
  7. Connect our tools through APIs and MCP (CRM, Chili Piper, Gong, Clay, Chargebee…) to remove re-keying and waiting between teams.
  8. Autonomous demand generation:
  9. Wire the lead scoring specified by the RevOps Analyst into our tools.
  10. Bring AEs new signals (intent, firmographics) and new sources, with prospecting tooling they use on their own.
  11. Lean system:
  12. Remove dead automations and duplicates, and put monitoring on what runs.

What will contribute to your success:

Experience and education:

  • Engineering school, business school or an atypical path. Your building track record matters more than your degree.
  • Side projects, a deployed app or an MCP server you built are a strong plus.

    • System & AI skills:

  • You understand at an advanced level how a system is built: functions, APIs, MCP, CI, deployment, data. No need to code by hand: you know how to architect and get it built with AI.
  • You have already shipped apps, agents or integrations with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent.

    • Beyond the technical:

  • Product mindset: you start from a business problem, not a technology, and ship small and fast.
  • Business curiosity: you want to understand how we sell.
  • Rigour in production: tests, rollback, not breaking what runs.
  • You're also fluent in English!

    • Why people love working at Brevo
    • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.
    • Practical perks for everyday balance: 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
    • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
    • Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
    • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

    Our candidate journey
  • First introductory TA call (30 min)
  • Interview with our RevOps Manager
  • Take-home assignment and debrief
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

title: Forward Software Engineer, Data
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job


As a Forward Software Engineer, Data, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who builds end to end and has shipped ML or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of models that pass every eval and fail on real data, and of quality that drifts after launch. You've also felt the data engineering pain: pipelines that break silently, schemas that change under you, and backfills that take a weekend. Data engineering is your edge. You turn messy, large-scale data into systems that hold up.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. Your depth in data architecture helps set the standard for how the team designs and delivers systems. You know lakehouse and data mesh patterns well enough to know when they fit and when they're overkill. You've designed ontologies and data models, and you know that getting them right is as much art as science.

What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the data architecture underneath them: ingestion, processing, storage, and the data models and ontologies that make messy data usable.

  • Build distributed pipelines that process large volumes of documents, code, logs, and multimodal content for retrieval, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build data governance into the systems themselves: ownership, access control, lineage, retention, and privacy for sensitive enterprise data.

  • Build the evaluation loop: labeling with LLMs and humans, versioned eval datasets, and checks that catch quality drift before customers do.

  • Set the standard for how the team designs and ships data systems.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.

What We're Looking For

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have 5+ years of experience building and running production data-intensive pipelines with distributed processing (for example Spark, Ray, Beam, or Dask) and orchestration tools (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) with structured and unstructured data.

  • You have experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic use cases, or LLM evaluation, and a clear view of how data quality drives model quality.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments, are obsessed with time to value and are comfortable making and articulating product-technical tradeoffs.

Ideally you have

  • A passion for graph-based systems (e.g. Neo4j) and ontology design

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines for LLM training, fine-tuning, or evaluation, and contributions to open-source projects, particularly in data or LLMs.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance and privacy requirements (for example GDPR), secure data handling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, or an affinity for security engineering.

How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

The role 

You’ll identify and help solve the more complex service problems that our clients face. You’ll investigate, define and design the end-to-end, front-stage and back-stage service journey. You’ll play a leadership role in projects and guide the direction of work. You’ll build relationships with senior stakeholders and other interested parties. You’ll support less experienced colleagues and share your extensive knowledge widely.

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards and procedures while working on client.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Essential experience

In your CV and interview you’ll need to show how you have:

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. descriptionHtml:

  • Teams und Verantwortliche führen. Du entwickelst klare Zuständigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass sportliche Planung, Content-Produktion und Partnerkampagnen zusammenpassen.

Du erhältst von Beginn an ein Geschäftsführungsmandat und gestaltest, wie sich InkuPlay sportlich und wirtschaftlich weiterentwickelt. Während der Übergabe arbeitest du direkt mit dem Gründer zusammen und lernst die Menschen, Verträge und Entscheidungen kennen, auf denen das Geschäft aufbaut.

title: GM / VP Sales, France
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Come build our France territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion, and France is a market we're committing to. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What we need now is the leader who turns that into a real business on the ground.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's France business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

title: Graduate / Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

The Role

We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.

Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.

This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Optimise Fraud Detection: Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.
  • Enhance Payment Performance: Lead data-driven initiatives to boost payment authorisation rates, optimise transaction routing, and reduce costs.
  • Drive Profitability within Finance: Lead automation and profitability initiatives across different areas of Finance.
  • Communicate Performance: Report on all aspects of fraud, payments and finance performance to stakeholders at all levels, including C-level management.
  • Drive System Improvements: Collaborate with Fraud, Payments, Finance and Engineering teams to scope and implement enhancements to detection systems and data pipelines.
  • Innovate & Automate: Proactively identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities, drive profitability, increase payment success, and enhance team efficiency through automation.

Requirements:

  • Proficient with SQL & Python
  • Proficient in a data visualisation software (Tableau/Looker/PowerBI/e.t.c.)
  • Experience using a variety of machine learning algorithms
  • Able to communicate effectively; using data to tell a story and drive business change
  • Experience within Google Cloud preferential

title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

There’s a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos,  or Customer Experience & Integrity. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. 

  • You’ll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.
  • You’ll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you’ll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.
  • You’ll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.
  • You’ll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won’t just shape your own projects - it’ll shape how design is practiced across the team.
  • You’ll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.
  • You’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

We’re looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here’s what you’ll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You’re in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.
  • You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving.
  • AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.
  • You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.
  • You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. You’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scaleWork on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fastShip, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
    environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownershipTake on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for buildersHigh standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA.

Our story began in 2000 in the garage of our co‑founder, Theo Duchen, who, alongside fellow former McKinsey partner David McDonald, set out to reinvent insurance technology. What started as a bold start‑up idea has grown into a global SaaS leader trusted by the industry.

Today, over 100,000 users across 40+ countries rely on the Acturis platform. By working closely with brokers, insurers, and MGAs, we continue to shape the market and drive new standards across both personal and commercial lines.

Working across APIs, databases, user interfaces and quality assurance, the team delivers the functionality that powers the software used by brokers and insurers every day. title: Growth Associate
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About Dex

Dex is backed by Notion Capital, a16z and Concept Ventures, with angels from OpenAI, Wise, ElevenLabs, Meta’s board, and many more. We’re an ambitious, direct and kind group of people, we value authenticity, ambition and people who make things happen.

We’re a team of 28 (and growing) based in London. We work together 3 times a week because we value in person time, but we’re person centric and flexible. We hire adults who can manage their own schedules.

The Role

40,000+ engineers have joined Dex, and we plan to 10x that in the next year. To get there we’re building a growth engine: channels, tools and agents that find the right engineers and get better every week. This role helps build and run it.

It’s a broad role on the candidate side of Dex. One week you might launch a new acquisition channel. The next you might build a lead magnet, run a test on the website or ship a free tool like our engineer salary benchmark. What ties it together is systems: you’ll build the automations, agents and reporting that let a small team do the work of a much bigger one.

You’ll learn growth from people who have done it before. Rob, our Head of Growth, led product growth at Cleo, and Luca, our Growth Lead, has built large B2B go-to-market teams. You’ll work directly with both of them, alongside Dex’s founding team, and see up close how a growth team gets built. Dex is AI-first: agents run our growth channels, our weekly reports are automated, and everyone here builds with Claude. You’ll work the same way from your first week.

It’s for someone early in their career who is technical, commercially minded and wants to start a company one day. You don’t need growth experience. You need to think in systems, stay comfortable when nobody has defined the problem yet, and want more ownership than most companies would give you this early.

What You’ll Do

  • Own part of the growth engine: take on whole areas of how engineers find and join Dex, with targets for good candidates and the freedom to decide how to hit them.

  • Build with AI: create the agents, automations and internal tools that take manual work off the team, and help work out how an AI-first growth team should run.

  • Scale our acquisition channels: run and improve channels across paid, the jobs feed and creators. You’ll be hands-on in each one, finding what limits it and fixing it.

  • Launch new channels: take a channel from first idea to a working system, test it against our own quality numbers and tell us plainly whether to scale it or stop.

  • Build tools and lead magnets: ship free tools and resources that help engineers with their careers and bring them to Dex.

  • Run website tests: design and run experiments on our site and landing pages, and make the winners the default.

  • Own the numbers: build the reporting that shows what’s working across channels, and use it to decide where we put time and budget next.

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical and fluent in AI: you build with AI tools every day and can turn an idea into a working script, automation or agent. Ideally you have a computer science or other technical degree or master’s.

  • Commercially driven: you care what something cost and what it returned, and you’d rather switch a channel off than defend one that isn’t working.

  • A systems thinker: when you solve a problem you build the thing that solves it every time, so nobody has to do it by hand again.

  • Comfort in ambiguity: you can take a goal with no brief, work out what the real problem is and make progress without waiting to be told how.

  • A self-starter: you find the next thing to do without being asked, and you finish what you start.

  • Startup experience: you’ve worked at an early-stage company, in a founders associate role or on something of your own, so you know how little gets handed to you.

  • Ambition to found something: you want to start or run a company one day, and you want the ownership now that gets you there.

Why Join Now

The growth team is 4 people and the plan is to 10x, so there is more to build than there are people to build it. You’ll get real ownership and broad scope early, direct time with the people running growth, and a close view of how an AI-first company builds a team.

We’re open on backgrounds. If you have the raw ingredients and have excelled where you are now, we want to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary - we’re building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you ‘have’ to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • “Whatever you need” approach to tools and support

Interview Process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  • We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren’t an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we’re building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  • A 30m video call with Becca, our Head of Talent; we’ll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  • A call with Rob, our Head of Growth, on short and medium-term objectives and deeper questions on the role.

  • A practical task to better understand how you work, completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  • Onsite interview loop where you’ll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on your task, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

title: Growth Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical, technical and hands-on Growth Lead to build and scale Dotfile’s growth engine.

You will own how we identify target accounts, capture buying signals, reach the right people with the right message, experiment with new channels, and turn what works into scalable systems. You will work closely with Marketing and Sales to generate qualified pipeline across our key markets, with a particular focus on our expansion in the US.

This is a builder role. You will combine strong growth instincts with data, automation and AI to build workflows for account research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis. You will own the full experimentation loop: finding opportunities, launching experiments quickly, measuring their impact on pipeline and revenue, and scaling the ones that work.

You will be expected to remain deeply hands-on with the tools and systems behind our growth engine. We want to build a small, highly leveraged growth team where technology replaces repetitive work and allows us to experiment faster and operate at greater scale.

You will report directly to the VP of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Dotfile’s growth strategy and pipeline generation across our key markets, working closely with Marketing and Sales

  • Build systems to identify target accounts and buying signals, enrich them with relevant data, and turn them into actionable growth opportunities

  • Design and execute highly targeted outbound and account-based campaigns across channels, using AI and automation to operate at scale without sacrificing relevance

  • Build workflows and agents for research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis

  • Develop a high-velocity experimentation engine: identify new audiences, messages, channels and tactics, launch tests quickly, measure their impact and scale what works

  • Own the growth stack and connect our CRM, data providers, automation tools, AI models and other systems to continuously improve how we generate pipeline

  • Own growth analytics and performance, developing a clear understanding of funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, CAC and channel effectiveness

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing to turn learnings from prospects, customers and campaign performance into better targeting, messaging and go-to-market decisions

title: Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We’re now on the hunt for a brilliant growth marketer who wants to make an enormous impact on Spruce’s growth trajectory as we add thousands of installers over the next 18 months. You’ll help to scale and own our marketing and growth engine – campaigns, content, ads, and the experiments that tell us what’s actually working – and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.

This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo, to scale our growth engine. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:

  • Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests across. This involves anything that can get the product into the hands of more users, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers.

  • Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers.

  • Owning our distribution channels – partnerships, website, socials, email nurture, paid ads and events, making sure each one is pulling its weight and the pipeline it generates is handed cleanly to sales.

  • Marketing analytics & reporting – breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, tracking CAC and channel performance, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack.

🫵 About You

You'll have somewhere between 2 and 5 years of work experience. You don't need a marketing background, but you do need to show us you can spot opportunities and push things forward, whether that's campaigns you've run, content you've created, or projects where you've built something from scratch and got it in front of people. You'll ideally be:

  • Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh*t done;

  • A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;

  • Full of creative energy — you have ideas for how to get more installers onto Spruce and you can't wait to test them. You look at what other companies have done well and think about how to adapt it, not copy it;

  • Hands-on with the tools — you’re willing to roll-up your sleeves to run campaigns yourself across paid ads, email and socials, and you’re comfortable building landing pages, setting up tracking, and making content without waiting for someone else to do it;

  • Data-minded — you're comfortable pulling apart a funnel to work out where it's leaking and you know your way around a spreadsheet, but you use data to decide what to try next, not as a substitute for ideas;

  • A natural "people person" — you love working with people and have a natural interest in their problems. You find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;

  • Genuinely curious about our customers — heat pump installers are small business owners doing technically complex, physically demanding work. The best marketing we can do starts with understanding their world, and you'll spend real time talking to them;

  • An AI whizz — you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;

… and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

🌟 Our Offer

  • 💰 Base salary £50-70k, with quarterly bonus aligned to company targets

  • 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • 🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

🧑‍💻 Working At Spruce

  • We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

descriptionHtml:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.


The Role

We are looking for a Head of Business Development, Defence to lead the next phase of ExTrac's growth across UK and European defence. This is a senior, high-impact role for someone who combines deep familiarity with defence and national security with the energy and agility of the technology sector.

You will set the direction for ExTrac's defence business: deciding which customers, programmes and markets we pursue, building the pipeline and partnerships to win them, and growing the team that delivers it. Reporting to the Director of Growth, you will be the senior commercial face of ExTrac to defence customers, and the voice of the defence customer inside ExTrac.

What the job involves

Defence growth strategy

  • Shape and execute ExTrac's growth strategy across UK and European defence.

  • Set the defence go-to-market plan: priority customers, programmes and markets, revenue targets, and where ExTrac will deliberately not play.

  • Own the defence revenue target and forecast, reporting progress and risk to the leadership team with candour.

Senior relationships and positioning

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and influencers across MoD, NATO and allied defence ecosystems.

  • Position ExTrac as the go-to decision intelligence partner for modern defence challenges.

  • Speak the language of operators and engineers, win trust in high-stakes environments, and translate ExTrac's technical edge into strategic advantage for our customers.

Capture, procurement and closing

  • Lead capture on multi-million pound opportunities from early shaping through to contract, across frameworks, competitions and direct awards.

  • Navigate UK and European procurement pathways, including innovation and rapid-acquisition routes, to get ExTrac on contract and scaling inside programmes.

  • Build partnerships with primes, systems integrators and channel partners where they accelerate access to programmes ExTrac could not reach alone.

Customer insight into product

  • Bring user needs back into product and data strategy, helping ExTrac stay ahead of market demand.

  • Work closely with Product, Research & Analysis and Customer Success so that what we sell, what we build and what we deliver stay aligned.

Building the defence BD function

  • Hire, develop and lead a defence BD team as the market scales, working with our existing Defence Business Development Lead.

  • Establish the pipeline discipline, qualification standards and playbooks that let the team win consistently without depending on any single individual.

You should apply if

  • You have a proven record winning multi-million pound opportunities in defence, intelligence or security markets, and you are ready to own the strategy, not just the deals.

  • You want to build a market, a team and a function, and you see a high-growth, venture-backed environment as the reason to join rather than a risk to manage.

  • You are comfortable being senior and hands-on at the same time. In the first year you will personally lead key pursuits while building the function around you.

Where this role can take you

  • Build and lead the defence BD function you create as ExTrac scales across the UK and Europe.

  • Shape company strategy, not just sales strategy, influencing how ExTrac positions itself at a defining moment for AI in defence and national security.

  • A clear path to broader commercial leadership as the defence business grows.

Requirements

For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand.

  • Candidates must hold a valid UK Security Clearance (e.g. SC, DV) or be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance to be considered for this role.

  • Deep domain knowledge of UK and European defence, procurement pathways, and decision-making cycles.

Desirable

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

Your Role

You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. Engineering Excellence

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

title: Head of Finance and Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Aufgaben

Du leitest Finance, IT, People und Operations: neun Menschen in vier Disziplinen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese vier Disziplinen zu führen, zu entwickeln und auf gemeinsame Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten auszurichten. Auch dort, wo du selbst nicht die Fachexpertin oder der Fachexperte bist. Gleichzeitig bist du Ansprechpartner für das C-Level (CEO, CGO und CRO) und die Teamleads in den anderen Abteilungen.

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Ergebnisverantwortung liegt dabei eindeutig im Finanzbereich. Dort führst du ein Team von vier Personen in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (AR/AP) und verantwortest den Rechnungslegungszyklus von Anfang bis Ende: Buchhaltung, Zahlungsläufe, Mahnwesen und Payroll bis hin zum abgeschlossenen Monat und den Zahlen, die das Haus verlassen. Du überschaust die Systeme, die diese Zahlen erzeugen – DATEV, Billing-Plattformen, CRM und Data Warehouse und bist in der Lage diese nach modernen KI basierten Standards miteinander zu verzahnen um ein fortlaufendes Reporting aufzubauen.

Es ist weder eine rein strategische noch eine rein operative Position. Für IT und Office führst du über Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten: Hardware, Onboarding, Compliance Standards wie ISO 27001 und 9001 sind dabei von dir zu koordinieren.

Unser CFO wechselt begleitend in ein Fractional-Modell und bleibt bei Board-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsthemen eng dabei, du bekommst also einen erfahrenen Sparringspartner, ohne dass jemand über deinem Tagesgeschäft sitzt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Finanzfunktion in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit eigener Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss vom Buchungssatz bis zum Reporting. In einem Team dieser Größe ist die Führungskraft Spielertrainer:in: Du kannst die Arbeit auch selbst machen, wenn jemand ausfällt.
  • Solide deutsche Rechnungslegungspraxis – HGB, DATEV, Payroll und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerberater. Praktisch, nicht theoretisch.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geführt – idealerweise in der Buchhaltung – und traust dir zu, auch für IT und People Standards zu setzen, ohne Sysadmin oder Arbeitsrechtlerin zu sein.
  • Sicherheit bei SaaS-Kennzahlen: ARR, MRR, Brutto- und Nettoretention, Rechnungsabgrenzung, Kohorten-Analyse und dem entsprechenden Reporting.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, einen manuellen Prozess durch einen echten zu ersetzen: ein Reporting, das sich selbst baut; eine Abstimmung, die keine Person mehr braucht. Du musst kein SQL schreiben, solltest aber über Data Warehouse, Billing-System und CRM sprechen können, ohne dafür einen Entwickler im Raum zu brauchen.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher – Arbeits- und Abschlusssprache in dieser Rolle – sowie fließendes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Due Diligence, Audit oder eine Finanzierungsrunde von innen erlebt; Berührung mit Förderprogrammen wie GRW oder IBB.
  • Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Compliance Frameworks wie ISO, GRC, ISMS, etc. geben dir einen erheblichen Vorteil im Prozess.

Benefits

  • 100.000–120.000 € Grundgehalt je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an eine Scorecard, die du mitgestaltest.
  • pot. Beteiligung an unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm (ESOP).
  • Ein echtes Mandat: vier Funktionen, neun Menschen und das Mandat Prozesse effektiv und wachstumsorientiert zu gestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte
  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG Ticket und weitere Benefits
  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Entscheidungen sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass die sie echten Impact haben.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Prozess, den du in Ordnung gebracht hast: wie er vorher aussah, was du verändert hast und was es dich gekostet hat, es durchzusetzen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
