title: Head of Implementation
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of Implementation, you will build the foundations that let implementation scale: the operating model, the process and the standards we need to grow well beyond where we are today. Enterprise implementation is slow and manual almost everywhere, so you will rebuild ours around agents, which almost no delivery leader gets the chance to do on live enterprise builds. Through all of it, you own how our largest customers experience Ben, from the enterprise sales conversation through to a confident go-live.

Things you will be working on

  • Transform how we implement enterprise customers: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. Rebuild the operating model, the standards and the reusable components so we can take on far more without adding a person for every customer, and collapse the time it takes a customer to reach value.

  • Make implementation AI-native: our builds are technically complex (integrations, eligibility logic, huge volumes of data). Decide what agents can genuinely own, where humans stay in the loop, then rebuild delivery around that. We expect a function where your team's time goes on judgement and relationships while the repeatable work runs itself.

  • Own the ARR we launch: every pound of new revenue goes live through your team. Builds land on the date we promised, at a standard the customer never has to think about, from the first enterprise conversation through to go-live.

  • Open up partner-led delivery: as our partner operation grows, partners will implement alongside us. Set the standards, the enablement and the oversight that make a partner-led build hold the same bar as one of ours.

  • Be the person customers trust when it matters: when a build gets difficult, you are in the room. Hold the relationship with the executive sponsor, make the tough decisions, and see it through.

  • Lead the team through the change: you will lead 8 to 10 Implementation Managers through a transformation of how they work. Bring them with you, develop the people already leading within the team, and build the bench that lets this function keep growing.

  • Make the wider business faster because of you: partner with commercial, customer and product leaders so the journey joins up before, during and after a build, and so what your team learns changes what we sell and what we build.


You will love this role if you have...

  • Built an implementation function: you have scaled a delivery, implementation or professional services function in a scaling B2B SaaS company, including the operating model, the standards and the process. You can show what changed because of it: time to go-live, delivery quality, how many customers a team could carry.

  • Led enterprise delivery: multi-country or multi-entity programmes with deep integration and data work, long timelines and stakeholder groups that reach the C-suite. You know how large organisations behave, where their delays come from, and how to hold a date when their side slips.

  • Built and led teams: you have hired, developed and retained delivery people, including people who lead others. You can name individuals who are measurably better for having worked with you, and you have handled the harder conversations as well as the good ones.

  • Technical credibility: you hold your own on integrations, APIs, data mapping and configuration logic on a technical product. You can tell when a technical answer does not add up, and you know which calls are yours to make and which belong with your team.

  • Taken a team through an AI shift: you have changed how a delivery organisation works using AI, decided what machines own and what people own, and carried the team and your customers through that change. You have a view on what implementation looks like when agents handle the repeatable work, and the conviction to argue for it and resource it.

  • Carried a commercial number: revenue going live, delivery margin, retention in the accounts you launched. You are at home in enterprise sales conversations, setting scope and timelines in front of a customer that you are then held to.

Nice-to-haves

  • Benefits, HR or payroll: or another domain where the data volumes and the compliance rules both bite, and a mistake shows up in someone's pay.

  • A technical background: solutions engineering, pre-sales or technical support alongside implementation.

  • Partner or channel delivery: you have set up professional services or delivery partners to implement on your behalf, and held them to your own quality bar.

Why join us?

  • The remit is genuinely yours: implementation at Ben has a strong foundation and no fixed ceiling. You get to decide what this function becomes.

  • The work is properly complex: global enterprise customers, real integration and data depth, and benefits logic that changes by country. Every build asks something new of the team.

  • An AI-native function, built for real: we're an AI-native company, so a plan to rebuild delivery around agents gets resourced here. Very few delivery leaders get to run that experiment on live enterprise customers.

  • Implementation has a seat at the table: what your team learns shapes the product roadmap, and you'll have the access to make that happen.

title: Head of India
descriptionHtml:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

title: Head of SEO & AI Search (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Deine Mission

Du beherrschst klassisches SEO in der Tiefe, mit mehrjähriger Senior-Erfahrung. Gleichzeitig ist dir klar: Kaum noch jemand sucht heute komplett ohne KI, sei es über ChatGPT, Gemini oder AI Overviews. Diesen Wandel willst du nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv gestalten. Klar ist dabei: Ohne solides SEO-Fundament funktioniert auch die beste GEO-Strategie nicht, deshalb bringst du beides mit.

Als Head of SEO & AI Search verantwortest du unseren SEO-Bereich strategisch, operativ und wirtschaftlich. Im Zentrum deiner Rolle stehen von Beginn an unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Bestandskunden: Hier baust du die SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie neu und mit voller Verantwortung auf Senior-Ebene auf, im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Perspektivisch entwickelst du von dort aus den SEO-Bereich für weitere Kunden im Haus.

KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle: erstens als Zielsystem, du machst Kunden auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar. Zweitens als Arbeitsweise, du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind echte Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs.

Was erwartet dich

  • AI Search & Sichtbarkeit – der Kern der Rolle, kein Nebenschauplatz: Du entwickelst Strategien, damit Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar, verständlich und zitierfähig sind. Du denkst Inhalte für generative Systeme mit: klar beantwortbare Absätze, saubere Q&A-Strukturen, belastbares Schema-Markup, damit KI-Systeme Inhalte einordnen und zitieren können.
  • Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testsets und Prompt-Sammlungen, um systematisch zu beobachten, wann und wie Marken, Produkte und Inhalte in KI-Antworten genannt werden – idealerweise mit AI-Visibility-Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound.
  • Einordnung statt Hype: Du ordnest GEO und AEO fachlich ein, statt Hype hinterherzulaufen, und vermittelst ehrlich, wo es heute schon belastbare Ergebnisse gibt und wo noch nicht.
  • Dein Case: Verantwortung von Tag eins. Du übernimmst die strategische, operative und wirtschaftliche Führung des SEO- und AI-Search-Mandats für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle. Du baust eine SEO- und GEO-Roadmap auf, die es in dieser Form bislang nicht gab, und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung des Kunden souverän in Workshops, Audits und Reviews.


Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise

Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel:

  • Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen.
  • Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen.
  • Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst.
  • Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken.
  • Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen.


Was solltest du mitbringen

  • Bei SEO erwarten wir echte Tiefe. Bei KI muss es kein Fachwissen oder Abschluss sein, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen. Die technischen Hürden legen wir bewusst niedrig, ein bisschen eigene Praxis braucht es trotzdem.
  • Mehrjährige SEO- und AI-Search-Erfahrung aus Agentur- oder vergleichbarer Unternehmensumgebung, mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Tiefgang, Ergebnisse und Neugier.
  • Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO, Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung.
  • Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen SEO-Strategien und Roadmaps, die du für unterschiedliche Kunden von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle steuerst – inklusive technischer Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten), Relaunches und Migrationen.
  • Keyword-, Content- und Autoritätsstrategien, die echten Mehrwert statt reiner Keyword-Abdeckung liefern.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Search Console, GA4, Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs sowie Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb.
  • Ein Bewusstsein für den Wandel zu KI-gestützter Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir zumindest ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast bereits eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools gesammelt, und sei es nur privat (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co.). Ein Zertifikat oder eine Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger ist Lust, das jetzt systematisch für deine SEO-Arbeit einzusetzen.
  • Denken in Leads, Conversions und Kundennutzen statt nur in Rankings, dazu eine eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sicheres Englisch.


Warum VS Mediahouse

Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unseren modernen Büros im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie eine moderne, sachorientierte Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot.
  • Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Epassi-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort.
  • Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr.
  • Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop.
  • Erweitere deine Rente durch die Teilnahme an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
  • Abgerundet wird deine Zeit bei uns natürlich auch mit verschiedenen Team-Events und Feiern.


Klingt nach dir?

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Rankings reportet, und genauso wenig einen reinen KI-Enthusiasten ohne SEO-Substanz. Sondern jemanden, der SEO in der Tiefe beherrscht, Lust hat, KI in den eigenen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren, und bereit ist, für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden von Anfang an echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Technisches KI-Vorwissen ist zweitrangig, echte Motivation nicht.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beschreibe uns stattdessen kurz zwei bis drei SEO-Projekte, für die du verantwortlich warst (Ausgangslage, deine Rolle, Ergebnis), und beantworte:

1. Wie nutzt du KI heute schon in deinem Alltag, und was reizt dich daran, KI-gestützte Suche zum Kernteil deiner Arbeit zu machen?

2. Wo hast du KI schon sinnvoll in einem SEO-Prozess eingesetzt? Falls noch nicht: Was würdest du als Erstes ausprobieren?

3. Wie misst du SEO-Erfolg, wenn Rankings und Klicks allein nicht mehr reichen?

Wenn du mehr über unsere Arbeitskultur und das Arbeitsumfeld erfahren möchtest, laden wir dich ein, die Bewertungen unserer Mitarbeiter auf Kununu zu lesen. Dort findest du ehrliche Meinungen und Feedback von aktuellen und ehemaligen Mitarbeitern.

title: Head of Tax
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: Head of Tax

Team: Tax

Location: Gibraltar, on-site

Tax at Midnite isn't a back-office function. We operate in one of the most heavily taxed and regulated industries, and we're expanding into new markets fast. As Head of Tax, you'll own Midnite's tax strategy and set-up across the UK&I, Gibraltar, Malta, South Africa and Canada, plus whatever comes next. You'll report directly to our founders.

You'll make the big structural calls on new markets, joint ventures, IP and fundraising. You'll keep a complex set of tax obligations running smoothly. And you'll turn constant tax change into clear decisions the business can act on. It's hands-on, high-ownership and genuinely strategic.

You will:

  • Own Midnite's Group tax strategy and lead the tax function across all our entities and markets.

  • Be the tax lead on international expansion and new market launches so we launch fast without leaving value or risk on the table.

  • Keep our tax obligations accurate, on time, and efficient.

  • Design and manage our transfer pricing, intercompany agreements, and residence and substance requirements.

  • Partner with Finance on tax accounting, forecasting, ERP configuration and cash tax planning, and review and sign off returns.

  • Advise on corporate transactions: reorganisations, IP location, fundraising, M&A and employee share schemes.

  • Get ahead of change, from UK gambling tax changes to Pillar Two, and turn it into clear recommendations for senior management and commercial teams.

  • Build the governance a scaling group needs: SAO readiness, Corporate Criminal Offence procedures, a tax risk register, and a published tax strategy.

  • Manage our external advisers and their fees, and represent Midnite with HMRC and other tax authorities.

  • Find and land opportunities, from R&D tax credits to optimising our gambling taxes.

The next Midniter:

  • Holds a recognised tax and/or accountancy qualification (such as CTA, ADIT, ACA, ICAS, ACCA).

  • Has 10+ years' relevant experience, including top-tier advisory and several years in a senior in-house tax role.

  • Has designed international structures and transfer pricing across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Is commercial and turns complex analysis into clear recommendations.

  • Is happy to be hands-on: writing memos, reviewing returns, and briefing senior management

  • Communicates simply with founders, senior management, and non-tax teams, and enjoys teaching others.

  • Manages advisers confidently and efficiently.

  • Thrives in ambiguity and pace, takes ownership, and holds high standards of integrity.

  • Experience of iGaming or gambling duties is a big plus.

💰 Winnings

  • Join us at an exciting stage as we establish our Gibraltar office. We're investing in a great local employee experience and will continue to expand our benefits package as we grow.

  • Enjoy 21 days of annual leave, plus 12 bank holidays. You'll also receive additional leave based on your tenure, with 2 extra days after 3 years at Midnite, a further 3 days after 5 years, and another day after 8 years.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

title: Implementation Engineer - Process Out
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Welcome to ProcessOut

ProcessOut is a pioneer in the payment orchestration space. We are on a mission to help merchants build, scale and optimize their payment infrastructure. We work to bring simplicity, flexibility & performance to payments.

Millions of transactions are routed via ProcessOut everyday for merchants all over the world. We are proud to partner with amazing merchants like Glovo, Bolt, Sainsbury’s, Dott, Rakuten and many more!

We were acquired by Checkout.com in 2020 with the goal of growing our global reach.

If you are looking to join a very fast-moving company with passionate, hard-working & fun teams, ProcessOut is for you! At ProcessOut, we are looking for people who are convinced they can play a central part in the Company's success! We are looking for people who are passionate, who are looking to achieve their full potential & who will actively contribute to strengthen the links between our teams. We value people that fully own their work and are passionate about building the next generation of online payments with us.

The role

At ProcessOut, Implementation Engineers play a central role in the success of the Company. We are looking for a highly motivated person to join our Merchant Experience team and work alongside colleagues to help customers get world-class guidance and advice during the implementation of ProcessOut.

You will play a critical role in helping customers go-live, in maintaining their trust and ensuring a strong feedback loop within our teams to continuously improve our products suite.

The ideal candidate must be customer-driven and tech-savvy with eagerness to learn in a fast-growing environment facing complex challenges.

What we’re looking for

  • In-depth technical knowledge, particularly with a robust understanding of SaaS companies, web services, APIs, web applications, mobile apps, and IT infrastructure essential for effective

  • Native level French or English communication skills complemented by a strong business acumen.

  • Able to read and analyze server and application logs and debug errors.

  • Strong experience working with REST HTTP APIs.

  • Strong experience in project management, and ideally customer onboarding.

  • Ability to investigate and solve complex technical problems to offer the best solutions to our customers.

Bonus points for

  • Experience in a similar role in a tech company.

  • Prior customer service experience working in a merchant-facing role.

  • Advanced data analytics skills, preferably with proficiency in sophisticated tools and demonstrated examples of analytical work.

  • Experience working with Javascript to design and build small application scripts.

  • Ability to read and understand application code (Golang).

What you will be doing

  • Provide technical support to merchants during their implementation of ProcessOut.

  • Plan and manage their project of implementing the solution.

  • Answer all merchants’ integration-related questions, including but not limited to configuration, debugging, documentation, testing, and go-live support.

  • Manage incidents related to the integration (investigation, troubleshooting, escalation, resolution, reporting, time tracking and analysis of incidents).

  • Partner internally with account managers, technical support, and engineers to resolve issues during customer trials, integrations, or post-implementation support.

  • Interact with the Product/Engineering teams to pinpoint improvement ideas.

  • Advise Management on project statuses and potential issues that impact customer satisfaction and provide recommendations for appropriate actions.

  • Ability to multitask with multiple projects and integrations of key customers

  • Maintain and update our merchant-facing documentation to continuously help reduce friction during the implementation phase.

Additional information

Apply without meeting all requirements statement

If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We always want to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

We believe in equal opportunities.

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.

Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.

When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.

We want to set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. We’ll be happy to support you.

  • Our careers page https://www.checkout.com/careers

  • Our LinkedIn Life pages bit.ly/3OaoN1U

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

title: Implementation Manager - Spend/ERP
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Merchant Services team partners with our clients to realise their full potential through the adoption of Airwallex products that drive their growth and success. Within Merchant Services, our Spend and card implementation specialists sit at the heart of how customers design, launch, and scale their global spend programmes on Airwallex.

We influence revenue growth across our Spend and issuing portfolio and collaborate with sales, strategy, product, and engineering teams to provide the best experience for our most valued customers. Our team works alongside commercial teams throughout the pre‑sales, solution design, and integration stages, then owns the orchestration from contract signature through go‑live and early adoption. We are committed to empowering businesses with the tools they need to run high‑performing, compliant, and scalable spend programmes across EMEA.

What you’ll do

As the Implementation Manager for our Spend Team, you will own the end‑to‑end delivery of complex Spend and corporate card implementations that bring our global spend management products to life for enterprise and high‑growth customers across EMEA. You will turn agreed business requirements and solution designs into actionable implementation plans, orchestrating cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders to deliver on time, on scope, and to a high quality bar.

You’ll sit at the intersection of Sales, Merchant Services, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, Risk and external partners (e.g. networks, processors, manufacturers), ensuring that every phase from pre‑sale through go‑live and early spend activation runs smoothly.

This role is based in London (3 days in office), with implementation coverage across EMEA.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal teams on high-value implementations and expansions, shaping integration approaches, system configuration, and overall solution design.

  • Partner with activation / onboarding and account management teams to translate customer requirements into scalable architectures, particularly where ERP, HRIS, and API integrations are core to the rollout.

  • Work with sales teams on technical discovery to understand customer systems, data flows, and workflows, and recommend a best-fit integration blueprint, including when and how to leverage APIs and third-party connectors.

  • Work hands-on with customers to troubleshoot integration hurdles and guide them through complex configuration decisions, focusing on designing robust, maintainable implementations rather than writing code directly.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the broader integration ecosystem (e.g. HRIS and accounting partners), collaborating with Sales, Product, and partners to close gaps and improve integration coverage.

  • Create and maintain internal documentation, playbooks, and lightweight tooling that make it easier for the wider team to support integration-heavy use cases at scale.

  • Channel customer pain points and integration feedback into Product and Engineering, influencing the roadmap and prioritisation of features that materially improve implementation outcomes.

Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g. Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer success, or project/program management, managing complex, multi‑stakeholder technology or financial services implementations.

  • 4+ years of client‑facing delivery or professional services experience in a high‑paced environment (e.g. SaaS, fintech, consulting, systems integration, enterprise implementation).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering cross‑functional projects with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and job functions, including C‑level executives, technical teams, and operations.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead steering meetings, write clear status updates, and influence decisions without direct authority.

  • Experience delivering ERP, accounting system, or expense platforms (e.g. Netsuite, SAP, Oracle, Xero) implementations and the associated data flows (GL, cost centres, entities, card feeds).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hands‑on experience working with or alongside integration engineers, solution architects, or technical program managers on API‑based integrations, including familiarity with common web, SSO, and ERP integration concepts.

  • Formal training or certification in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master), and comfort setting up operating rhythms such as stand‑ups, steering committees, and executive readouts.

  • Experience managing strategic or enterprise accounts as part of a broader account team, including navigating commercial sensitivities while protecting delivery quality and scope.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑moving, ambiguous environment, balancing structured methodologies with pragmatic decision‑making to keep complex projects moving forward.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Infra Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

About the Role

We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to build the secure, reliable foundation everyone else at ClaimSorted builds on top of - and the self-service tools to create accurate analytics.

  • You'll close the gaps before they become a headline - own access controls, PII protection, and compliance end-to-end, at a company handling real claims data for the world's largest insurers. This isn't theoretical security work; it's the real thing, with real stakes.

  • You'll standardize how we build and run infrastructure - bring consistency across the stack, build the observability to actually see what's happening, and drive measurable gains in reliability, latency, and cost as we scale.

  • You'll build the data infrastructure that lets teams answer their own questions - accurate, self-service analytics that mean claims and ops don't have to file an engineering ticket and wait days for something they could pull themselves.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We're a tight-knit team that genuinely enjoys building this together, and we think you'll feel that from day one.

Who You Are

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resume. You might come from a platform, security, or data infrastructure background - what matters is you've owned the unglamorous stuff that everything else depends on.

  • Deep in security - access controls, PII protection, and compliance aren't an afterthought for you, they're a discipline

  • Deep in infrastructure - you know reliability, observability, database performance, and data pipelines from real production experience, not just theory

  • A driver of standards, not just a follower of them - you set the bar and hold teams accountable for meeting it, even when that means an uncomfortable conversation

  • Comfortable owning ambiguity - this role doesn't come with a fixed roadmap; you're helping define what "good" looks like here

Our Values

 

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

title: International Indirect Tax Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Forming part of the tax team, you will own the day-to-day management of Volta's indirect tax affairs in all jurisdictions outside the US, including VAT/GST, customs duties, excise taxes and property taxes, as applicable. You will combine hands-on compliance and process ownership with practical indirect tax advice on business operations, commercial transactions, capital investment and new projects.

You will work closely with finance, procurement, commercial, legal and external advisers to ensure indirect taxes are correctly assessed, charged, recovered and reported, and that available exemptions and reliefs are identified, documented and implemented.

This is an opportunity for an experienced indirect tax specialist to build scalable processes within a fast-growing, global AI infrastructure business and directly influence the tax cost and cash flow of major infrastructure investments.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own indirect tax compliance across all jurisdictions in which Volta operates outside the US, including registrations, returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax notices, coordinating with local advisers and service providers.

  • Assess registration obligations, place of supply, taxability and reverse charge requirements for Volta's business activities and commercial arrangements.

  • Partner with procurement and project teams to establish the appropriate indirect tax treatment of purchases of goods and services before orders are placed.

  • Identify and implement available tax recovery opportunities, exemptions, reliefs and import VAT/GST arrangements, working with external advisers to confirm eligibility and ongoing requirements.

  • Manage tax invoices and supporting documentation for both purchases and customer sales, including evidence for cross-border transactions, validation and retention.

  • Review customer and supplier contracts with legal and commercial teams, advising on indirect tax clauses, invoicing, recovery requirements and responsibility for tax assessments.

  • Establish transaction review processes to identify indirect taxes that have not been accounted for or have been charged or recovered incorrectly and pursue refunds or corrections where appropriate.

  • Lead indirect tax audits and enquiries, coordinating responses, supporting evidence and external advisers.

  • Build and maintain indirect tax guidance, compliance calendars, controls and data requirements, and support the implementation of tax technology, e-invoicing, digital reporting and automation.

  • Monitor legislative changes and assess their impact on existing operations and new projects, providing clear recommendations and supporting the business teams.

  • Support finance with indirect tax accounting, account reconciliations, budgeting, cash flow forecasts and financial audit requirements, including the timing of VAT/GST recovery and refunds.

  • Advise on the indirect tax implications of cross-border and intercompany arrangements, property leases and entry into new countries, coordinating with local specialists where needed.

  • Manage customs duties, excise taxes and property tax matters, coordinating with specialist advisers on import procedures and other relevant local taxes.

What You Bring

  • Strong experience in VAT/GST and other indirect taxes across multiple jurisdictions outside the US within a business, Big 4 or specialist tax advisory firm.

  • Strong technical knowledge of VAT/GST compliance, place of supply, reverse charges, input tax recovery, exemptions and audit management, with broader knowledge of customs duties, excise taxes and other relevant local taxes.

  • Experience assessing the indirect tax treatment of goods and services, cross-border transactions and intercompany arrangements.

  • Practical experience with VAT/GST registrations, invoice reviews, tax reconciliations, refund claims and import VAT/GST.

  • Experience supporting significant capital expenditure or businesses operating across multiple countries; exposure to data centres, infrastructure or equipment leasing is particularly valuable.

  • The ability to translate technical tax analysis into clear instructions for procurement, finance, legal and commercial teams.

  • Experience working with ERP systems, tax engines and large transaction datasets, with an interest in improving processes and automation.

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines while taking ownership of issues through to resolution.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience; a recognised tax or accountancy qualification is advantageous.

title: Junior Copywriter (m/w/d) im Performance Marketing
descriptionHtml:

Wir suchen einen Junior Copywriter (m/w/d) im Performance Marketing für unser Office in Hamburg (hybrid).

Wenn folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

  • Du schreibst oder erzählst gern und andere hören dir bis zum Ende zu

Skinbro macht Körperpflegeprodukte für Männer, die keine Lust mehr auf 3-in-1-Duschgel aus dem Drogerieregal haben. Angefangen hat alles mit der festen Duschseife aus Kokosöl, Aktivkohle und Olivenöl, Made in Germany, ohne Silikone, Parabene und Mikroplastik. Inzwischen vertrauen uns über 100.000 Kunden, 97 % der Bewertungen haben 4 oder 5 Sterne, und das Sortiment wächst mit Deo und Parfüm weiter.

Wir verkaufen ausschließlich direkt an unsere Kunden und wachsen über Direct Response auf Meta, E-Mail und eine Community, die wir ernst nehmen. Unser kleines Team rund um die Gründer arbeitet mit externen Editoren und modernen KI-Tools. Wir sitzen mit eigenem Office direkt in der Hamburger Innenstadt.

Das lernst du bei uns

  • Monat 1: Du kennst Skinbro, unsere Kunden und unsere besten Ads und verstehst, warum sie funktionieren.
  • Monat 2: Du arbeitest nach Direct-Response-Logik und liest die wichtigsten Kennzahlen selbst.
  • Monat 3: Du verantwortest eigene Tests, von der Idee bis zur Auswertung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Bewertungen, Kommentare und Kundenumfragen auswerten und die Sätze finden, mit denen unsere Kunden selbst über Skinbro sprechen
  • Skripte für Video-Ads schreiben, erst mit Begleitung, dann eigenständig
  • Anzeigentexte und Headlines für Meta schreiben und in Varianten testen
  • Produktseiten, Landingpages und E-Mails mittexten
  • Wöchentlich mit uns auf die Ergebnisse schauen und daraus lernen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Arbeitsproben, die zeigen, dass du schreiben oder erzählen kannst: Artikel, Werbetexte, Drehbücher, Newsletter, Posts oder Bühnenprogramme
  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Kommunikation, Journalismus, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder Marketing, oder vergleichbare Erfahrung
  • Gespür für Sprache, Rhythmus und Pointen
  • Du begeisterst dich für Social-Media-Content und Verkaufspsychologie
  • Du nimmst Feedback auf und lieferst die nächste Version am selben Tag
  • Offenheit für KI-Tools beim Recherchieren, Texten und Variieren
  • Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

Deine Benefits

  • Faires Festgehalt, über das wir im ersten Gespräch offen sprechen
  • Klarer Lernpfad in Direct Response Marketing, einer der gefragtesten Fähigkeiten im E-Commerce
  • Lerne von den Besten: Trainings und modernste KI-Lösungen
  • Deine Texte gehen live und du siehst jede Woche, was sie bewirken
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office in Hamburg, moderne KI-Tools, Skinbro-Produkte für dich und dein Umfeld

Haben wir dich überzeugt?

Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben und einem kurzen Video von 60 bis 90 Sekunden statt Anschreiben. Im Video erzählst du uns die beste Geschichte, die dir je jemand über ein Produkt erzählt hat, und warum sie funktioniert hat. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Service mit Persönlichkeit
descriptionHtml:
Du liebst persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Bei uns verbindest du ihn mit internationalen Aufgaben und der Chance, beruflich weiterzukommen.

Wir sind Akademis, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsberatung. Wir helfen Familien, das passende Internat im Ausland für ihr Kind zu finden, und begleiten sie bei den nächsten Schritten. Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau suchen wir jemanden, der gerne telefoniert, aufmerksam zuhört und Freude daran hat, sich persönlich um Menschen zu kümmern.

Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Sie schätzen eine Ansprechperson, die ihre Wünsche kennt, verständlich erklärt und zuverlässig nachfasst. Genau das lieben wir an unserer Arbeit: wenn aus einem ersten Gespräch eine vertraute Zusammenarbeit wird und Eltern wissen, dass sie sich auf uns verlassen können.

Vielleicht arbeitest du bisher in der Hotellerie, in der Gästebetreuung oder im Kundenservice und möchtest deine Erfahrung in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen. Bei uns bist du als Quereinsteiger herzlich willkommen. Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf sind uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Verlässlichkeit und deine Freude daran, Familien und junge Menschen zu begleiten.

Du möchtest dich einbringen und beruflich weiterkommen? Wir arbeiten dich persönlich ein und unterstützen dich dabei, deine eigenen Familien zunehmend selbstständig zu betreuen. In unserem kleinen Team kannst du Abläufe mitgestalten und mehr Verantwortung übernehmen. Mit deiner fachlichen Entwicklung und guten Leistungen soll sich auch dein Gehalt weiterentwickeln

Aufgaben

Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen.

Beziehungen zu internationalen Partnerschulen pflegen: Du kommunizierst auf Englisch mit unseren Partnerschulen, klärst Fragen und stimmst Anforderungen und Abläufe ab. Dabei baust du persönliche Kontakte und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf.

Eigene Projekte gestalten und umsetzen: Du übernimmst Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, bringst Ideen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit uns Abläufe. Ziele und Zuständigkeiten legen wir zusammen fest.

Profil

Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du hältst Zusagen ein, bringst Aufgaben nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig zum Abschluss und sprichst Schwierigkeiten frühzeitig an.

Du denkst mit und packst an: Du erkennst, wo dein Beitrag gebraucht wird, unterstützt dein Team und möchtest unser kleines Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten. Eigene Ideen bringst du ein und hilfst dabei, sie umzusetzen.

Du gehst neue Herausforderungen offen an: Du arbeitest dich engagiert in neue Themen ein, stellst gezielte Fragen und entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten weiter.

Du verbindest Sorgfalt mit Tempo: Du arbeitest konzentriert und zügig, setzt Prioritäten und behältst parallele Anliegen im Blick. Unterlagen, Daten und Termine prüfst du gewissenhaft auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit. Du hältst Absprachen nachvollziehbar fest und kontrollierst deine Ergebnisse, bevor du sie weitergibst.

Du berätst mit Einfühlungsvermögen: Du telefonierst ausgesprochen gerne, hörst aufmerksam zu und stellst dich auf unterschiedliche Menschen ein. Du nimmst die Wünsche und Sorgen von Eltern und Jugendlichen ernst und kommunizierst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen herzlich, klar und professionell.

Du arbeitest an Lösungen: Du benennst Probleme klar, überlegst, was du selbst zu ihrer Lösung beitragen kannst, und beziehst rechtzeitig die Unterstützung ein, die du brauchst.

Du bleibst respektvoll und direkt: Du sprichst Meinungsverschiedenheiten sachlich mit den Beteiligten an und trägst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen zu einer konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit bei.

Du nutzt Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung: Du gehst offen mit eigenen Fehlern und sachlichen Rückmeldungen um, setzt berechtigte Hinweise um und gibst selbst respektvoll Feedback.

Außerdem sprichst und schreibst du sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch und gehst sicher mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln um. Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Betreuung oder Organisation ist hilfreich. Unsere Partnerschulen und die Besonderheiten der Internatsberatung lernst du während deiner Einarbeitung kennen.

Wir bieten

Persönliche Einarbeitung: Wir begleiten deinen Einstieg. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Familien, Aufgaben und Projekte.

Ein wertschätzendes Miteinander: Direkter Austausch, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Raum für Fragen und Ideen gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag.

Klare Erwartungen und regelmäßige Rückmeldung: Wir vereinbaren konkrete Ziele für Betreuung, Organisation und Projekte und unterstützen deine Entwicklung.

Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eigene Ideen umsetzen, Abläufe mitentwickeln und mit wachsender Erfahrung weitere Verantwortung übernehmen.

Karriere- und Gehaltsperspektiven: Wir möchten, dass du dich langfristig bei uns weiterentwickelst. Mit wachsender Kompetenz, guten Leistungen und zusätzlicher Verantwortung hast du die Möglichkeit, beruflich voranzukommen und auch dein Gehalt zu steigern. Deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Fortbildungen und internationale Einblicke: Du baust dein Wissen aus, arbeitest mit internationalen Partnerschulen zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, an internationalen Branchenveranstaltungen teilzunehmen.

Eine langfristige Festanstellung: Du arbeitest 40 Stunden pro Woche, Montag bis Freitag, an fünf Tagen in unserem Büro in Berlin-Frohnau.

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Associate Director (Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe)
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ327R343

Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. This role is based in Zurich, Switzerland and will work with our customers across the Central region.

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field enablement – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

  • Strong enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.
  • Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

  • Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

  • Architecture

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

  • You get excited when working with a ton of data

  • Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

  • Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

  • Former founder

  • Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

title: Logistics Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Logistics Officer owns the daily inbound and outbound logistics function across Harmattan AI’s two French sites — the Wissous production facility and the Paris engineering office. Reporting to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead, the role operates with significant autonomy: independently managing freight flows, customs compliance, dangerous goods, and international trade requirements without requiring hand-holding on routine decisions.

This is not a pure execution role. The Logistics Officer brings senior operational experience and the judgement to run the function independently day-to-day — escalating where needed, but owning the full logistics picture between escalations. The right candidate has seen enough complexity — military goods, DG shipments, ITAR — to handle it confidently and knows when something requires attention from the Lead.

Responsibilities

Inbound Logistics

  • Own inbound freight flows for both sites — booking, tracking, customs clearance, and goods receipt for components, materials, and equipment

  • Proactively manage supplier and forwarder relationships to resolve delays and protect the Wissous production schedule

  • Process import documentation, verify HS/CN classification, and coordinate with customs brokers to ensure clean clearance

  • Escalate supply disruptions and compliance flags to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead with structured context and a proposed resolution

Outbound Logistics

  • Manage outbound shipments to customers, integrators, programme offices, demonstrations, and trade events — from booking through to proof of delivery

  • Prepare complete export documentation — commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, export declarations, and end-user certificates

  • Manage temporary export regimes and ATA carnets for demonstration and event shipments, including tracking and timely return

  • Independently assess ITAR, EAR, and EU/French dual-use export control requirements for each outbound shipment — applying the correct treatment and flagging licence requirements before despatch

Dangerous Goods

  • Independently classify, prepare, and document dangerous goods shipments under ADR, IATA DGR, and IMDG — lithium batteries (UN 3480/3481), propellants, and other regulated materials

  • Ensure packaging, labelling, marking, and documentation are correct on every DG movement without requiring supervision

  • Monitor freight partner compliance with DG handling standards and raise issues to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead

Customs & Trade Compliance

  • Apply confident working knowledge of HS/CN tariff codes, incoterms, and customs regimes to ensure accurate and complete declarations

  • Maintain full compliance records — export licences, end-user certificates, DG records, and customs documentation — to audit standard

  • Stay current on changes to ITAR, EAR, EU dual-use regulations, and customs procedures relevant to Harmattan AI’s trade lanes

Site Coordination & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate goods flows between Wissous and Paris, ensuring accurate stock transfers, documentation, and storage standards for military hardware and dangerous goods

  • Identify process gaps, recurring issues, or compliance risks in the logistics function and bring structured improvement proposals to the Logistics & Warehouse Lead

  • Work closely with production, supply chain, and engineering teams to align logistics priorities with operational needs

Candidate Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in freight, logistics, or supply chain in a regulated industry — defence, aerospace, advanced electronics, or similar

  • Able to operate the inbound/outbound logistics function independently — making sound daily decisions on customs, DG, and compliance without close supervision

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of customs documentation: HS/CN classification, import/export declarations, incoterms, and freight procedures across Europe, the US, and the Middle East

  • Direct working experience with ITAR, EAR, and EU/French dual-use export control regulations applied to physical shipments

  • Certified and experienced in dangerous goods — IATA DGR, ADR, or equivalent — with specific experience on lithium batteries and military-relevant materials

  • Familiarity with military goods logistics: packaging, marking, documentation, and transport standards for defence hardware

  • Detail-oriented, compliance-driven, and calm under time pressure

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken

Preferred

  • Experience with temporary export regimes, ATA carnets, and trade event logistics

  • Familiarity with ERP or WMS systems (Odoo or equivalent)

  • Experience coordinating logistics across multiple sites

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
