title: Manager, Analytics, UK
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3263 - Manager, Analytics, UK

Role Summary and Impact

ABOUT OPENDOOR & MGM

At WPP, we're constantly reinventing the future of creativity, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and expertise across communications, media, experience, commerce, technology and entertainment marketing.

That philosophy sits at the heart of OpenDoor's partnership with MGM, Amazon's iconic film studio. For more than a century, MGM has shaped some of the world's most recognised stories, franchises and cinematic moments. Today, as part of Amazon, it combines Hollywood legacy with the scale, innovation and customer obsession of one of the world's most influential entertainment companies.

MGM's future slate reflects this unique position, bringing audiences a diverse portfolio of theatrical releases and cultural moments. Upcoming titles such as Verity, The Thomas Crown Affair, The Sheep Detective, Masters of the Universe, and The Beekeeper 2 show the breadth of MGM's ambitions across adaptations, franchises, action blockbusters and original storytelling.

OpenDoor was built to help MGM maximise the impact of these moments. By combining WPP's talent, capabilities and technology, we create integrated solutions that connect media, creative, data, strategy, commerce and measurement into a seamless operating model. Our role extends beyond campaign execution to helping MGM understand audiences, optimise investment, measure business impact and build long-term cultural relevance.

The OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next-level productivity through our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms and Process. Drawing expertise from across WPP agencies and disciplines, our teams work closely with MGM stakeholders to unlock smarter, faster and more effective ways of bringing stories to audiences worldwide.

By joining OpenDoor, you become part of a team operating at the intersection of entertainment, technology, media and creativity. You'll work alongside leading industry talent while supporting one of the world's most exciting film studios as it enters its next chapter, helping shape how audiences discover and engage with stories that define culture.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are searching for an analytically ambitious, detail-oriented analytics specialist with a genuine passion for film and entertainment to join our OpenDoor team as Manager, Trailer & Campaign Analytics – MGM. This role reports into the Global Director of Insights for MGM and is based in London.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role focused on building and scaling the analytics infrastructure for trailer performance and in-flight campaign measurement across MGM's theatrical release slate and global marketing operations. You will own the end-to-end setup and delivery of automated trailer reporting systems, working with the team to establish benchmarks, build learnings, and continuously optimize campaign performance through data-driven insights.

What makes this role distinctive is the opportunity to build measurement discipline from the ground up for two critical areas: pre-launch trailer analytics and real-time in-flight campaign monitoring. You'll inherit foundational frameworks and collaborate with the broader Measurement team to enhance these with attention measurement, creative A/B testing, and social listening capabilities. You're expected to identify opportunities for automation and agent-assisted reporting that will scale insights over time — contributing directly to the efficiency and impact of MGM's global theatrical marketing operation.

This role operates at the intersection of Paid Media measurement, Cultural Impact analytics, Creative Performance, and multi-platform reporting — translating performance data into clear, actionable insights that directly inform investment and optimization decisions across MGM's theatrical release calendar. The scope is global with particular focus on key markets, informing measurement practice and learning agendas that shape how MGM launches its most ambitious stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Establish & Run Trailer Analytics Reporting

  • Design, build, and operationalize automated trailer performance reporting across all format variants (teaser, full trailer, format cuts) and distribution platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc.)
  • Establish standardized reporting cadence: 24-hour, 72-hour, and 7-day performance snapshots for all trailer launches across key territories and global markets
  • Define and build trailer-level KPI frameworks (view velocity, engagement rates, audience retention, CPA, brand lift signals) and communicate performance against pre-established benchmarks
  • Integrate territory-level performance data to identify which markets are responding strongest to creative approaches, messaging, and format variants
  • Support the development of automated reporting pipelines and dashboards that enable stakeholders to self-serve key insights between formal reports

Integrate Social Listening & Cultural Impact Measurement

  • Deploy social listening tools (Brandwatch, Talkwalker, or equivalent) to track organic conversation, sentiment, and cultural momentum around trailer launches
  • Combine organic social signals with paid media performance to build a holistic view of trailer impact across both channels
  • Identify emerging cultural moments, audience conversations, and competitive dynamics that materially affect trailer performance and audience receptivity
  • Generate weekly cultural impact summaries that accompany trailer performance data, providing context beyond metrics
  • Use these insights to advise creative and media teams on what's resonating, what's falling flat, and where optimization is needed pre-launch and in real-time

Support Attention Measurement & Creative Testing

  • Collaborate with the Measurement team to integrate attention metrics (eye-tracking, dwell time, brand recall diagnostics) into in-flight campaign analysis
  • Work with media planning and creative teams to design and interpret A/B tests on creative variants, messaging approaches, and media placements
  • Translate attention and creative testing outputs into clear performance narratives that inform mid-campaign optimization and creative recommendations for future campaigns

Benchmark Performance & Inform Strategic Planning

  • Establish and maintain a comparative benchmarking framework for trailer and campaign performance, comparing each title against historical performance, competitive context, and similar content archetypes
  • Produce quarterly comparative analysis documenting how each title is tracking vs. benchmark, highlighting where performance is tracking ahead/behind and why
  • Generate longitudinal learning summaries that synthesize insights across multiple title campaigns, identifying patterns in what drives trailer and campaign effectiveness
  • Work closely with the Global Director of Analytics to translate findings into broader patterns and insights that inform MGM's next-generation campaign planning
  • Advise on investment decisions for upcoming titles based on similar historical performance and learnings from comparable campaigns

Build Analytics Infrastructure & Automation Opportunities

  • Identify opportunities to automate routine reporting, data integration, and insight generation — reducing manual effort and accelerating insight delivery
  • Document data sources, methodologies, and reporting logic to create reusable frameworks for future title campaigns
  • Collaborate with the broader OpenDoor technology and analytics teams to explore agent-assisted or AI-enhanced reporting approaches that could scale insights over time

Partner Across Functions

  • Work hand-in-hand with Media Planning, Paid Social, and Creative teams to ensure measurement insights directly inform campaign strategy and optimization
  • Provide clear, accessible reporting that enables non-analytics stakeholders to understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Represent the Measurement function in campaign planning and review forums, ensuring data informs decisions from strategy through execution and optimization
  • Contribute to the development of measurement playbooks and best practice frameworks that raise the standard of analytics across the OpenDoor network
  • Operate effectively within a matrixed structure, reporting into the Global Lead of Analytics with a dotted line into the MGM Measurement Lead

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilise the Enterprise

We are looking for:

Essential:

  • Experience in marketing analytics, media measurement, campaign analytics, or performance marketing — preferably in entertainment, film, streaming, or media environments
  • Genuine passion for film, cinema, and storytelling — you actively engage with cinema, understand audience behavior around theatrical releases, and can speak credibly about what makes trailers and film marketing campaigns work
  • Demonstrated expertise in multi-platform analytics, with hands-on experience building performance dashboards, tracking KPIs across media channels, and reporting on campaign effectiveness
  • Practical experience with social listening and brand monitoring tools (Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, or equivalent), with the ability to translate social signals into business insights
  • Strong Excel, SQL, and data visualization skills — you're comfortable manipulating datasets, building reporting models, and creating clear visual narratives from complex data
  • Experience building or owning end-to-end reporting frameworks for marketing campaigns or product launches, including defining metrics, establishing benchmarks, and automating routine reporting
  • Ability to translate analytical findings into clear, executive-ready communication — written, verbal, and visual — without sacrificing accuracy or nuance
  • Familiarity with media measurement fundamentals, including paid media KPIs, CPA/ROI analysis, channel attribution, and performance benchmarking
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments, collaborating with media planning, creative, content, and strategy teams
  • Strong commercial instinct — you understand how measurement insights drive investment decisions and can connect data to business impact

Desirable:

  • Experience working on film releases, theatrical campaigns, or tentpole title launches, where rapid reporting cycles and multi-platform complexity are the norm
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms or analytics tools that support real-time campaign monitoring and optimization
  • Exposure to A/B testing methodologies and experimental design in a marketing context
  • Familiarity with brand health tracking or brand lift measurement
  • Experience with AI-assisted analytics tools, automated reporting pipelines, or agent-based approaches to data synthesis
  • Active engagement with industry bodies such as the IPA, MRS, or the Media Research Group
  • Evidence of thought leadership or speaking experience on topics related to media analytics, campaign measurement, or entertainment marketing
  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where you've delivered at scale

LIFE AT WPP MEDIA & BENEFITS

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location. This position is a 12-month fixed-term contract to cover a period of maternity leave, with a proposed start date of [DATE].

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

title: Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Purpose

The Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation will be the functional owner responsible for both the strategic evolution and the daily operational execution of Checkout.com’s Procurement and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) functions.

The role is structured across four core pillars:

  • Transformation: Setting the long-term vision, target operating model, and multi-year transformation initiatives, roadmaps, business cases, and cost-benefit analyses across all operating model components: Service Delivery Model, People, Process, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Operations: Managing the day-to-day Procurement Operations team, monitoring functional health, data quality, and operational metrics, as well as eliminating bottlenecks and escalations across sourcing and corporate travel.

  • Business Partnering: Acting as the primary strategic bridge between Procurement and core business functions (Technology, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and People) to ensure cross-functional alignment and service delivery.

  • Program Management & Governance: Leading programmatic execution, centralizing compliance and regulatory inputs, servicing audit requirements, and managing functional roadmaps with support teams.

The primary objective is to modernize Procurement and TPRM into high-performing service functions delivering superior customer experience, strict SLAs, advanced automation, and scalable tooling architectures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation & Operating Model Strategy

  • Define and execute the global strategy, target operating model, and vision across all Procurement & TPRM components: Service Delivery Model, Process, People, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Map strategy into prioritized roadmaps supported by concrete business cases and cost-benefit analyses.

  • Define the functional AI and automation strategy, sponsoring the delivery of automated capabilities in partnership with Technology to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Establish and monitor core operational metrics, KPIs, and SLAs to track function health, service quality, and risk posture.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to drive end-to-end Source-to-Pay process optimization and touchless execution.

2. Operational Leadership & Escalation Management

  • Lead and manage the Procurement Operations team, ensuring category management teams receive required data, analytics, and operational support.

  • Own vendor master data governance to maintain maximum accuracy and integrity across downstream systems and reporting.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for operational blockers across Procurement, corporate travel, and P2P handoffs.

  • Maintain functional relationships with platform providers and monitor tooling health, releases, and integrations in collaboration with Technology.

3. Tooling Ecosystem Ownership

  • Zip: Act as joint business owner with Accounts Payable, functionally managing intake-to-contract workflows, vendor onboarding, and P2P handoffs.

  • OneTrust: Functionally own TPRM risk assessment workflows and vendor risk oversight.

  • Navan: Functionally oversee corporate travel management tools, user support, and policy administration.

  • Partner with Technology on business requirement definitions (BRDs), backlog prioritization, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

4. Regulatory, Compliance & Audit Enablement

  • Act as the functional Procurement lead for internal and external audits, SOX controls, and regulatory assessments.

  • Deliver operational support for global market expansion, ensuring supply-chain and TPRM standards satisfy new market license applications and regulatory filings.

  • Programmatically centralize, manage, and track regulatory, audit, and compliance inputs and remediation actions across the team.

Requirements

  • Transformation & Operating Model Leadership: Proven track record designing, delivering, and scaling target operating models, large-scale procurement transformations, and process re-engineering in fast-paced enterprise environments.

  • Procurement Operations & People Management: Demonstrated experience leading a Procurement Operations team, driving daily operational discipline, and resolving cross-functional bottlenecks.

  • Tooling & Digital Enablement: Hands-on functional ownership, administration, or implementation experience with modern enterprise platforms: Zip, OneTrust, and Navan (or comparable modern P2P and TPRM tools).

  • Automation & AI Strategy: Proven ability to identify, scope, and sponsor automation and AI initiatives, partnering closely with Technology and Engineering to deliver technical solutions.

  • TPRM & Regulatory Governance: Strong background in Third-Party Risk Management frameworks, regulatory compliance requirements, and audit management.

  • Program Management: Strong capability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programmatic roadmaps and drive alignment across Finance, Legal, Risk, and Technology.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operating Model Transformation: Multi-year transformation roadmap is executed efficiently, delivering measurable productivity gains and modernizing the functional architecture across Procurement and TPRM.

  • Automation & AI Execution: Automation and AI use cases are successfully delivered alongside Technology, driving touchless handoffs, faster cycle times, and optimized workflows.

  • Operational Excellence: Operational SLAs and KPIs are consistently achieved, vendor master data maintains high integrity, and operational bottlenecks are rapidly resolved.

  • Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Zero critical audit findings across Procurement and TPRM operations, with dependable operational execution for international license applications and filings.

  • High-Performing Operations Team: An engaged, well-structured Procurement Operations team that consistently provides reliable, high-quality operational support to category managers and internal stakeholders.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Manager Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

As Manager Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering, you are accountable for translating the company quality strategy into effective governance, measurable objectives, and consistent execution across the organization. You will provide independent quality leadership, ensure customer and certification requirements are embedded into business processes, and maintain clear visibility of organizational quality performance.

This role is not limited to maintaining procedures or reacting to non-conformances. It is about building a prevention-focused quality system, strengthening engineering and operational decision-making, and ensuring the organization remains ready for customer, regulatory, and certification scrutiny as products and production scale.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Implement and continuously develop the company quality strategy in alignment with business, product, and operational priorities.
  • Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering function, establishing clear ownership, priorities, standards, and development plans.
  • Define, deploy, and monitor quality objectives, KPIs, and improvement targets across the organization.
  • Prepare and facilitate management reviews, ensuring quality performance, risks, trends, and required decisions are clearly presented and followed through.
  • Own customer quality governance, including quality requirements, customer interfaces, escalations, reporting, and the coordination of customer quality reviews.
  • Act as the primary quality interface to certification bodies and coordinate certification, surveillance, and recertification activities.
  • Establish quality planning and assurance approaches for products, projects, processes, and organizational changes.
  • Provide Quality Engineering leadership for risk prevention, including FMEA, control plans, process capability, measurement strategy, and verification planning.
  • Govern non-conformance, corrective action, and preventive action processes, ensuring root causes are addressed and actions are effective.
  • Drive cross-functional resolution of systemic quality issues and ensure lessons learned are translated into standards and preventive controls.
  • Monitor organizational quality performance and provide transparent reporting to senior leadership on compliance, customer quality, product quality, and improvement priorities.
  • Partner with Product Assurance, Supplier Quality, Production, Engineering, and the Chief Quality Inspector organization to ensure clear interfaces and end-to-end quality governance.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Product Quality, or Quality Management within aerospace, space, defence, automotive, or another highly regulated engineering environment.
  • Proven leadership experience managing quality teams and influencing cross-functional organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of EN 9100 / AS9100, ISO 9001, and risk-based quality management principles; familiarity with ECSS requirements is advantageous.
  • Experience working with customers, certification bodies, auditors, and senior management on quality performance and compliance topics.
  • Practical knowledge of quality planning, FMEA, control plans, process capability, root cause analysis, corrective action, and structured problem-solving methods.
  • Experience defining quality objectives, management review inputs, KPIs, and organizational quality performance reporting.
  • Ability to balance independent assurance with pragmatic support for engineering and manufacturing execution.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to challenge decisions, escalate risks, and drive accountability.
  • Clear, concise communication and professional proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.

Aim high, deliver relentlessly, act with integrity, and keep the mission first.

title: Marketing Manager Digital & Lead Generation (m/w/d) / B2B / Energiewirtschaft / 50-60
descriptionHtml:
Du baust lieber Kampagnen, die Kunden bringen, als Präsentationen darüber, wie man Kunden gewinnen könnte?

Dann haben wir einen Job, der dir gefallen dürfte.

Stell dir vor, du startest eine Google-Ads-Kampagne, optimierst die Landingpage und siehst anschließend, welche Anfragen tatsächlich zu Kunden werden.

Kein Marketing, das nur Klicks und Impressionen feiert. Sondern Marketing, dessen Beitrag zum Umsatz sichtbar wird.

Unser Kunde ist ein wirtschaftlich starkes B2B-Unternehmen aus der Energiewirtschaft. Seit über 15 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt, mit einem eingespielten Vertrieb aus Callcenter und bundesweit tätigen Key Account Managern.

Die telefonische Neukundengewinnung funktioniert bereits.

Jetzt soll ein zweiter Kanal wachsen: digitale Leadgenerierung, die messbar neue Kunden bringt.

Die ersten Google-Ads-Aktivitäten und Landingpages gibt es bereits. Was fehlt, ist jemand, der das Thema intern übernimmt, weiterentwickelt und selbst mit anpackt.

Und genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Aufgaben – von der ersten Kampagne bis zum neuen Kunden

  • Du entwickelst digitale Kampagnen: Du baust Google Ads, Landingpages und Formulare auf, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst die Conversion.

  • Du machst Marketing messbar: Du richtest das Tracking ein und sorgst dafür, dass Anfragen sauber im CRM ankommen. Gemeinsam mit Sales Operations wertest du aus, welche Leads zu Abschlüssen führen.

  • Du steuerst externe Partner: Du briefst Dienstleister, prüfst Ergebnisse und entscheidest mit, welche Aufgaben intern oder extern umgesetzt werden.

  • Du entwickelst weitere Wege zur Kundengewinnung: Du kümmerst dich um Messen, Mailings sowie Kooperationen mit Verbänden und Partnern.

  • Du erstellst Inhalte, die Interesse wecken: Du entwickelst Newsletter, Website-Texte und Fallbeispiele, die potenzielle Kunden überzeugen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Das ist uns wichtig:

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der B2B-Leadgenerierung oder im Performance Marketing und weißt, woran sich erfolgreiche Kampagnen messen lassen.

  • Du hast Google Ads, Landingpages und Conversion-Tracking bereits selbst umgesetzt und optimiert.

  • Du kannst eigenständig arbeiten, Prioritäten setzen und Projekte von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis voranbringen.

  • Du verstehst, dass ein guter Lead nicht bei einem ausgefüllten Formular endet, sondern erst für den Vertrieb wertvoll werden muss.

Das wäre ein Plus:

  • Du kommst aus einer Agentur oder hast bereits externe Dienstleister gesteuert.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Newslettern, Marketing Automation oder SEO.

  • Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft oder hast schon Messen und Partnermarketing betreut.

Und auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Member of Marketing Staff - Marketing Manager (Demand Generation)
descriptionHtml:
About Tessl

AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next.

We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests.

By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale.

Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart.

Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Demand Generation Manager to build and scale Tessl’s growth engine.

You’ll own pipeline creation across channels — from experimentation to execution. This is a hands-on, data-driven individual contributor role focused on building repeatable, measurable demand in a developer-first market.

You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Content, and Sales to ensure we’re attracting the right audiences and converting attention into high-quality pipeline.

If you love testing hypotheses, building systems from scratch, and turning signal into scalable growth, this role is for you..

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline Strategy & Execution

  • Own demand generation strategy across paid, organic, partnerships, and community channels

  • Build and optimise multi-channel campaigns aligned to product launches and GTM priorities

  • Drive MQL → SQL pipeline growth with clear attribution and reporting

Experimentation & Optimisation

  • Run rapid growth experiments across paid media, landing pages, email, and content distribution

  • Manage budget allocation across channels based on performance

  • Improve conversion rates across the funnel

Performance & Analytics

  • Define and track core growth metrics (CAC, CPL, conversion rates, pipeline contribution)

  • Build dashboards and reporting frameworks

  • Use data to continuously refine strategy

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Marketing on launch amplification

  • Align with Sales on ICP targeting and pipeline quality

  • Work with Content to maximise distribution and reach

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

  • 4–8+ years in demand generation or growth marketing (B2B SaaS preferred)

  • Experience owning paid acquisition and multi-channel campaigns

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with attribution models

  • Demonstrated success building pipeline in early-stage or high-growth environments

  • Bias for action and experimentation mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience marketing to developers or technical audiences

  • Familiarity with PLG + sales-assisted hybrid funnels

  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM tooling (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce)

Application Process

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager interview

  3. Practical growth case discussion

  4. Cross-functional interviews

  5. Final conversation with leadership

Life at Tessl

We want Tessl to be a place where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and enjoy being part of the team. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits designed to support you both inside and outside work.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity: Market-benchmarked salaries and EMI share options.

  • Time off: 25 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays, and two paid volunteering days each year.

  • Private healthcare: Vitality medical insurance, including dental, optical and mental health support, with cover included for partners and dependants.

  • Pension: A 5% employer pension matched contribution through Smart Pension.

  • Life assurance: Company-paid life insurance with MetLife providing cover of four times your annual salary.

  • Family Leave: We offer enhanced Maternity, Parental and Adoption Leave from day one to support you and your growing family.

  • Learning and development: We support opportunities to continue developing your skills with a £1,000 per year to spend.

  • Commuting benefits: Financial support for eligible team members commuting from outside Greater London, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Summer & winter offsites: Twice a year, we bring the whole Tessl team together for a week-long offsite. It's a chance to step away from our usual routines, collaborate on big ideas, build stronger relationships and enjoy shared experiences together. And of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

Our London HQ

Our office is in the heart of King's Cross, surrounded by London's growing AI and technology community.

We work together in person on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, giving us time to collaborate, exchange ideas and build relationships. You'll also enjoy catered lunches (Tuesday & Thursday), plenty of office snacks, regular team lunches and socials, plus a pet-friendly workplace.

How we work

Our operating principles shape how we collaborate and make decisions. We move quickly and learn by doing, build on ideas before challenging them, get stuck in wherever we can help, and give people real ownership. We encourage thoughtful debate, curiosity and a willingness to try things that haven't been done before. Read our five operating principles.

We're AI native

AI isn't just what we're building - it's central to how we work every day, across every function. We actively use AI to improve how we work, solve problems and challenge traditional ways of doing things.

You don't need to be an AI expert to thrive at Tessl, but you do need curiosity, an appetite for experimentation and a willingness to embrace new ways of working. We expect everyone to use AI regularly, invest time in learning how to get the most from it and keep experimenting when something doesn't work the first time, rather than defaulting to manual approaches.

We're also big believers in sharing what we learn. We encourage transparency about how we're using AI, what's working, what isn't and how we can help each other improve. Being AI native doesn't mean removing human judgement, it means using AI thoughtfully, while taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of our work.

Everyone is welcome at Tessl

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.

We particularly welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in technology. If you're excited about the opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to make the process accessible and comfortable.

Come build with us

We're moving fast, experimenting boldly and figuring things out as we go. There's plenty to build, lots to learn and real opportunities to make your mark.

If you're excited by big ideas, enjoy getting stuck in and want to be part of something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Operations analyst - Transfers
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid with 2 days a week in our Edinburgh or Bath office

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform that’s on a mission to helping more people to invest – and invest well.

 

We’re B-Corp certified with an amazing product-market fit, impressive early traction and the potential to transform an outdated industry, for the better. We've been growing fast and will scale even faster over the next few years.

 

We’re also proud to be part of Octopus, the £multi billion group that's on a mission to breathe new life into broken industries, through companies like Octopus Energy, Octopus Investments and Octopus Money.

 

Check out the Seccl website for the latest on our products and our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for an Operations analyst to join our Transfers team, where you’ll be responsible for processing transfers accurately and on time across multiple wrapper types. This is a fast paced and varied role that will require you to adapt quickly to changing priorities, move seamlessly between different tasks and processes, and stay focused in a busy operational environment.

You’ll balance pace with precision, managing competing demands while consistently delivering high quality outcomes. Working closely with colleagues across Operations and our customer facing teams, you’ll help processes run efficiently and resolve queries and issues within agreed service levels. Alongside day to day processing, you’ll use your operational knowledge and experience to improve processes, reduce risk and support automation, helping us build a more scalable and resilient operations function for the future.

 

On a typical day you will be…

  • Supporting your Senior analyst with regular business reporting

  • An analytical problem solver, delivery focussed and a trusted member of the team, you will support the wider business by answering queries in a timely manner

  • Investigating and taking end to end ownership of our transfer processes. Ensuring issues are resolved in line with regulatory and customer agreed SLAs

  • Reviewing operational workflow and, where possible, suggesting process improvements

  • Working closely with the customer, product and engineering teams to explore better ways of working and to support our scalability

  • Supporting with training for new members of the team

  • Supporting other areas of Operations as and when required

 

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a good understanding of the platform industry

  • You have proven experience in handling transfers efficiently

  • You have the ability to identify, analyse and resolve any complex issues working to strict deadlines

  • You have good domain knowledge of investment platforms, particularly knowledge of the CASS environment

  • You have strong communication and organisation skills with the ability to describe to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

     

What’s in it for you…

 

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

 

💰 A salary between £30,000 and £35,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

 

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager

  • Second stage – one-hour technical interview or assessment

     

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

 

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

title: Partnerships Lead, Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partnerships Lead, Southern Europe to lead our partner sales and development team for Southern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Southern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production.

  • Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners.

  • Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and aligning account or territory coverage across a region.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional partner sales or co-sell business at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience aligning sales and partner delivery organisations to support enterprise implementations and sustained production adoption.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms, modern cloud architectures, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise procurement models.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. title: Performance Marketer, Paid Search
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We're looking for a hands-on paid marketer to run search and display across Google, Microsoft, The Trade Desk and emerging channels such as ChatGPT ads. You'll build agents with Lovable that read performance, move budgets, catch issues, and make changes. This is an IC role for someone senior who likes being in the detail and building the machine, not just operating it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years running paid search and display channels. You've owned significant budgets across Google, you know your way around Microsoft Ads, and you've worked in at least one DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk).

  • Automation-led. You don't do by hand what a script or an agent could do. You've built automations for reporting, budget pacing, or optimisation, and you're comfortable with platform APIs and pulling your own data.

  • A social-creative scaler. You understand social scales on creative, and you can keep a diversified asset pipeline moving with the creative team. You've taken a paid social channel from small to large and kept it efficient on the way up.

  • Efficiency-minded. You think in CAC and payback, and you can tell efficient growth from spend that just looks like growth.

  • Hands-on by choice. You'd rather be in the account driving impact than in a deck. You like the detail, and you build things yourself.

  • Already building with AI. You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.

  • Technical spiking. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.

What you’ll do

  • Run paid search and display end to end. Own the channels across Google, Microsoft, The Trade Desk and emerging AI surfaces like ChatGPT Ads. You set the account structure, the bids, the budgets, and the targets.

  • Automate the day-to-day. Build agents and automations with Lovable that read performance, pace and shift budgets, flag issues before they cost us, and make the changes. The goal is a paid program that mostly runs itself, with you steering.

  • Scale through creative. Keep a steady supply of diversified assets in market, and know which creative to push when. You've scaled Youtube before, so you know volume and variety are what keep it working.

  • Go programmatic where it pays. Use a DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk) to extend into prospecting, retargeting, and new inventory, and hold the same efficiency bar there as everywhere else.

  • Protect the signal. This is where your technical depth shows up, and you deliver it yourself rather than handing it to a data team. Build and debug the tracking (server-side/CAPI, pixels, cookies, consent, and deduplication), and write the queries that judge channels on incrementality instead of platform-reported ROAS alone.

  • Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, bids, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

descriptionHtml:

Du schaltest die Anzeige, baust Dir mit Claude den Workflow dazu und weißt am nächsten Morgen, welche Variante gewinnt. Wie Marketing bei uns läuft, entscheidest Du. Fließendes Deutsch und ein sicheres Gefühl für den lockeren Du-Ton junger Zielgruppen

Du bist spritzig: Du hast Ideen, Humor im Content und ein Gespür dafür, was gerade funktioniert!

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Unser Marketing wird so, wie Du es aufbaust!

descriptionHtml:
talenthafen steht für Exzellenz im modernen Recruiting.

Unser Anspruch ist es nicht, dem Markt zu folgen – sondern ihn aktiv mitzugestalten.

talenthafen ist Vorreiter in der Innovation des Recruitings.
Wir leben Fortschritt. Wir entwickeln eigene Systeme, implementieren Automatisierungen und integrieren künstliche Intelligenzen konsequent in unsere internen Prozesse und Kundenstrukturen. Dadurch schaffen wir skalierbare, messbare und nachhaltige Lösungen – und setzen neue Standards in der Branche.

Hinter diesem Anspruch steht ein starkes Fundament:
Ein Team von über 60 ambitionierten Persönlichkeiten, die unternehmerisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln wollen. Auf mehr als 900 m² Bürofläche in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld entsteht täglich die nächste Stufe moderner Personalgewinnung - sowohl menschlich als auch technisch.

Was uns besonders macht, ist nicht nur unsere Marktposition und Software, sondern die Qualität unseres Teams.

Wir arbeiten leistungsorientiert, professionell und mit klaren Standards. Hohe Ansprüche treffen bei uns auf hohe Wertschätzung: überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, echte Entwicklungsperspektiven und ein Umfeld, in dem Exzellenz gefördert wird.

talenthafen ist kein klassisches Recruiting-Unternehmen. Wir kombinieren Performance Marketing mit unserer eigenen Tech-Plattform talenthafenOS – über 70 automatisierte Workflows, die den HR-Markt neu definieren. Bootstrapped, profitabel, dreistelliges Wachstum. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Beratung und Technologie, in einem Markt, der gerade komplett umgebaut wird.

Deine Rolle: Recruiting-Kampagnen mit talenthafenOS aufsetzen, betreuen und optimieren. Du kümmerst dich um das, was am Ende über den Erfolg entscheidet – die Performance.

Aufgaben

Dein Daily Business

  • Volle Ownership für deine Kundenaccounts. Du steuerst Paid-Kampagnen auf Meta, Google & Co. für unsere Top-B2B-Kunden – von Zielgruppe über Funnel bis Skalierung. Der Erfolg der Kampagne ist deine Verantwortung, nicht die von „dem Team"

  • Proaktives Performance-Management. Du wartest nicht auf Reports oder Anweisungen – du erkennst, wenn eine Kampagne aus dem Ruder läuft, bevor sie zum Problem wird, und steuerst gegen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen Abteilungen. Die Strategieberater halten den Kundenkontakt und geben dir den nötigen Kontext – du übersetzt ihn in Kampagnen, die liefern. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen, gemeinsame Verantwortung fürs Ergebnis

  • Kanalübergreifendes Creative- und Zielgruppen-Denken. Du denkst nicht in Plattform-Silos, sondern in Zielgruppen, Botschaften und Hooks – und verstehst, wie Creative, Targeting und Daten zusammenspielen

  • Reindenken in Kunden. Jeder Kunde hat einen eigenen Markt, eigene Zielgruppen, eigene Engpässe. Du verstehst das Geschäft deiner Kunden so gut, dass deine Kampagnen-Entscheidungen strategisch begründet sind – nicht nur technisch

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Du hinterfragst laufende Setups: Welcher Kanal, welches Creative, welcher Funnel-Schritt hat noch Luft? Stillstand ist keine Option

  • KI als Hebel, nicht als Buzzword. Du nutzt unsere Plattform und moderne AI-Tools, um Recherche, Creative-Testing und Optimierung auf ein Niveau zu heben, das manuell nicht erreichbar ist – und bringst eigene Ideen mit, wie es noch besser geht

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen:

  • Erfahrung mit Paid-Kampagnen. Du hast Kampagnen schon eigenständig geplant und betreut und kennst Kampagnenstrukturen, Creative-Testing sowie die wichtigsten Bid- und Attributionslogiken
  • Datenkompetenz. Zahlen sind für dich die Grundlage jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht. Du weißt, welche KPI wann zählt
  • Eigenantrieb und Verbindlichkeit. Du brauchst niemanden, der dich anschiebt oder erinnert. Was du übernimmst, wird erledigt – in Qualität und im Zeitrahmen
  • Ein unternehmerisches Mindset. Du denkst in Hebeln und nächsten Schritten, holst dir aktiv Inspiration – aus Werbebibliotheken, anderen Märkten, neuen Formaten – und denkst über den Tellerrand deines Aufgabenzettels hinaus
  • Neugier. Du hast Lust, mit einer eigenen Software-Plattform zu arbeiten, Neues auszuprobieren und dazuzulernen

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

  • Eine eigene Recruiting-Plattform (talenthafenOS) statt Tools von der Stange

  • Eigenfinanziert, profitabel und stark wachsend

  • Spannende Kunden quer durch den DACH-Mittelstand

  • Gutes Gehalt und ein klarer Karriereplan

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team, in dem Feedback und Weiterentwicklung wirklich gelebt werden

  • Modernes Office in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld – kreativ & professionell zugleich

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung & ehrliches Mentoring

  • Offene Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege

Das bekommst du on top

  • 500€ Gesundheitsbudget oder Zuschuss zum Wellpass
  • 50€ monatlich für deine Altersvorsorge
  • MacBook – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Regelmäßige Grill- & Teamabende (alle 3 Monate)
  • Raum, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

..und alles, was halt dazu gehört (Obstkorb & Co)

Klingt nach dem nächsten Schritt für dich?

Bring gemeinsam mit talenthafen den Recruiting-Markt aufs nächste Level - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung (CV reicht – kein Anschreiben nötig)

  2. Telefonisches Erstgespräch (ca. 20 Minuten)

  3. Video-Interview mit Fachbereich

  4. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Hamburg

title: PhD Autonomy Engineer Intern - Computer Vision / Deep Learning Summer 2027
descriptionHtml:

The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. You will architect and implement the algorithms that run on every drone powered by Skydio as part of a world class computer vision and deep learning team with researchers who have pushed the state of the art in academia and industry.

As a Research Intern, you will be paired up with one or more members of our core software development team, assuming direct ownership of a project that meaningfully advances the capabilities of our team and products.

If you have a strong foundation in math, theory, and software development and you are interested in directly contributing to the development of the next generation of autonomy algorithms and pushing them into real products, we would love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Enable rapid research and development of intelligent systems with advanced autonomous capabilities beyond anything that exists in the world today

  • Research, prototype, and generally assess the feasibility of new approaches

  • Imagine and then implement new features that unlock magic for our users

  • Characterize and quantify the performance of core components of the software and hardware stack

title: Principal Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Backend Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.

The Role

As a Principal Backend Developer, you will act as a strategic technical leader, guiding and shaping robust architectures, data strategies, and cloud-native environments across multiple squads and collaborative programmes. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, making thoughtful choices that balance cost, security, performance, and user experience to help Waracle scale and deliver high-performance, world-class products.

If you are a collaborative leader who thrives on mentoring talent, fostering inclusive engineering communities, and navigating complex technical landscapes with empathy and pragmatism, we would love to welcome you to our team!

Key aspects of the role include

  • Solving Complex Technical Challenges: Partner closely with client technical and business stakeholders at all levels, gaining a deep understanding of their technology estates to advise on impactful, world-class digital solutions.

  • Technical Excellence & Delivery: Shape architectures across multiple squads; select tools and frameworks to scale across clients while optimising for cost, security, performance, and scalability.

  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted advisor to clients on technical strategy and roadmaps, translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible communication for senior stakeholders.

  • Leadership & Community Cultivation: Mentor Lead and Senior Engineers, foster and grow our engineering community of practice, and ensure cross-team alignment on technical standards.

  • Culture & Knowledge Sharing: Define and evolve Waracle’s technical standards while contributing to our shared body of knowledge through lessons learned, thought leadership, and good practices.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What You'll Bring

  • Architectural Leadership: Proven experience designing, documenting, and scaling complex back-end architectures, distributed systems, microservices, and database designs (SQL and other technologies) within cloud-native environments—particularly Azure (with a focus on API management, maintenance, and scaling).

  • Technical Direction & Delivery Ownership: Strong leadership capability to set clear technical direction, maintain a dedicated ownership mindset, and foster high-standard outcomes across complex enterprise projects.

  • Consultative Communication: Excellent communication and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex client organisations, support diverse stakeholders, and pragmatically balance commercial constraints with high technical standards.

  • Team Mentorship & Growth: A proven track record of mentoring, developing, and aligning senior engineers and technical leaders to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning and psychological safety.

  • Modern SDLC Innovation: A pragmatic, forward-thinking approach with a strong interest and enthusiasm for applying AI across the Software Development Life Cycle to enhance engineering practices and advise clients on effective adoption.

What to expect from our hiring process

1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Principal Fire Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Principal Fire Engineer to join our growing team in London. This is a technical leadership role offering the opportunity to deliver complex fire engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial, and infrastructure developments.

As a Principal Fire Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping fire safety strategies, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting business growth through strong client relationships and technical innovation. You will not only lead on some of the industry’s most exciting projects but also have a key role in shaping the future talent within our teams through mentorship and development opportunities.

Why join us to grow your career?

  • We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Denmark, Italy, and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
  • As a Principal Engineer you will be an integral part of a dynamic technical team, working with other experienced Engineers, Surveyors and teams including our Forensics division. You will work on the industry's leading technical projects.
  • Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team that always strives to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
  • You will be given early the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to achieve chartered status and offer help and support during the process

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver complex fire engineering projects from inception through to completion.
  • Develop fire strategies for a wide range of new-build and existing building projects.
  • Undertake fire safety engineering analyses, including evacuation modelling, smoke control assessments, and performance-based design solutions.
  • Provide expert advice on compliance with UK Building Regulations, Approved Document B, and relevant fire safety legislation.
  • Review and approve technical reports, calculations, and design documentation.
  • Liaise with architects, developers, contractors, approval authorities, and wider project teams.
  • Act as a technical lead and mentor for junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including client engagement, tender submissions, and project proposals.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving legislation, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Represent the business at client meetings, industry events, and technical forums.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Degree qualified in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Ideally be or working towards becoming a Chartered Engineer.
  • A background in fire engineering preferably within a consultancy environment.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus scheme.
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
  • Private healthcare.
  • Generous pension contribution.
  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Professional membership subscriptions.
  • Ongoing training and support towards professional development.
  • Clear career progression pathways.
  • A collaborative and inclusive working environment where technical excellence is valued and rewarded.
