title: Senior Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities

Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Application Mobile E-commerce (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe Data Analytics E-commerce recherche un·e Senior Data Analyst - Application Mobile E-commerce (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Paris ou Lille.

À PROPOS DE L'ÉQUIPE

L'équipe Data Analytics E-commerce (environ 10 personnes) accompagne les enjeux E-commerce de Decathlon à l'échelle internationale. Notre mission est de démocratiser la prise de décision guidée par les données pour rendre nos produits digitaux toujours plus performants, fluides et centrés sur l'utilisateur·rice. Au sein du périmètre Application Mobile, tu travailleras en proximité directe avec des équipes Produit pluridisciplinaires pour faire rayonner nos solutions et maximiser la visibilité et la performance de nos offres à travers le monde.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d) sur le scope de l'Application Mobile E-commerce, ton rôle sera d'apporter une vision analytique stratégique pour optimiser l'ensemble du funnel de conversion de l'application mobile, de l'installation au passage de commande, jusqu'aux fonctionnalités post-purchase et omnichannel.

Tes missions principales :

  • Accompagnement des équipes Produit à 360° : Être le·la partenaire clé des Product Managers tout au long des cycles de vie Produit (phases de Discovery, cadrage des KPIs, suivi des A/B tests et mesure d'impact lors du Rollout). Apporter des enseignements basés sur les données pour orienter la roadmap Produit, aider les équipes à prioriser les initiatives et mesurer la valeur des actions mises en place.
  • Production d’insights actionnables : Réaliser des études exploratoires proactives afin d'identifier des opportunités de croissance, d'optimiser l'expérience utilisateur in-app et nourrir la stratégie globale de l'application mobile en lien étroit avec le Group Product Manager.
  • Accompagnement des équipes : Partage d'insights et formation aux outils (Amplitude, Adjust) pour soutenir les équipes globales et locales dans le suivi de la performance App mobile.
  • Compréhension du Tracking, de la Tech App & de la Privacy : Définir les besoins de marquage spécifiques aux environnements iOS/Android avec les équipes Tracking tout en garantissant le respect strict des normes de conformité. Échanger avec aisance sur les problématiques techniques.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise E-commerce & Application Mobile : Connaissance solide du e-commerce dans un environnement retail et expérience prouvée sur les métriques clés et enjeux d'un environnement App mobile (iOS/Android).
  • Maîtrise de l'A/B Testing, du Tracking & de la Privacy : Expérience dans la définition et l'analyse d'A/B tests, la conception de plans de marquage et la prise en compte des contraintes de confidentialité des données.
  • Compétences Data avancées : Maîtrise experte du langageSQL et expérience pratique sur des environnements Cloud/Big Data comme Databricks pour traiter et croiser de grands volumes de données.
  • Profil curieux & Veille permanente : Grande curiosité intellectuelle, veille active sur l'évolution des usages mobile et appétence pour l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodologies analytiques.
  • Développement & Optimisation Produit : Capacité avérée à mesurer la valeur incrémentale des évolutions Produit et à fournir des recommandations stratégiques pour optimiser l'expérience client.
  • Communication & Maîtrise de l'anglais : Excellente capacité à vulgariser la donnée, faire du data storytelling et interagir avec fluidité en anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) au sein d'un environnement international et collaboratif.
  • Esprit d'équipe & Impact Data : Volonté de partager les connaissances au sein du collectif, participation à la construction d'une expertise Data E-commerce référente et contribution à la stratégie Data globale de Decathlon.

STACK TECHNIQUE

Amplitude, Statsig, Adjust, Databricks, SQL, Tableau.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITÉ

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.
  • CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.
  • Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.
  • Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems
  • Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform
  • Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience
  • Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code
  • Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security
  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost
  • Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy
  • Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement
  • Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

  • Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design
  • Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

  • Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption
  • Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost
  • Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

The interview process

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • DDSA (45 min): A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.

Per the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the pay range for this role is listed below for all legally required countries. Pay within the range reflects your skills, experience and the scope of the role, and is set using objective criteria applied consistently across the team. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards including variable pay under the applicable plan. Ledgy offers equity through our employee option plan. Benefits offered vary by country and type of employment.

Spain pay range€79.000—€97.000 EUR

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Are you a talented Linux administrator or DevOps engineer looking for new opportunities in cloud computing and infrastructure as code? Do you enjoy working – as we do – with tech and tools such as AWS (VPC, IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis, Route 53, CloudFormation, NLB), Azure, configuration as code (Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, AWS Systems Manager), Docker, Kubernetes (Rancher, Kops, EKS), Git, Jenkins, Bamboo, GitLab CI/CD and Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Bamboo, Bitbucket, Opsgenie)? Then join our DevOps and infrastructure team in Munich, Leipzig or remotely.

What to expect

  • Advising customers on migrating IT services and software to the cloud.
  • Planning and provisioning highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable cloud solutions.
  • Designing and optimizing cloud architectures.
  • Running cloud migration projects.
  • Working in agile environments and actively shaping software solutions.
  • Analyzing requirements and supporting functional/technical design.
  • Evaluating existing and new solutions and concepts.

What you bring

  • Several years of experience with completed projects in cloud, DevOps, DevSecOps or SRE concepts.
  • Experience with AWS (VPC, IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis, Route 53, CloudFormation, NLB) and ideally Azure.
  • Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (Bamboo, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with container orchestration: Kubernetes including Rancher, Kops or EKS.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code and configuration as code (Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, AWS CloudFormation, AWS Systems Manager).
  • Confident use of Git, GitLab CI/CD and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Bamboo, Bitbucket, Opsgenie).
  • Motivation to keep developing in the DevOps and cloud space, try new things and test current technologies.
  • Ideally a cloud or AWS certification – or an interest in earning one with our support.

What we offer

  • Company support for AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional).
  • A say in shaping a growing company, in a creative environment with short decision paths.
  • Support for personal and professional growth.
  • Training opportunities (learning platforms, conferences, courses).
  • Financial support for certifications (Atlassian ACP-100, ACP-400, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes).
  • A wellbeing budget of €50 per month.
  • Flexible, family-friendly working hours.
  • Remote work and workation support.
  • 30 days of paid leave per year.
  • Modern offices in Munich and Leipzig.
  • Your choice of equipment (MacBook, Linux notebook or Windows PC).
  • No mindless ticket-crunching – we build on new ideas and impulses, with our customers and in internal projects alike.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be embedded in one of our engineering teams, not in a central team, owning how that team builds, tests, ships, and runs its software.

You'll work day to day with the team's software engineers, and closely with platform engineers, SRE, and Infra Ops.

The teams

  • Infra

  • Network

  • Cloud

  • Observability

  • MLOps

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and run CI/CD pipelines and release processes.

  • Automate infrastructure and environments as code.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

  • Make it fast and safe for engineers to ship.

  • Take part in on-call and incident response.

 

Your Profile

  • Solid experience in DevOps, platform, or SRE roles.

  • Strong CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g. Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions).

  • Kubernetes and containers in production.

  • Scripting or coding skills, ideally in Go or Python.

  • Calm and methodical in incidents.

 

What You Bring

  • Automation instinct: If you do it twice, you automate it.

  • Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others' work with care.

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure, SRE and customers, and share what you learn.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two engineers) → Final.


Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer Contract
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFutureCreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

Our UK Benefits 

  • 35 days leave (including bank holidays). 
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Enhanced parental and adoption leave. 
  • Financial coaching + 5% pension match.
  • 40 hours of paid learning and development.

 View our full list of UK benefits. 

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

We are looking for an experienced senior DevSecOps Engineer to join our growing Security practice. In this role you will drive Platform and application security across client engagements — embedding security thinking into every stage of the SDLC, mentoring engineers, and helping CreateFuture build world-class DevSecOps capabilities.

Our clients span regulated and high-stakes industries including iGaming, healthcare-tech, e-commerce, and financial services. You will work hands-on with these clients — conducting threat modelling, secure architecture reviews, and penetration testing — while also shaping the internal AI-powered security tooling that sets CreateFuture apart.

Key Responsibilities
  • Cloud Security – Design and implement security controls across Azure using Terraform (including Azure Entra ID, PIM, CAP, Policy Defender, and Sentinel).
  • Application Security – Incident Response plans, design and implement SAST, DAST, IaC, Container scans with industry-standard tools and deal with common issues such as False Positive rates. 
  • Threat Modelling & Secure Design – Lead threat modelling sessions and carry out secure architecture and code reviews on client engagements, including within regulated iGaming environments.
  • Penetration Testing – Perform white-boxed application and infrastructure pentesting across client projects, identifying vulnerabilities and delivering clear, actionable remediation guidance.
  • Security Incident Handling – Assist with and senior security incident response activities, coordinating across engineering teams and senior stakeholders to contain, investigate, and remediate incidents effectively.
  • Vulnerability Remediation & Validation – Conduct impact analysis and drive end-to-end remediation for application and infrastructure findings—including firewall configurations, system patching, and Entra ID administrative controls—while executing retesting and coordinating cross-functional regression testing to ensure seamless operational continuity.
  • AI-Powered Security Tooling – Build and evolve AI-driven security tooling using Claude Code skills, hosted agents via StrandsAgent, and AWS AgentCore (or Azure equivalent) — automating security workflows and increasing coverage at scale.
  • Compliance & Governance – Perform compliance analysis, identify security requirements, and implement controls aligned to regulatory standards on client projects.
  • Mentoring & Onboarding – Coach and onboard DevSecOps engineers, and development teams on modern security practices.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Present security posture, risk findings, and remediation roadmaps clearly to senior stakeholders.
What we're looking for

Essential

  • Production experience operating in a multi-region Azure environment
  • Proven experience in a senior DevSecOps / Application Security engineering role
  • Proven experience working in SDLC as Dev, Quality engineer or DevOps
  • Proven experience working in a consulting setting and mindset
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills, particularly Terraform
  • Azure security experience (Entra ID, PIM, CAP, Policy, Defender, Sentinel)
  • Practical experience with CI/CD security integration (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
  • Deep knowledge of OWASP frameworks, secure SDLC, and application security assessment
  • Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing and threat modelling
  • Experience with secure code and architecture review, ideally in regulated or high-compliance environments such as iGaming, fintech, or healthcare
  • Hands-on involvement in security incident response and handling
  • Familiar with how the infosec team operates, including GRC, TPRM and SOC capability.
  • Familiar with common SIEM and SOAR platforms, their workflows and underlying data structure.
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience  with  compliance and regulatory analysis (GDPR, PCI DSS, or similar)

Desirable

  • Experience building AI-powered security tooling using Claude Code, StrandsAgent, AWS AgentCore, or similar agentic frameworks
  • Experience in iGaming, lottery, or other highly regulated digital sectors

Tech Stack
Azure | Terraform | GitHub Actions | Azure DevOps | JavaScript | C# | Java | .NET | React Native | Node.js | Claude Code | OWASP ZAP | Burp Suite | Sentinel | Defender

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: (Senior) Electronics Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a (Senior) Electronics Engineer (m/f/d) who will help develop PCB-level electronics for our robot arms, from safety-circuit design through to production-ready schematics.

Responsibilities

  • PCB Design: Create and review schematics, PCB layouts, and wiring diagrams for production, from initial concept through manufacturing-ready output.
  • Safety Circuits: Design and implement safety circuits and fail-safe mechanisms for the robot's electronics, working within established safety requirements.
  • Component Selection: Select and integrate electronic components (motors, drivers, sensors, power systems) that meet the robot's performance and reliability requirements.
  • Test Development: Design in-house test devices and write test cases for the electronics subsystem.
  • Hardware Debugging: Troubleshoot and resolve electrical and electronics issues on the physical robot, working directly with firmware, software, and mechanics engineers when a fault crosses disciplines.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain electrical documentation, including BOMs, test procedures, and compliance reports.

Essential Skills

  • Engineering Background: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and hands-on experience designing electronics for robotic or industrial systems.
  • Hands-On Build: Hands-on experience building and debugging electronics, including schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium Designer, microcontroller programming, and signal debugging using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
  • Safety Standards: Working knowledge of safety standards for high-voltage and high-current electronics.
  • Power Electronics: Working knowledge of power electronics for robotic systems, including PMSM motor control, DC/DC converters, battery management, and thermal design for power components.
  • Communication Protocols: Working understanding of communication protocols used in robotic and embedded systems, including CAN, SPI, I2C, and Ethernet.

Beneficial Skills

  • Harness Design: Experience with harness design and cable management for moving systems.
  • SolidWorks Electrical: Experience with SolidWorks Electrical for wiring and harness documentation.
  • Functional Safety: Experience working on functional safety projects.
  • Test Specifications: Experience writing requirements and test case specifications, and implementing the resulting tests.
  • Software Tools: Familiarity with common software engineering tools such as git.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join our Platform team supporting Spacecraft Operations. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in supporting other disciplines by focusing on the embedded software aspects of our satellite systems. The Platform team interfaces directly with many engineering groups to conduct R&D, design, manufacturing, and operations activities, ultimately ensuring all current and future spacecraft systems satisfy their mission.

Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years!

What You’ll Do as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer:

  • Design, implement and test, deploy and maintain embedded firmware
  • Collaborate with other engineering functions on scoping, architecture and system design
  • Resolve on-orbit and on-ground issues related to embedded systems
  • Implement, optimize and maintain various serial protocols
  • Design and develop interface tools to improve abstraction between the embedded system and other satellite components 
  • Debug and resolve complex embedded systems issues in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain technical documentation

Key Skills: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Mastery of Embedded C programming language
  • Proficiency with scripting languages like Python and Bash
  • Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), specifically FreeRTOS
  • Familiarity with serial protocols and implementations
  • Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging embedded systems
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Experience developing on Linux (Ubuntu)
  • A base level of mathematical knowledge (engineering mathematic or similar)
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

Preferred Skills: 

  • Experience with space systems or satellite technology
  • Familiarity working to coding standards and using static analysis tools
  • Experience writing Rust for resource constrained environments (embedded Linux)
  • Experience with embedded Linux
  • Knowledge of control systems and algorithms

Tools and Technologies:

  • FreeRTOS for real-time operating system implementation
  • GNU ARM Embedded Toolchain for code compilation
  • GDB for debugging, complemented by extensive use of serial and/or CAN debugging
  • Experience with debugging techniques for systems without JTAG access, particularly for remote issue resolution
  • Familiarity with manual testing procedures for embedded interface code
  • Experience working with Arm Cortex Microcontrollers
  • Version control using Git

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MI1

title: Senior Engineer II, Mechanical Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Job's mission

We are seeking innovative, motivated recent graduates to join our team as Mechanical Engineers. In this role, you will contribute to new product development, sustainment, and engineering design projects. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging problems, is thorough and detail-oriented, and uses experimentation and model-based analysis to identify root causes. You will collaborate effectively with cross-disciplinary teams to solve complex engineering problems and drive new technological advancements.

What you will be working on

Responsibilities:

  • Design mechanical systems and products supporting ASM process chambers using sound engineering principles
  • Interpret and design to gas, water and pneumatic schematics
  • Create and manage 3D CAD models (Creo) and 2D drawings with GD&T
  • Perform engineering analysis including structural, thermal, and fluid dynamics
  • Lead hardware development from concept through testing and HVM readiness
  • Drive data-based design decisions in a cross-functional team environment

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.


What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.

Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.


What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?

After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.

You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.

Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:

  • Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

  • Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

  • Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next manager.

  • AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.

What success looks like

At 6 months: The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality. Our agentic engineering playbook is noticeably better because of you — you’ve added or rewritten the skills, rules, and AI review checks the team uses every day, and you lead by example in how you ship with agents.

At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've found and/or coached the EM Nr. 2 to support growth.


How we work

We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

  • AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here.

  • Zero-bugs. We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product.

  • We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us.

This role is for you if:

  • You've managed a real team and made it ship faster. You've hired for it, run the hard conversations, and know what breaks as it grows — and you can point to where cycle time dropped because of you.

  • You know what great engineers look like. You've thought deeply about what makes them productive, what holds them back, and how to move them forward — and you can spot one in a single interview.

  • You have an exceptional IC track record before becoming a manager. You were a senior/principal engineer before you started managing — you didn't skip into management early because coding wasn't working out.

  • You have product taste. You notice when a feature ships on time but isn't good enough, and you say so.

  • You hold people to a high standard. You're comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations about performance.

  • You're hands-on with AI-assisted development. You've used Cursor and Claude Code in real production work, not just toy projects. You have opinions about how AI changes the engineering workflow from ideation to release, and you want to push a team to keep getting faster.

  • You've worked in startups. You know what it feels like when there's low process, and the answer is "figure it out and ship it."

  • You think engineering culture can stay startup-like at scale. You're optimistic that a small, high-performing team can stay that way as it grows, with little process.

  • You communicate proactively in writing. In a remote team, written communication is how decisions get made and context gets shared. But you're not scared of jumping into a pair programming session either.


What we're looking for

Required

  • 8+ years as a software engineer, including 4+ years managing a team of 8+ and hiring for it yourself

  • You've shipped AI features to production — retrieval, RAG, agentic workflows — and you know the difference between a demo that works and one that holds up on real customer data

  • Product taste: a keen sense for what makes a product feel great, and the habit of saying so when it doesn't

  • You've built and shipped with Claude Code and Cursor in real production work, and you have opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debt

  • You're an engineer at heart. You were senior or principal before you managed, and you can still hold your own in a design review, a debugging session, or building a feature

  • You've built something zero to one at a startup, or scaled a team through the messy middle. You know what it feels like when there's no playbook

  • Able to work in European timezone (CET/CEST). EMEA-based, ideally Germany or UK

Nice to have

  • You've grown a team to 15+ at a VC-funded startup

  • Managed tech leads or a second manager

  • Previous experience at a fully remote company

Interview process

We want to see how you think, build, and lead — not test you on algorithms. Here's the process:

  • 30 min — Intro call with our talent team

  • 45 min — Interview with Grigory

  • 60 min — Technical interview

  • 1.5 hr — AI-assisted build session: system design for a real feature, then building part of it with AI

  • 2 hr — Leadership session with the founders

Then you’ll get the offer! If we don't make an offer, we'll tell you why.


What Secfix gives you

  • Remote: 100% remote with a real virtual office in Gather

  • Salary: Competitive, benchmarked to European market rates (we'll share specifics once we talk)

  • Equity: Generous package — we're all owners here

  • Development budget: €1,000/year — yours to spend on whatever makes you better

  • Workspace: Remote workspace support + co-working access

  • Holidays: 26 days + local public holidays

  • Health insurance: Comprehensive coverage

  • Annual retreat: Last time we went to Alicante 🇪🇸 — before that, the Austrian Alps, Portugal, Italy, and the Spanish Islands

  • Tech: MacBook, monitors, headphones — the latest

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

We are currently looking for a Senior Crypto Analyst to join our fast growing FCI team

As a Senior Financial Crime Intelligence Analyst, you'll play a key role in handling screening and transaction monitoring alerts to prevent bad actors from processing transactions through BVNK. You’ll also conduct in-depth analysis and thorough investigations to address complex and varied financial crime threats. You’ll be taking ownership of cases triggered by BVNK’s financial crime systems and controls, focussing primarily on BVNK’s digital assets offering, and mitigating financial crime risks for BVNK. While this role focuses on BVNK’s digital assets offering, your cases will inevitably crossover with the world of fiat currency and you’ll have the opportunity to support cutting-edge investigations in fiat and digital assets.

We are seeking a candidate who can commit to a full-time schedule working from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. (CEST).

We are looking for a team player; someone who is adaptable and enjoys solving complex problems in a constantly changing environment. You must be adept at managing competing priorities, and work well in a highly demanding environment. You will be comfortable delivering high quality investigations at pace, and presenting your findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

As a Senior Financial Crime Intelligence Analyst, your day-to-day role will be varied, but will include tasks such as:

  • Reviewing of sanctions and watchlist screening alerts on entities and individuals on relevant lists;
  • Management of end-to-end financial crime investigations stemming from BVNK’s transaction monitoring system, Trade Surveillance, payment screening tools, blockchain analytics provider, and other triggers;
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and business processes through the effective use of AI tools and automation;
  • Receiving escalations from, and providing coaching to, more junior team members;
  • Drafting of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) for submission to the relevant authorities;
  • Working closely with colleagues responsible for BVNK’s transaction monitoring systems; identifying and testing changes to the rules in our transaction monitoring system;
  • Seeking out and escalating opportunities to enhance BVNK’s control environment.

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have at least 3 years’ experience in crypto transaction monitoring within a regulated institution or digital assets setting. Experience in a B2B context is essential, as we are primarily a B2B business. Familiarity with B2C environments is a plus, and experience across both crypto and fiat transaction monitoring environments would be advantageous;
  • You have experience reviewing sanctions and watchlist screening alerts, within a regulated institution or digital asset setting;
  • You have experience using tools such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, or TRM (or equivalent). Any blockchain related investigative certifications are desirable but not required;
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to streamline processes, automate routine tasks, and drive operational improvements;
  • Strong knowledge of AML/CTF regulations, financial crime typologies, and risk-based compliance frameworks is required;
  • Knowledge of Trade Surveillance would be an asset;
  • You’ve drafted and submitted Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs);
  • You’re a motivated and proactive individual contributor, who takes pride in the quality of your work;
  • You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving and demanding environment, often with competing priorities;
  • You’re happy working with a high degree of autonomy and managing evolving priorities to deliver against the team's strategy;
  • You have an interest in digital assets, and are looking for an opportunity to expand your knowledge in this space; 
  • You have exceptional written and verbal English;

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Joure
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Joure. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • middagdienst: 11:00 tot 19:30 uur;

  • nachtdienst: 02:00 tot 11:30 uur.

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  1. Kennismaking: we leren elkaar beter kennen tijdens een eerste gesprek.

  2. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.
As a Senior ML Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do

As a senior machine learning engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our ML team and R&D processes.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Facebook, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

  • Lead ambitious ML projects, collaborating with multiple engineers to deliver impactful solutions.

  • Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

  • Propose and guide experiments, model architectures, and data-labeling strategies to improve our speech-to-text, note generation, and normalization systems.

  • Implement, train, and deploy models in production, ensuring scalability and robustness in a live healthcare setting.

  • Optimize R&D processes, enabling the team to ship new models quickly and confidently as we scale.

  • Stay at the cutting edge of AI research, sharing expertise and fostering technical growth within the team.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have:

  • Nabla processes 10 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

  • By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Your DNA:

The ideal candidate will bring both technical depth and leadership experience to help Nabla revolutionize healthcare with AI.

Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in machine learning: You have extensive (5+ years) experience in training and deploying neural networks for real-world use cases.

  • Strong leadership skills: Proven ability to lead ML projects, collaborate across teams, and mentor junior engineers.

  • Advanced Python coding skills: You write clean, production-ready code.

  • Vision for AI in healthcare: Passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

  • Fluent in English: You communicate clearly and effectively.

  • Broader software engineering experience (infrastructure, front-end, etc.) is a plus.

Our Stack

  • Python for everything ML-related

  • Pytorch and Transformers for training

  • vLLM for inference

  • Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

  • Calls to OpenAI GPT-4 when needed

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers).
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Senior Manager, Constructability
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Senior Manager, Constructability, you will build and lead Volta's constructability function. Your team will make sure every DSX design and build sequence is buildable, safe and maintainable before it reaches site, across all our AI factories.

This is a senior leadership role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will own the constructability process end to end, build the team that runs it, and hold the line with designers, contractors and suppliers when buildability risks threaten schedule or cost.

What you will do

title: Senior Manager Strategy & PMO (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Ohne Strategie kein Wachstum. Ohne Umsetzung keine Transformation.

Bei ju:niz Energy gestalten wir die Energiewende aktiv mit. Als eines der führenden Unternehmen im deutschen Batteriespeichermarkt entwickeln, finanzieren und realisieren wir großskalige BESS-Projekte, die das Stromsystem der Zukunft ermöglichen.

Unser Wachstum bringt neue Herausforderungen – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen keine klassische PMO-Rolle und keinen Präsentationsersteller. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die strategisch denkt, Zusammenhänge erkennt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Wenn du den Anspruch hast, Unternehmen nicht nur zu beraten, sondern aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Strategie entwickeln. Wachstum gestalten. Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Du verbindest analytische Exzellenz mit unternehmerischem Denken.

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Uns zählen Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende voranzubringen.

title: Senior Mobile Security Developer - Contract (Inside IR35)
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a UK-based Inside IR35 Contract role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London or Edinburgh office oron client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

title: Senior Ops Manager
descriptionHtml:

Bei Ongle24 / Proglow, unseren beiden Marken der Nailscamp GmbH, schlägt unser Herz für hochwertige Beauty- und Nagelprodukte für unsere stetig wachsende Community. Als Senior Operations Manager übernehmen Sie die strategische und operative Steuerung zentraler Unternehmensprozesse. In enger Abstimmung mit dem Top-Management gestalten Sie effiziente Abläufe von der Lagerlogistik bis hin zur Abfüllung:
