title: Senior Payroll Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets.

This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation.

Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues.

The role will also provide opportunities to support international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation, helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation.

What you'll be doing

  • Take ownership of the end-to-end payroll delivery for assigned international entities.
  • Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.
  • Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised.
  • Apply a strong understanding of legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices, ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled.
  • Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions.
  • Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented.
  • Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes, reducing manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Support and lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding.
  • Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution.
  • Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets.
  • Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team.
  • Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers.
  • Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience working in a payroll analyst or senior payroll position, ideally within a complex, international organisation.
  • Strong hands-on experience of international payroll, with experience of Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable.
  • Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable.
  • Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, payments, statutory reporting and compliance.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate payroll data, identify discrepancies and understand the root cause of issues.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on payroll accuracy and risk management.
  • Experience of identifying and implementing process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies.
  • Experience supporting or leading payroll projects, system implementations or payroll migrations.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with payroll data and reporting.
  • Experience with Workday/Cloudpay or other HR/payroll technology is preferred.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge, influence and provide a clear point of view.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll matters clearly to both payroll and non-payroll stakeholders.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to question the why and the how behind existing processes.

Why Deliveroo?

Deliveroo's mission is to build the definitive food company by making food more convenient and accessible.

As a technology-driven business in one of the world's fastest-growing industries, Deliveroo offers the opportunity to make a real impact while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.

We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets.

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

You’ll be central to our mission as we turn historically slow and painful processes into ones that are quick, intuitive and even delightful for installers. We’ve been design-led since the beginning but the challenge is only growing as our product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you’ll be:

  • Making complex decisions feel effortless – Our platform handles everything from building physics calculations to fluid dynamics modelling to complicated compliance requirements. We need to make handling that complexity feel effortless for all our customers, irrespective of how tech-savvy they are.

  • Designing across multiple touchpoints – You'll work on desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work seamlessly across different user types (from 3-person local installers to national utilities);

  • Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs can be shipped quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team);

  • Building systematic, scalable design systems – Creating robust, structured, and reusable components that work across platforms and for potentially low-tech users;

  • Researching and validating - Interviewing and spending time with installers to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems to solve are; and building quick prototypes to test and validate design decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.

🫵 About You

We’re looking for a designer with 3+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially a lot more), ideally in a startup context or within fast-paced, impact-focussed teams. We'd love to speak with you if you are:

  • A clear, systematic thinker who loves tackling complex flows;

  • Comfortable with diving into technical detail, even if it’s a new domain;

  • User-obsessed; you enjoy deeply understanding the user, solving their problems and making a tangible impact on them;

  • Proactive and self-organising, happy juggling multiple projects;

Bonus if you’ve worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or on operational workflows (but absolutely not a requirement!).

🌟 Our offer

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

This is clearly particularly important for this role but you’ll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
descriptionHtml:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

  • Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

  • Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

  • Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

How we work:

  • We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

  • We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

  • We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

  • Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

You should apply if you have:

Basic qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

  • Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

  • Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

  • Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

  • Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

  • Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

  • Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.

  • Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts.

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle pricing and tax logic directly within the application layer.

  • Bonus: Direct experience with tax engines or multi-jurisdiction tax compliance (VAT, GST, sales tax), or with travel-industry reservation systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience launching or significantly redesigning a checkout or booking flow end-to-end.

  • Experience building tax calculation or compliance capabilities across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform commerce (orders spanning buyers, sellers, and modifications over time).

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Your commerce expertise is limited to plugging in off-the-shelf checkout or cart solutions. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer.

  • You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical booking flows or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail.

  • You prioritize greenfield development over the complex challenge of scaling and refining an existing system with significant booking volume.

  • You are looking for a siloed IC position without the need for cross-functional collaboration or product-level discovery.

  • You require a rigid, pre-defined roadmap; we prefer to sharpen our strategy and direction as we scale the team.

Why join us?

  • Solve real commerce problems at real volume: over a million travelers booking adventures in 150+ countries, and growing.

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.

  • Be part of building the best engineering team: you'll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.

  • Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, and remote-friendly work culture.

Benefits Section

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Monday/Thursday team lunches and after-work social events.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As the energy transition accelerates, flexibilities in the low-voltage grid become increasingly important - and smart metering and steering of distributed energy resources sit at the heart of this shift. You take a central role in our end-to-end steering proposition, turning regulatory complexity into scalable, compliant, and customer-friendly products at the intersection of regulation, product, hardware, and field operations.

  • Be the Expert on Smart Metering & Steering Regulation: Act as the first point of contact - internally and externally - for regulatory developments such as §14a EnWG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, and §118 Abs. 6 EnWG. Interpret legal frameworks, VDE FNN requirements, BNetzA rulings, and BDEW Guidelines, and help shape the rules of tomorrow through active industry engagement.
  • Translate Regulation into Product Requirements: Define and prioritize development requirements for our engineering teams to ensure Heartbeat AI and connected hardware (e.g. §14a Steuerbox + Smart Meter) meets all compliance and performance standards.
  • Drive Hardware Strategy and Rollout: Coordinate testing and lab capacities, prepare key hardware decisions, and operationalize the rollout of intelligent metering systems and Steuerboxen across our customer segment.
  • Manage Service Providers and Market Partners: Own relationships with external service providers as well as DSOs and metering point operators, ensuring smooth collaboration and reliable market communication processes.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Projects & Monitor Performance: Take overarching project responsibility for steering initiatives, define KPIs, monitor target achievement, and derive optimization measures from data and field feedback.

Dein Profil

General:

  • 3+ years of experience in the energy sector with a clear focus on metering and steering
  • Strong project management skills, leading cross-functional initiatives across internal teams, network and metering point operators, and external service providers
  • Analytical, structured thinker who can define KPIs and use data to drive decisions
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and regulatory change
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English - German is essential given the heavy regulatory and partner interaction

Domain & Regulatory Expertise:

  • Solid working knowledge of §14a EnWG and the grid-oriented control of consumption and generation assets, as well as the broader regulatory framework (MsbG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, §118 Abs. 6 EnWG)
  • Familiarity with relevant technical standards and guidelines, as well as Marktkommunikationsprozesse and smart metering infrastructure
  • Experience coordinating hardware testing, lab setups, or certification processes (e.g. for §14a Steuerboxen) is a strong plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let’s be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They’re seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the ‘doing more with less’ memos. If you’re currently at a startup that’s struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that ‘growth’ story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. 

And we aren't just stable—we’re expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we’re looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You’ve successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What’s in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC’s hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph Storage
descriptionHtml:
Location Details:

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.  

Join Our Team…

GoDaddy's Global Storage Engineering team operates one of the largest Ceph environments in the industry, powering the object, block, and file storage platforms that underpin hosting, applications, internal infrastructure, and next-generation AI/HPC workloads. If you're passionate about distributed systems, large-scale storage architecture, and solving complex reliability challenges, you'll work on infrastructure that few engineers ever experience. 

At GoDaddy, Ceph isn't a side project — it's a critical platform. Our environment spans 80+ production clusters, 20,000+ OSDs, and approximately 300 PB of raw storage capacity, supporting tens of billions of objects across multiple continents. The scale demands deep technical expertise in storage architecture, automation, observability, and performance engineering. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll be a key technical owner of the platform, responsible for maintaining reliability, driving operational excellence, and influencing the future evolution of our storage ecosystem. You'll tackle challenging production problems, develop automation that operates at massive scale, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced Ceph engineers. This is an opportunity to have direct impact on a storage platform that serves millions of customers worldwide. 

What You'll Get to Do…

  • Own the reliability, performance, scalability, and capacity of large-scale production Ceph environments supporting object, block, and file storage workloads (RADOS, RGW, RBD, CephFS). 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems issues including recovery/backfill events, OSD instability, PG imbalance, storage latency, and RGW performance bottlenecks. 
  • Design and build automation using Python, Shell, SaltStack, and Ansible to reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience at scale. 
  • Define and improve observability for the storage platform through SLIs, SLOs, PromQL, LogQL, Grafana dashboards, and proactive alerting strategies. 
  • Lead storage lifecycle initiatives including cluster expansions, hardware refreshes, software upgrades, OpenStack integrations, and large-scale migration projects. 

Your Experience Should Include…

  • 5+ years operating large-scale Linux infrastructure with significant experience supporting distributed storage systems in production environments. 
  • 2+ years hands-on Ceph administration including OSD, MON, MDS, and RGW operations, CRUSH map management, pool design, placement groups, and performance troubleshooting. 
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, storage architecture, networking, filesystems, block devices, and performance analysis under production workloads. 
  • Experience developing operational automation and tooling with Python, Shell, and configuration management platforms such as Ansible, SaltStack, Puppet, or Chef. 
  • Proven incident response expertise, including production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, postmortem creation, and implementation of durable corrective actions. 

You Might Also Have…

  • Advanced Ceph expertise across RGW Multisite, CephFS, RBD Mirroring, erasure coding, and large-scale cluster design. 
  • Experience integrating storage platforms with OpenStack (Cinder, Nova, Neutron, Swift) or Kubernetes storage technologies (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook). 
  • Familiarity with modern observability platforms including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Grafana, and enterprise monitoring architectures. 
  • Experience planning and executing petabyte-scale storage migrations, capacity expansion programs, and storage hardware lifecycle management. 
  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or storage projects and a passion for advancing distributed systems technologies. 

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back...We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

About us...  GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us. 

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. REJOINS L'ÉQUIPE DIGITAL PAYMENT

Au sein de cette organisation, l'équipe Digital Payment, est en charge de proposer la meilleure expérience de paiement pour nos marchands comme pour nos clients d'un point de vue performance, stabilité, cout, profitabilité et UX. Pour cela, elle a la charge de plusieurs produits digitaux utilisés sur la majorité des expériences digitale de Decathlon et contribuant fortement au chiffre d'affaire de l'entreprise :

  • OnePay : l'orchestrateur de paiement (le core), qui permet à nos marchands une standardisation et une flexibilité d'accès aux moyens de paiement (plugins) en choisissant le plus pertinent par rapport au contexte grace à un moteur d'éligibilité, au panier ou au client. Onepay propose notamment un widget de paiement directement intégrés par les différents front-office web.
  • OneWallet : le portefeuille numérique, qui sauvegarde de manière sécurisée les tokens des différents moyens de paiement et permet ainsi une expérience d'achat sans couture pour nos clients.
  • Payment Preview : module d’éligibilité permettant d’exposer les moyens de paiement possibles au plus tôt de l’expérience d’achat.
  • Third Party Checkout : un module permettant d'utilisant les partenaires de paiement pour faciliter le checkout pour les clients guest.
  • Payment Manager : une API d'orchestration du core qui permet de gérer des flows complexes de paiement composés ou de remboursement.

Les indicateurs principaux de l'équipe sont autour de la conversion à l'étape de paiement et le taux d'acceptance, c'est à dire la performance de nos partenaires.

We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Intercept team, which builds the Endpoint Agent and Browser Extension that run on our customers' devices, and the backend services behind them. You'll be a full-system contributor. You'll design and build complex Java backend services and make significant contributions to the agent's Rust codebase and the extension's TypeScript codebase. This software has to be fast, resilient and trustworthy across operating systems and real-world conditions.

Java is the foundation. You don't need expert-knowledge of Rust or TypeScript yet, but you must be willing and able to learn them and comfortable working across all three. You'll join a fast-moving team that ships often and cares about correctness, observability and maintainability.

What You'll Do

  • Ingest and process high-volume event data from the agents and extensions running on customer devices

  • Expose well-designed APIs used by the Endpoint Agent, Browser Extension, UIs, and external systems

  • Make significant contributions to the Endpoint Agent in Rust across Windows, macOS and Linux, and to the Browser Extension in TypeScript across Chromium, Firefox and Safari

  • Build robust tests, validation tooling and deployment mechanisms for releases that customers rely on every day

  • Investigate and resolve platform-specific issues with precision and speed

  • Work closely with security engineers, other engineers, and product stakeholders to shape technical requirements

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, mostly building backend services and distributed systems in the Java ecosystem (Java, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle)

  • Some experience in a systems programming setting, such as Rust, C++, or native software running on user devices

  • A solid grasp of systems programming concepts: memory safety, concurrency, error handling and IPC

  • Experience with Rust or TypeScript is a bonus. You must be willing and able to learn whichever you don't know

  • Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing patterns, messaging systems, and distributed system design

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining APIs and service-to-service integrations

  • Comfortable operating in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments and working with modern observability tooling, logging, and monitoring platforms

  • A track record of delivering performant, reliable and scalable applications

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional teams

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Learn quickly and independently, and are happy with a wide variety of work

  • Understand how the whole system fits together, from backend services to the code running on a user's device, and why architectural decisions matter

  • Know when to move fast and when to slow down, and make careful decisions in security-critical code

  • Test and validate rigorously, and care about building bulletproof software that runs reliably around the clock

  • Have led a technical initiative, or want to grow into leading one

  • Have worked with OS platform APIs on Windows, macOS or Linux, or built browser extensions

  • Have experience building products in cybersecurity, identity, data protection, or enterprise SaaS environments

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

  • Leverage AI tools as an engineer to help you build smarter, faster and better

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.
We expect you to have:
  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

title: Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

  • Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities.

  • Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process.

  • Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark.

  • Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down.

  • Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team.

     
 

Who we're looking for

  • An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business.

  • Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality.

  • Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship.

  • Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here.

  • An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over.

  • Someone who shares what they know and helps develop the people around them.

 

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

  • If you want to specialise in one area. You'll be hiring across the whole organisation, often for very different roles in the same week. If you'd rather go deep in one function, this isn't the role for you.

  • If you want to move into people management now. This is an individual contributor role and you'll be carrying your own reqs. You'll informally mentor and share knowledge, but there are no direct reports.

  • If you're looking to own TA strategy or set standards for the whole team. Good ideas come from everyone in our team, but leading on this won’t be yours to own.

  • If you prefer a steer on ambiguous searches. We need someone who works through unclear briefs independently, and only escalates the genuinely strategic calls.

  • If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

  • If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't share what works. Evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£50,000 - £60,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = 60-minute video call with our Talent Lead > In-person interview with two members of the People team > Final interview with two members of our SLT.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

 

How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

Compensation: £50K – £60K

title: Senior Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.


The Role

Location: Hybrid (in-office in London, 2-3 days per week)

This is ExTrac's first Talent Enablement hire and as a founding member of the Talent Function you will run full-cycle recruiting across Engineering, Growth and Research & Analysis, but the deeper brief is to build the systems, tools and hiring-manager capability that let ExTrac scale with a lean talent team. Reporting to the Director of People & Talent, you will own Ashby, the data behind our hiring decisions, and the sourcing and assessment tools hiring managers use, while coaching those hiring managers to run strong searches with less of your direct involvement over time. We're looking for someone who wants to build something that outlasts their own day-to-day effort, not just fill requisitions.


What the job involves

Talent Acquisition, Hiring manager enablement and sourcing strategy

  • Run full-cycle, generalist recruiting across Engineering, Growth and Research & Analysis (and other functions as needed).

  • Design and roll out sourcing strategies that hiring teams can run themselves, rather than owning sourcing for every role personally.

  • Coach and upskill hiring managers and interviewers so strong hiring practice lives in the teams doing the hiring, not solely with you.

  • Act as the trusted business partner hiring managers bring hard calls to: who to hire, how to structure a search, when a role isn't working as scoped.

Systems, AI-augmented infrastructure and data driven decision-making

  • Own and continuously improve ExTrac's use of Ashby, reducing friction in the hiring process for candidates, hiring managers and interviewers.

  • Use AI to analyse and calibrate hiring data into insights that drive a recruitment project roadmap grounded in evidence, backed by a clear hypothesis of what needs to change, while keeping hiring decisions with the humans making them, never handed to AI.

  • Build internal talent products, such as process design tools, assessment tools, and hiring manager and interviewer training, so quality hiring practice doesn't need to be rebuilt from scratch for every open role.

  • Build the clean, consistent data foundations that make hiring decisions and reporting trustworthy.

  • Use data to identify where the hiring process is working, where it isn't, and what to fix next.

Assessment design

  • Design assessment strategies that get at candidates' real capability, not just what they can produce with AI assistance, refreshing methods as the ways candidates use AI evolve.

Talent Partnership and Operations

  • Support and constructively challenge hiring managers on workforce planning, org design and capability mapping decisions.

  • When active recruitment isn't at peak, shift into longer-term work: capability mapping, org design support, and building future talent pools and long-term candidate relationships.

  • Flex into adjacent People Operations work when the business needs it, including onboarding support and administering equity paperwork and employment contracts.

You should apply if

  • You have a proven track record as a business partner or stakeholder manager, not just a candidate-pipeline builder: you've built trust with hiring managers and driven outcomes by working through them, not around them.

  • You're a generalist by inclination as well as necessity: you're equally comfortable partnering on a technical engineering search, a commercial hire and a research or analyst role, rather than being deep in one domain and shallow in the rest.

  • You've genuinely used AI to build agents, automations or workflows, whether in a professional recruiting context or in your own life, and you're energised by using it to change how hiring works here, not just to speed up admin.

  • You are comfortable working in a lean team at all levels of scope - from partnering with executives through to basic recruitment coordination.

  • A background as a sourcer is genuinely welcome here; this role is as much about what you can build and who you can influence, as the specific lived experience.

  • You're based in or able to commute into our London office 2-3 days a week to build the in-person relationships this role depends on.

Where this role can take you

  • Gain experience driving significant change management around how we market and assess candidates in the new AI influenced shift towards assessing competency not just technical skills.

  • This role presents an opportunity to grow into a Lead Talent Partner: fuller ownership of the AI-driven recruiting infrastructure and the recruitment roadmap, with recognised authority as the systems owner behind ExTrac's hiring.

  • Partner with colleagues across the business on workforce planning, org design and global geo location strategies.

  • Shape how AI is used in hiring and assessment across ExTrac, on a topic most companies are still improvising on.

Requirements

  • A proven track record of business partnering or stakeholder management in a recruiting, talent or adjacent context, with specific examples of driving outcomes by influencing hiring managers and interviewers rather than owning delivery alone.

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience across more than one function or domain (for example technical, commercial, research or analytical), reflecting genuine generalist range rather than single-domain depth.

  • Experience designing candidate assessments, particularly ones built to withstand AI-assisted candidate output.

  • Hands-on experience administering and improving an ATS (Ashby or a comparable platform), including reducing process friction for candidates and hiring teams.

  • Demonstrated, genuine use of AI tools to build workflows, agents or automations, in a professional or personal capacity, with a clear point of view on how AI should and shouldn't be used in hiring decisions.

  • Based in or able to commute to ExTrac's London office 2-3 days per week.

Desirable

  • Experience across both UK and US talent markets.

  • Prior experience as a sourcer.

  • Experience in a small or lean People or Talent team where the role required covering adjacent work such as onboarding, equity administration or contracts.

  • Experience working in a security-conscious environment serving government, defence and intelligence-adjacent clients.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening interview with Director of People & Talent – 30 minutes

  • Business-partnering scenario & Competency based interviews – 2 x 45 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview – 30-45 minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • £500/year education budget with additional items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, hybrid: 2-3 days per week in our central London office.

ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) – Großbatteriespeicher/ EMSR-Technik
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Ohne Speicher keine Energiewende.

ju:niz Energy entwickelt und betreibt seit über zehn Jahren netzdienliche Großbatteriespeicher. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz und schaffen die Flexibilität, die eine Energieversorgung mit erneuerbaren Energien braucht. Wir investieren selbst in unsere Projekte und behalten die Speicher langfristig im Bestand.

Für unser Operations-Team suchen wir dich als Servicetechniker (m/w/d). Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen sicher und zuverlässig laufen. Du kannst überall in Deutschland wohnen: Von deinem Wohnort aus betreust du unsere Anlagen im gesamten Bundesgebiet. Je nach Einsatzplanung gehören auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung dazu. Aufgaben, die keine Anwesenheit an der Anlage erfordern, kannst du von zu Hause erledigen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • An unseren Großbatteriespeichern und elektrotechnischen Nebenanlagen führst du Wartungen, Inspektionen und Instandsetzungen durch.
  • Tritt eine Störung auf, grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein, behebst den Fehler und tauschst bei Bedarf Komponenten aus – vor Ort oder, soweit möglich, per Fernzugriff.
  • Mithilfe von SCADA-, EMS- und Fernwirksystemen überwachst und parametrierst du unsere Anlagen.
  • Bei Inbetriebnahmen, Funktionstests, Netztests und Upgrades bringst du deine technische Erfahrung ein und führst Prüfungen im Rahmen deiner Qualifikation durch.
  • Deine Einsätze, Messergebnisse und Lösungen hältst du nachvollziehbar fest. Wiederkehrende Fehler und Verbesserungspotenziale besprichst du mit dem Operations-Team, damit unsere Anlagen langfristig zuverlässig laufen.

Dein Profil

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im elektrotechnischen Bereich bildet deine Grundlage – zum Beispiel als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Mechatroniker mit elektrotechnischer Erfahrung.
  • In der Wartung oder Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen, industrieller Steuerungen oder Energieanlagen hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt. Kenntnisse von Batteriespeichern sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Schaltpläne und technische Dokumentation liest du sicher; bei der Fehlersuche gehst du strukturiert vor.
  • Erfahrung mit EMSR-Technik, SCADA, EMS oder Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus und IEC 61850 ist ein Plus.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.
  • Für Einsätze an unseren Anlagen reist du innerhalb Deutschlands. Auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung sind für dich grundsätzlich möglich.

Warum wir?

  • Technik mit Wirkung: Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, dass Großbatteriespeicher zuverlässig funktionieren und das Stromnetz stabilisieren.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze: Dich erwarten unterschiedliche Anlagen und Aufgaben – von der Fehleranalyse bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
  • Deutschlandweiter Einstieg: Dein Wohnort muss nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Aschheim liegen.
  • Fachliche Entwicklung: Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in der Batterietechnik und im Anlagenbetrieb weiter ausbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit einem kollegialen Team und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

descriptionHtml:
