title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (TLM), Driver Understanding and Evaluation
descriptionHtml:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The DUE Machine Learning team will build and operate scalable machine learning and data systems, simulation workflow and insight tools, improve and speed up the evaluation and onboard developer journeys. It will combine expert human judgements and advanced machine learning models to deliver training and evaluation data for hundreds of metrics and components that make up the Waymo driver. 

We are planning to set up a team in London UK to work with the teams in MTV and Oxford to build these foundation models out and to integrate them into several evaluation and training products. We are looking for researchers and software engineers who are passionate about developing machine learning techniques for the Evaluation systems on our autonomous vehicles, and have an incessant drive to improve the performance of our technology stack.

descriptionHtml:

Wie zijn wij? Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren en merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei te bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

Ons Brand & Culture team is de drijvende kracht achter zowel onze externe merkidentiteit als onze interne cultuur en maatschappelijke impact. Je krijgt de unieke kans om te leren hoe we onze merkstrategie vertalen naar concrete acties én hoe we ons verhaal op een pakkende manier vertellen aan zowel interne als externe doelgroepen. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren professionals en krijgt volop ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen.

Wat ga jij doen? Als Stagiair(e) Brand & Culture ben jij een onmisbare schakel in ons team en help je mee om onze ambities waar te maken. Jouw missie is om ons te ondersteunen bij het versterken van de merkidentiteit van WPP Media en het creëren van impactvolle content. Je krijgt de kans om volop mee te werken aan diverse projecten en activiteiten, en er is ruimte voor jouw eigen initiatieven en ontwikkeling. Jouw takenpakket is veelzijdig en uitdagend:

  • Merkidentiteit & Cultuur: Je ondersteunt bij het bewaken en verder ontwikkelen van de merkidentiteit, tone of voice en visuele richtlijnen van WPP Media. Je draagt bij aan de doorvertaling van onze merkstrategie naar praktische initiatieven en versterkt onze interne bedrijfscultuur.
  • Content Creatie & Redactie: Je werkt actief mee aan de creatie van diverse content (tekst, beeld, video) voor verschillende kanalen. Denk hierbij aan social media posts, blogs, artikelen, whitepapers en communicatie voor interne activaties en evenementen.
  • Content Planning & Promotie: Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van contentplannen en denkt mee over hoe we onze content effectief kunnen verspreiden via relevante kanalen. Je draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van content voor online vindbaarheid (SEO).
  • Evenementen & Projectondersteuning: Je helpt bij de organisatie van inspirerende interne evenementen (zoals borrels, workshops en collega-activiteiten) en andere projecten die onze cultuur versterken. Dit omvat ondersteuning bij projectmanagement taken, zoals planning, coördinatie met diverse interne en externe stakeholders en het bewaken van deadlines.
  • Social Impact: Je draagt bij aan projecten met maatschappelijke relevantie die aansluiten bij onze doelstellingen en een positieve impact maken.
  • Analyse & Optimalisatie: Je helpt met het analyseren van markttrends, concurrentie en de prestaties van onze communicatie-uitingen, en draagt bij aan inzichten voor continue verbetering.

Wie ben jij? Jij bent een enthousiaste, open-minded en proactieve student(e) die gelooft in de kracht van verbinding. Je krijgt energie van het samenbrengen van mensen en ideeën, en je bent niet bang om de handen uit de mouwen te steken.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je bent communicatief sterk in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk).
  • Je bent creatief, leergierig en hebt een "get it done" mentaliteit.
  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig werken als goed functioneren in een team.

Wat bieden wij?

Handicap International est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE :

Le stage se déroulera au sein du Pôle Qualité de Vie et Conditions de Travail à la direction des Ressources Humaines de Handicap International, avec un démarrage mi-janvier pour une durée de 6 mois. Le pôle est constitué d’une référente santé/handicap et d’une manager QVCT/prévention des risques psycho sociaux. Nous travaillons avec des acteurs externes (médecin du travail, assistante sociale, psychologues, courtiers). A noter le tutorat sera exercé par un RH et non un psychologue.

L'objectif de l'équipe QVCT est de mettre en œuvre et de coordonner la politique de protection du personnel de l'organisation afin de garantir la bonne santé psychologique et physique de tous ses employés.

Vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Activité 1 Vous contribuez à l’élaboration et mise en œuvre du plan de déploiement de la prévention des addictions au sein de l’organisation, plus spécifiquement pour le personnel intervenant sur le terrain. Globalement :

Phase 1 : revue documentaire et analyse sur les addictions et les risques professionnels, établissement d’un benchmark sur les bonnes pratiques en entreprise et les spécificités du monde humanitaire

Phase 2 : appui à l’élaboration du plan de prévention contre les addictions

Phase 3 : réalisation de supports de communication interne variés en français et anglais ; co élaboration d’un e-learning simple et synthétique sur les addictions et leur prévention

Activité 2 : Vous participez à la vie quotidienne du pôle QVCT (participation aux réunions de services, aux sessions de sensibilisations organisées, à l’alimentation de l’intranet sur des sujets de prévention, à la production et suivi de statistiques etc) et pouvez être amené à appuyer sur des sujets ponctuels liés à la QVCT (télétravail, lutte contre la sédentarité, Duty of Care, inclusion des travailleurs handicapés…). En fonction des sujets, vous pourrez assister aux réunions de la CSSCT.

Requirements

PROFIL ATTENDU :

Vous êtes étudiant en master psychologie du travail ou santé publique ou prévention des risques.

Vous êtes à l’aise à l’écrit, vous savez rédiger des articles / des textes, élaborer des outils de sensibilisation et des présentations dynamiques.

Vous faites preuve d’organisation, de rigueur, d’implication, de polyvalence, d’adaptabilité et d’autonomie. Vous êtes complètement à l’aise en anglais relationnel ainsi que rédactionnel

Une première expérience de vie à l’étranger serait appréciée ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le monde de la solidarité internationale.

français et anglais (fluent)

Le poste est situé en Open Space avec une modalité de flex office ; des box/salles silence sont mis à disposition pour plus de calme si nécessaire et l’espace de travail est très lumineux. Une référente handicap est présente pour répondre à vos questions et vous accompagner dans vos démarches ; en fonction de vos besoins le poste peut être aménagé.

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vos missions :

Rattaché.e à l'équipe Business développement, vous contribuez à la construction d'une infrastructure de données fiable au service de l'activité opérationnelle. Vous concevez un processus complet qui collecte des données issues de sources externes variées, les fiabilise et les met à disposition dans nos outils SIG.

Vos principales missions :

  • Identifier et qualifier les sources de données : recenser de manière exhaustive les sources externes pertinentes (open data, bases institutionnelles, données géographiques…) et évaluer leur format, leur fréquence de mise à jour et leur fiabilité.
  • Croiser les sources entre elles : définir et mettre en œuvre une méthode de rapprochement (record linkage), afin d'identifier de façon fiable les mêmes éléments présents dans plusieurs sources.
  • Consolider les données : nettoyer, harmoniser et compiler les données dans un format cohérent, prêt à être intégré à notre base de données existante.
  • Garantir la cohérence entre sources : mettre en place des contrôles de qualité et des règles de mise à jour, pour éviter qu'une modification dans une source ne crée des incohérences dans l'ensemble de la base.
  • Publier les résultats : intégrer les données consolidées à la base et les rendre exploitables dans les outils SIG de l'entreprise.
  • Automatiser le processus : industrialiser la chaîne de traitement pour permettre des mises à jour régulières et reproductibles, sans intervention manuelle.
  • Documenter la méthode : rédiger une documentation claire de la démarche et des choix retenus, pour assurer la maintenance et la transmission du dispositif.

HSE :

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement 
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques

Qualité :

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité 
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité 
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil :

Étudiant.e en Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, master en data science, informatique, statistiques), vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois à partir de début 2027, avec un goût prononcé pour la donnée et la construction de systèmes fiables.

Compétences techniques attendues :

  • Maîtrise de Python (pandas, éventuellement GeoPandas) et de SQL ;
  • Solides bases en modélisation de données et bases de données relationnelles
  • Familiarité avec la consommation d'API et le scraping de données ouvertes.
  • Connaissance des méthodes de rapprochement de données et des notions de statistiques associées (probabilités, scoring, mesures de similarité) ;
  • Notions de SIG (QGIS, ArcGIS ou équivalent) et de données géospatiales.

Un plus :

  • Notions d’ETL et d’orchestration de traitements (Airflow, Jenkins…)
  • Pratique de Git et des bonnes pratiques de développement (tests, code review) ;

Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire soigneux.se, attentif.ve à la qualité des données et capable de repérer les incohérences, avec l'envie de progresser en autonomie sur un projet, de l'exploration jusqu'au déploiement.

Vous aimez expliquer vos choix de façon claire, et vous êtes curieux(se) de travailler avec des collègues d'autres métiers, qui vous accompagneront dans cette découverte.

title: Strategic Account Director, Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

Altana AI is looking for a Strategic Account Director to own and accelerate two high-priority, under-developed go-to-market motions: large customs broker sales and channel/partnership activation for logistics service providers (LSPs). This role combines strategic account ownership with hands-on execution across demos, conference engagements, and cross-functional collaboration with the broader Growth team.

The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in trade compliance, customs brokerage, or supply chain technology, with an established network among top-tier brokers and LSPs. They are equally comfortable running a complex enterprise sales cycle and stepping onto a conference panel to represent Altana’s platform vision.

You Will

  • Large Logistics Service Provider Sales
    • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for Top-25 Global Logistics Providers, from prospecting through close
    • Develop and execute an account strategy targeting high-value customs brokerage firms, leveraging existing warm relationships.
    • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for large broker accounts, building multi-threaded executive relationships
    • Partner with Sales Engineering and Product to tailor demonstrations and proof-of-value engagements to broker-specific workflows
  • Cross-Functional Growth Support
    • Deliver product demonstrations, executive briefings, and pitch presentations to prospects and partners
    • Represent Altana at industry conferences, trade shows, and panel discussions as a subject-matter expert
    • Collaborate across the Growth team to share market intelligence, refine messaging, and support pipeline development for adjacent segments
    • Contribute to thought leadership content, case studies, and competitive positioning

You Have

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales, business development, or strategic partnerships experience in supply chain technology, trade compliance, or logistics SaaS
  • Demonstrated success selling into or partnering with large customs brokers, freight forwarders, or logistics service providers
  • Established relationships with multiple Top-25 Global Logistics Providers.
  • Track record of building and scaling new go-to-market motions from early stage to repeatable revenue
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to deliver compelling presentations and represent the company externally
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with deal sizes of $500K+
  • Preferred:
    • Prior experience in a dual role spanning both direct sales and channel/partnership development
    • Familiarity with AI/ML platforms, data-as-a-service business models, or supply chain visibility tools
    • Background in leading or contributing to sales at a high-growth B2B startup
    • Experience with customs brokerage operations, ACE/ABI systems, or trade compliance technology

This role is based in New York or London with hybrid work flexibility.

US Salary Range: $180,000 - $210,000 USD

UK Salary Range: £120,000 - £140,000 GBP

The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position.  The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees.

The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

  • Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
  • Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
  • Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
  • Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. Our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. title: Strategic Client Manager
descriptionHtml:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. From multi-national operations, to well known brands, and growing sector leaders, we want you to own these relationships, making sure they get the very best Flock service.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

title: Team Leader - Cambridge
descriptionHtml:
Team Leader

Location: Cambridge

Working pattern: Onsite | 30 hours per week (Shift rotation)

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Team Leader to join our Cambridge team. In this role, you’ll support Site Management in achieving peak performance and operational excellence, ensuring our restaurant partners and customers receive world-class service.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Deliveroo Editions team. Editions are our delivery-only kitchens that partner with incredible restaurants like Wagamama and Starbucks to bring high-quality food to more doorsteps. You will be at the heart of this fast-paced hub, ensuring every shift runs smoothly.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Lead shift operations by effectively prioritising tasks and delegating to the team to meet all company performance goals.

  • Supervise compliance and safety by coaching the team on standard operating procedures (SOPs) and conducting essential H&S checks.

  • Optimise the dispatch process to ensure accurate order handling for riders and a seamless experience for our restaurant partners.

  • Drive site standards by maintaining high levels of food safety and ensuring a clean, organised, and professional environment.

  • Manage team performance through accurate timekeeping oversight and fostering a positive, cooperative culture on every shift.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proven leadership ability, with experience training others and the confidence to run shifts independently.

  • Strong hands-on mentality and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced operational environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, including proficiency in written and spoken English to coordinate with riders, partners, and stakeholders.

  • A results-oriented mindset with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding KPI targets.

  • Commitment to excellence, ensuring all tasks are completed in a safe, legal, and compliant manner.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with real opportunities to step into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

What We Offer

  • Pay: £14.30 per hour

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Free Deliveroo Plus—no delivery fees on your orders

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Tech Lead Grower Experience (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Grower Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unserer Browser-Anwendung und den dazugehörigen Backend-Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.

Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web-, ERP-, Warehouse- oder E-Commerce-Systemen sowie über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit TypeScript in einer Microservice-Architektur und mit React/Vite im Frontend.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen (AWS Lambda), modernen Deployment-Prozessen (AWS CDK) und Monitoring mit.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.
  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit PostgreSQL oder DocumentDB.
  • Erfahrung mit PHP oder Spryker.
  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen
  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.

Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung der Grower ERP Browser App und ihrer Backend-Services.
  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.
  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.

Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.
  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.
  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Berlin sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort

Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Writer, Frontier AI Best Practice
descriptionHtml:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

About the team

AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted. 

AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary. 

AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. This role directly delivers on part of the Prime Minister’s September 2026commitment that the UK will work towards principles and standards that ensure the most capable AI systems are developed securely and with appropriate transparency. It builds directly on our October 2026 publication Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development, setting out our view of the most urgent priorities. 

This is a new, growing team with high ambitions. It is a cross AISI initiative that draws on and collaborates with researchers and engineers from across AISI's research teams, as well as our Communications, International and Strategy teams. We're now building a dedicated core team and expect it to grow as the work does. 

Why this team matters:

AISI is uniquely placed to shape this guidance, and this team is how we'll do it: 

  • Technical expertise: AISI has roughly 10 technical and research teams whose expertise can be drawn on; one of the largest groups working on AI risk outside the frontier AI companies. AISI has evaluated more than 55 frontier models before release and published research on topics such as safety cases, monitorability and control. 
  • A research institute within government: we work directly with leading AI developers, other governments, and third-party evaluators, and can bring them together around practices no single company would set on its own. UK AISI also coordinates the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science – a group of 10 AI security institutes and equivalents – which has already published its own and socialised others’ best practices.  
  • A track record of shaping industry practice: AISI has already helped establish voluntary practices such as pre-release testing, and built Inspect, now the standard framework for leading third-party evaluators. 

We're not seeking to mandate requirements. We want to contribute our expertise to an industry-wide effort to develop technical best practice that could later inform formal standards. 

What we're working on:

Examples of our first priority areas include: 

  • Overseeing AI systems: what monitoring and controls developers need to make sure AI systems behave as intended, and how to preserve that oversight as systems become more capable. 
  • Sharing information on the speed of AI development: which metrics best track progress, including AI's use in its own development, and when they should be shared with governments and the public. 
  • Assessing and documenting risk: what risk assessments and safety cases should cover, and what standard of evidence they should meet.

About the role

Primary objective: turn AISI's technical expertise into authoritative best-practice documents that frontier AI developers find valuable and use, and into clear explanations of why those practices matter. 

You'll work closely with AISI researchers and the standards team on two kinds of writing. 

Example responsibilities:

  • Best-practice documents (about 50%) 

    • Work with researchers to decide what form each piece of best practice should take, and how it should be structured. 
    • Own delivery of best-practice documents, co-drafting by managing researchers’ technical input and editing to ensure each practice is coherent, specific, testable and technically accurate. 
    • Set out the technical rationale for each practice, drawing on research findings, threat models and evaluation results, so the case for it is evidence-based and credible to a diverse set of expert readers.  
    • Develop a consistent style, templates and terminology for AISI best practice documents, and run review rounds with internal and external experts.

  • Explainers (about 50%) 

    • Write public explainers and technical blog posts setting out the reasoning behind AISI's best practice: why it matters, and what it means for developers, policymakers and the public. For example, the series that follow our agenda, Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development. 
    • Manage multi-stakeholder drafting processes, engaging with feedback from industry, wider government and expert third parties. 
    • Adapt material for different audiences, from technical researchers to non-technical policy readers, working with AISI's communications team.

Reporting and growth:

You'll report to the Head of Technical Standards and Best Practice. This role by default has no line management responsibilities thought responsibility will scale as the team grows. You'll learn from AISI's researchers across a wide range of frontier AI safety topics, and help shape a new team as it grows.

What we are looking for

We're flexible on the exact profile and expect successful candidates will meet many, but not necessarily all, of the criteria below. This role is most likely to fall at Level 4, but we are open to exceptional candidates at other levels. 

Essential:

We're looking for someone who can: 

  • Understand nuanced technical AI safety work well enough to explain its claims and limitations accurately, 
  • Write precise, structured documents that set out what organisations should do and why, 
  • Explain the same technical topics clearly and engagingly to non-technical readers 

For example, you might have: 

  • Written or co-written AI research papers, such as preprints on arXiv. 
  • Written in-depth technical communication on AI working directly with researchers, such as AI company blog posts or technical reports. 
  • Written technical guidance, standards or documentation in a complex field. 
  • Written for public or policy audiences on technical topics. 

You don't need all of these. For a sense of the level and style we're looking for, see the work our research teams publish on the AISI blog by our research teams. 

Desirable:

  • Familiarity with one or more of our priority areas: monitorability, safety cases and risk reports, or AI research automation. 
  • Extensive experience communicating AI security concepts for policy audiences. 
  • Experience running the writing of a multi-author document: gathering input from several experts, resolving conflicting feedback and getting it to publication. 
  • Familiarity with how frontier AI developers, evaluators or standards bodies work, for example from working at or alongside them. 

Example backgrounds:

  • An AI safety researcher who has published several papers and especially enjoys the writing and framing side of research. 
  • A technical writer or science communicator with a machine learning degree or AI background, who has co-written papers or reports on AI research. 
  • A research engineer or analyst at an AI safety organisation who has led writing on published frameworks or reports. 

Core requirements 

  • You should be able to spend at least 4 days per week working with us. 
  • No security clearance is needed to apply. Eligibility for Security Check (SC) clearance is preferred, but not essential. More detail on clearance eligibility can be found on the UK Government website: National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK.

Interview process

Candidates should expect to go through some or all of the following stages once an application has been submitted:   

  • Initial interview   
  • Technical take home test   
  • Second interview and review of take home test   
  • Third interview   
  • Final interview with members of the senior team 

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 
  • On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. 
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 
     

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £40,850 + Technical Allowance £24,150–£34,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £48,540 + Technical Allowance £36,460–£46,460)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £63,165 + Technical Allowance £41,835–£51,835)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £48,525–£58,525)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £68,525)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Use of AI tools in recruitment

We may use AI tools to help our hiring team review applications, for example by summarising application materials and helping us prioritise them against the published criteria. We do not use AI tools to find information about you from other sources, including online. People make every decision. We do not make solely automated decisions about candidates. Find out more, including your rights, in our recruitment privacy notice: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/careers/privacy-policy.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window). As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&I. You can see how we process this data here: Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK.

Over de functie

Onze software verwerkt jaarlijks 35 miljoen declaraties voor zorgaanbieders door heel Nederland. Kwaliteit is hier geen bijzaak — het is de kern van alles wat wij doen. Als Test Automation Engineer ben jij diegene die ervoor zorgt dat onze software blijft werken zoals het hoort: betrouwbaar, snel en veilig.

We werken met een high code test automation oplossing op basis van C#/Playwright. Jij bouwt mee aan ons framework en helpt het naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Heb je een stevige basis in C# en affiniteit met Playwright? Dan ben je precies wie we zoeken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt samen met je team aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van ons test automation framework. Concreet betekent dat:

  • Automatiseren en onderhouden van testcases (UI én API)

  • Bouwen en onderhouden van het test automation framework in C#/Playwright

  • Adviseren over testscenario's en kwaliteitsrisico's

  • Samenwerken met developers, QA's en product owners

  • Kennisdeling binnen de Quality Guild

Wat vragen we?

Must have

  • Stevige basis in C# (high code)

  • Ervaring met of affiniteit voor Playwright

  • Ervaring met API-testen (Rest Assured of vergelijkbaar)

  • Kennis van testmethodieken en Agile werken

  • Teamplayer met goede communicatieve vaardigheden

Nice to have

  • Kennis van Java (achtergrond, geen vereiste)

  • Ervaring met CI/CD (Azure DevOps)

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een zelfstandige en afwisselende rol in een dynamisch team.

  • Een rol met directe impact — 35 miljoen declaraties per jaar draaien op jouw werk

Wie zijn wij?
Bij Infomedics draait alles om het maken van impact in de zorg. We willen de zorgprocessen soepel laten verlopen, maar vooral menselijk houden. We zijn een snelgroeiende en bevlogen organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. We zetten steeds meer in op softwareontwikkeling en zoeken continu naar manieren om waarde toe te voegen voor onze klanten.

We bieden een financieel sterke en stabiele werkomgeving, met volop kansen voor onze medewerkers om door te groeien. Bij Infomedics werk je in een open en vertrouwde omgeving waar samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan.

title: Test Technician
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

  • Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.

  • Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.

  • Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.

  • Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.

  • Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.

  • Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.

  • Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care.

  • Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance.

  • Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations.

  • Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination.

     

WHO YOU ARE

 

  • A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment.

  • Practical electrical measurement skills.

  • The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure.

  • Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results.

  • A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability.

  • The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop.

  • Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings.

  • Ln2 Experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements.

  • High-current DC testing or quench detection.

  • Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems.

  • Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding.

  • CAD literacy for reviewing or developing test fixtures.

  • Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

 

This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH)
*This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

About The Flex

 

Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.

Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.

Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

title: VP, Global Developer Relations
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors.

You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral.

What You Will Do

Build a Global Developer Movement

  • Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists.

  • Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools.

  • Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations.

Engage and Inspire the Technical Community

  • Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including:

    • Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models.

    • Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts.

    • Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities.

  • Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers.

Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption

  • Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models.

  • Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs.

Scale a World-Class DevRel Team

  • Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco

  • Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy).

  • Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities

Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth

  • Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models.

  • Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation.

  • Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source.

  • Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture).

  • Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons).

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions.

  • Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach.

  • Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs).

  • Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities.

  • Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets.

  • Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: VP of Design
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.


Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.


We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description Sonar is looking for a VP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role, responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to translate customer needs and market trends into design decisions that drive measurable business impact.
What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end product design vision, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, and overall platform evolution across Sonar's product line.

  • Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.

  • Build, scale, and lead a global design organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing design talent to foster a high-performing, creative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Champion and evolve Sonar's design systems and UX best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across a complex, technical, developer-facing product suite.

  • Guide the design approach for agentic and AI-driven features, ensuring the team understands emerging patterns and best practices in this space.

  • Engage directly with customers, users, and industry leaders to gather insights, and translate those insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.

  • Represent design at the executive level, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership and cross-functional, global stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to ensure design is embedded early in the product development process, not bolted on at the end.


    • Experience and qualifications

  • 7+ years of management experience in product design, UX, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading and scaling teams globally.

  • Demonstrated success in end-to-end product design leadership, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, strategic product thinking, and platform evolution.

  • Deep expertise in design systems and UX best practices, including experience designing for developer tools, API based tools, or similar technical/complex products.

  • Good understanding of the agentic domain and how it shapes product and design decisions.

  • Experience defining design strategy that drives measurable business outcomes.

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and global stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to mentor and develop design talent, fostering a high-performing, creative, and inclusive global design culture.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and market trends, with experience engaging directly with users and industry leaders to translate insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.


    • Additional comments
    This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.
